hero.sub: Kuvumbura & kugenzura umugenzuzi wa Vortex urungano rwurungano. Fungura. Bifunze. Ntibishobora guhagarara.

network.label: NETWORK
network.body: Urungano rwose rufite indangamuntu yasinywe. Abakiriya bagenzura mbere yo guhuza, node yerekana nyirubwite kwiyandikisha. Nta buyobozi bukuru bushobora kwigana ibyo kode yamaze kwemeza.
network.dual_body: Kwiyandikisha hamwe na mugenzuzi AND bifunze kumurongo binyuze kuri Solana. Abatangabuhamya babiri bigenga bemeza code hash na pubkey. Umutekano mukiganiro cyoroshye.
network.ctrl_body: Umukono werekana ko node ifite urufunguzo rwihariye, ariko ubunyangamugayo ntabwo bwometse kumurongo. Nibyiza kumasomo menshi; ibyago = kwiringira umugenzuzi.
network.unverif_body: Azwi muri config cyangwa gusebanya. Nta bimenyetso bifatika. Koresha gusa kugirango utangire urutonde rwurungano - ntanarimwe nkintego ya handoff kumasomo azima.

security.label: SECURITY
security.body: Bane bigenga Ed25519 kanda, buriwese ufite akazi kamwe. Kwiyunga urufunguzo urwo arirwo rwose ntirusenya izindi.
security.controller_verified: Abakiriya - kuva SNS cyangwa kubaka pin
security.step1_d: Soma vortexx.sol kumurongo. Inyandiko zashyizweho umukono na Solana ikotomoni - ntibishoboka DNS-gushimuta.
security.step2_d: Abakiriya bahamagara /v1/integrity. Kwanga igisubizo icyo aricyo cyose usibye status: verified uhereye kurufunguzo rwo kurekura.
security.step3_d: Buri API guhamagara kugaruka {payload, sig, signed_by}. Umukiriya agenzura umukono wa Ed25519 mbere yo kwizera.
security.step4_d: Ikidodo gifunze: umukiriya asoma code_hash avuye mu gitabo cya Solana. Gutandukana kuva mugenzuzi = kurutonde rwirabura burundu.
security.check_auth: Gusubiza ukuri - ntibishoboka guhimba /v1/nodes udafite urufunguzo rwihariye rwumugenzuzi.
security.check_integrity: Kode yubunyangamugayo - kugenzura dosiye yihuta kandi igenzurwa kuri buri gutangira. Tampering isubiza 503 mbere yuko traffic yose itangwa.
security.check_identity: Indangamuntu - imitwe igomba gusinya kwiyandikisha nurufunguzo rwabo. Igitero ntigishobora kwiyandikisha mwizina ryizindi mbuto.
security.check_dns: DNS kurinda gushimuta - .sol inyandiko zibaho kuri Solana. Umwanzi akeneye guteshuka ku gikapo, ntabwo ari DNS gusa.
security.check_handoff: Handoff umutekano - kwimura amasomo bitwara ibimenyetso bya Ed25519 byashyizweho umukono na anti-replay, bifite iminota 5 gusa. Intego yanze inkomoko itazwi.
security.check_transport: Gutwara ibanga - guhuza URL bigaragara kuri ISP / Cloudflare. Koresha indorerwamo ya Tor niba metadata ifite akamaro.
security.check_content: Ubutumwa bwibirimo - NOT byakozwe na mugenzuzi. Impera-iherezo-ihishe hagati yabakoresha. Umugenzuzi ntashobora gusoma ikintu kabone niyo cyaba cyangiritse rwose.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel - niba VPS yashinze imizi, urufunguzo rushobora kwibwa. Koresha ibyuma bishyigikiwe nibikoresho bya paranoid.

access.label: ACCESS
access.body: Ingingo nyinshi zinjira bivuze ko nta kintu na kimwe gishobora guhagarika uburyo bwawe. Imbuga zindorerwamo zitanga ibyasinywe bivuye mubikorwa remezo byigenga.
access.tunnel_body: Ubuntu * .trycloudflare.com adresse. Nta konti isabwa. URL ihinduka mugihe umuyoboro utangiye - fata nka ephemeral.
access.tor_body: .umwanya wa adresse, ushobora kugera kuri Tor gusa. Censor-yerekana na metadata-yihariye, ariko itinda. Ukeneye umukiriya wa Tor.
access.ipfs_body: Ibirimo-byerekanwe kopi yimiterere yimbere. Irembo ryose IPFS rirashobora kuyikorera - nta seriveri imwe yo guhagarika.
access.direct_body: Indangarugero isanzwe + TLS. Ihitamo ryihuse. Guhagarikwa kurwego rwa DNS/IP - kugwa kubandi niba bigenzuwe.
access.mirrors_body: Ubundi hosties ikora ibintu bimwe byashyizweho umukono nkiyi mugenzuzi. Buri ndorerwamo isuzumwa mugihe - akadomo kibisi bivuze kugerwaho muminota 5 yanyuma. Indorerwamo za Tor .onion ntizishobora kugenzurwa nubuzima udafite porokisi yaho.

start.label: GET STARTED
start.step1: Kwinjiza Vortex kubikoresho byawe - mobile cyangwa desktop.
start.step3: Shyira mugenzuzi URL (auto-byakemuwe ukoresheje SNS) cyangwa any0⟫entry URL uhereye kurupapuro rwinjira.
start.step4: Kugenzura pubkey muri porogaramu yawe ihuye nintoki ya mugenzuzi hepfo. Kudahuza bisobanura kunyereza.
start.step5: Urahuze. Urutonde, umukono, hamwe ninzira bikoreshwa uburyo bwikora.
start.fingerprint_note: Shyira urufunguzo mu bakiriya bawe mbere yo kwizera igisubizo icyo ari cyo cyose.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS
treasury.transparency_body: Amafaranga yose ya protocole - amafaranga yo kwiyandikisha no kugabanya 20% yo kwiyandikisha kwa premium - gutembera mu gikapu cya Solana. Igicuruzwa cyose kigenzurwa kumugaragaro numuntu wese.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% ya buri premium sub ijya mubihembo bya pisine, ikwirakwizwa pro-rata kubakoresha node ikora. 20% bitera inkunga yibanze. 10% yaka cyangwa yicaye nkubwishingizi.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Ururimi
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Ururimi rwimikorere rwimyandikire yo kubaka bots. Ibiranga 96. Inyuma.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix ni ururimi rwihariye (DSL) rwashizweho kuva hasi kugirango rwandike Vortex. Aho izindi ndimi zisaba amasomero, guhamagarwa, hamwe na boilerplate, Gravitix iguha ibyiciro byambere byabashinzwe kuyobora ibyabaye, ibiganiro bitemba, hamwe na leta yubatswe - byose mubisobanuro bisukuye, bisomeka byahumetswe na Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Isomeka - code isoma nkintego, ntabwo imashini
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Umutekano - ubwoko bwa static bufata amakosa mbere yigihe cyo gukora
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Kugaragaza - gutemba, kurinda, no guhuza imiterere byubatswe
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Ntarengwa - nta byiciro, nta murage, nta buryo bwo kwiga
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix ni iyumuntu wese ushaka kubaka bot ya Vortex vuba - waba utarigeze wandika code mbere, cyangwa uri umuhanga muburambe warambiwe guteka Python. Iyi nyandiko yigisha Gravitix uhereye kumahame yambere: nta burambe bwambere busabwa.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Buri gice cyubaka kubibanjirije. Niba uri mushya kuri programming, soma kuva hejuru kugeza hasi. Niba usanzwe uzi urundi rurimi, koresha imbonerahamwe yibirimo kugirango usimbukire neza kubigushimishije.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Inzira yihuta kuva kuri zeru kugera kuri bot ikora.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: kuri / gutangira {...} - isobanura umukoresha ukora iyo umukoresha yohereje / gutangira. ohereza "..." - yohereza ubutumwa gusubira kumukoresha. {ctx.first_name} - ihuza izina ryumukoresha kumurongo.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Muri Gravitix IDE, kanda buto yo Gukoresha mukabari hejuru. Injira Vortex Bot Token mugihe ubajijwe. Bot itangira ako kanya - nta ntambwe yo kubaka ikenewe.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Porogaramu ya Gravitix yubatswe kuva kubintu bitatu byibanze byubaka: abakoresha, gusohora imvugo, na logique.
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Agaciro kose muri Gravitix gafite ubwoko. Ubwoko bwa sisitemu irahagaze: ubwoko bugenzurwa mugihe cyo gukusanya, mbere yuko bot yawe ikora.
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Abakoresha bahuza indangagaciro kugirango batange indangagaciro nshya.
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Imirongo muri Gravitix ni UTF-8 inyandiko yanditse. Bashyigikira interpolation ikungahaye hamwe na suite yimikorere.
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Igishushanyo-gihuza agaciro kangana nuburyo bwinshi. Tekereza nk'amagambo akomeye yo guhindura.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Imikorere nibishobora gukoreshwa kode ya code. Baragufasha kwirinda gusubiramo no koroshya kode kubyumva.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Abacunga umutima ni bot ya Gravitix. Buri mucungamutungo yumva ubwoko bwihariye bwibyabaye kandi akiruka mugihe ibyo byabaye.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Abashinzwe umutekano bakwemerera kongeramo ibintu kumucunga. Umukoresha yiruka gusa niba umuzamu asuzumye ukuri.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Ikintu ctx gihita kiboneka imbere muri buri mucunga. Irimo amakuru ajyanye n'ubutumwa buriho n'umukoresha wayohereje.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: Leta ireka bot yawe yibuka ibintu hagati yubutumwa. Hatariho leta, buri butumwa bwigenga kandi bot nta kwibuka.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Urujya n'uruza reka wandike ibiganiro-byintambwe nyinshi muburyo bumwe, busomeka. Urujya n'uruza rushobora guhagarara no gutegereza ubutumwa bukurikira.
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Kohereza ubutumwa nibisohoka byibanze bya bot.
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Koresha code mu buryo bwikora kuri gahunda - nta mirimo ya cron, nta serivisi zo hanze zikenewe.
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Umuyoboro wa pipe |> utambutsa agaciro nkimpaka yambere kumikorere ikurikira. Bituma ingoyi zikorwa zisomeka, ibumoso ugana iburyo.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix itanga ikosa ryuburyo bwo kugerageza / gufata / kurangiza.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Inzira ikwemerera guteranya amakuru ajyanye nubwoko bwiswe. Enum isobanura ifunze ryahinduwe.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix yohereza isomero ryimibare yuzuye hamwe nimirimo ~ 180.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix ifite ubwoko kavukire bugizwe - hamwe na 64-bit ireremba byerekana ibice nyabyo nibitekerezo.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix ikubiyemo imibare yimibare: ibikomoka hamwe nibisobanuro bibarwa kumikorere uko bishakiye.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Algebra kumurongo ni imibare ya vectors na matrices.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Umubare wimibare yiga imiterere yimibare. Urufatiro rwibikoresho bigezweho.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Ibarurishamibare ritanga ibikoresho byo gusobanura, gusesengura, no gufata imyanzuro iva mu makuru.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Imikorere idasanzwe ni ibisubizo byingirakamaro zingana.
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Impinduka ya Fourier ibora ikimenyetso mumirongo yacyo.
gravitixDocs.bp5: Koresha kugaruka hakiri kare kugirango ugabanye ibyari
gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Inzira nziza yo kwiga Gravitix nukubaka. Tangira byoroshye echo bot, hanyuma wongere leta, hanyuma ongeraho flux. Buri gitekerezo gishya wiga gifungura byinshi bishoboka.

complex_type.cc8: Imizi ya kare kare ya −1 ni i
complex_type.li4: Icyemezo: (a + bi) / (c + di) = [(ac + bd) / (c² + d²)] + [(bc - ad) / (c² + d²)] i
complex_type.li5: Imbaraga: z ** n ikoresha formula ya De Moivre kuri integer n
complex_type.p1: Umubare utoroshye ufite ishusho a + bi, aho a nigice nyacyo naho b nigice cyibitekerezo. i nigice cyibitekerezo cyasobanuwe na i² = −1. Imibare igoye yongerera umurongo nyawo indege, itanga ibisubizo kuburinganire nka x² + 1 = 0 bidafite igisubizo nyacyo.
complex_type.p2: Muri Gravitix wandika imvugo yibitekerezo hamwe na i umugereka:
complex_type.p3: Ibikorwa bine byose byibanze bikora kumico itaziguye. Gravitix ikurikiza amategeko asanzwe yimibare:
complex_type.p4: Gutunganya ibimenyetso (gusesengura amajwi, FFT), ibisekuruza byavunitse (set ya Mandelbrot), kwigana ibya fiziki, kubara inzitizi zamashanyarazi, hamwe na comptabilite byose bisaba imibare igoye. intro.p1: Gravitix ni ururimi rwihariye (DSL) rwashizweho kuva hasi kugirango rwandike Vortex. Aho izindi ndimi zisaba amasomero, guhamagarwa, hamwe na boilerplate, Gravitix iguha ibyiciro byambere byabashinzwe kuyobora ibyabaye, ibiganiro flows, kandi byubatswe muri state - byose mubisobanuro bisukuye, bisomeka byahumetswe na Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix ni kubantu bose bashaka kubaka Vortex bot vuba - waba utarigeze wandika code mbere, cyangwa uri umuhanga muburambe urambiwe Python boilerplate. Iyi nyandiko yigisha Gravitix uhereye kumahame yambere: nta burambe bwambere busabwa.
intro.p3: Buri gice cyubaka kubibanjirije. Niba uri mushya kuri programming, soma kuva hejuru kugeza hasi. Niba usanzwe uzi urundi rurimi, koresha imbonerahamwe yibirimo kugirango usimbukire neza kubigushimishije.
intro.p4: Muri iyi nyandiko yose, → bisobanura "gusuzuma" cyangwa "gutanga", naho // ... bisobanura ibitekerezo byirengagijwe nuwabiteguye.

math_linalg.td11: Kugwiza every element by scalar s

types.p1: 64-bit byashyizweho umukono. Shyigikira indangagaciro kuva kuri −9.2 × 10¹⁸ kugeza +9.2 × 10¹⁸.
types.p10: Indangagaciro zimwe zirashobora kuba zidahari. Imirima idahitamo muri ctx (nka ctx.username) irashobora kuba null. Buri gihe ugenzure mbere yo gukoresha:
types.p11: Ongeraho ? nyuma yubwoko bwerekana ko ari hitamo - agaciro gashobora kuba null. Nuburyo imikorere yimikorere na state imirima yerekana "ibi birashoboka cyangwa ntibishobora kuba bihari":
types.p12: Niba agaciro kadashobora kubaho buri gihe, tangaza T? kandi uhore ugenzura != null mbere yo kuyikoresha. Kugera kumurima null ntibisenya bot - ni returns null bucece.
types.p3: 10 / 3 hamwe na int indangagaciro ebyiri gives2⟫ (zaciwe). Koresha 10.0 / 3.0 kubisubizo icumi.
types.p5: Umugozi wanditse Unicode. Imirongo ni indangagaciro zidahinduka.
types.p6: Itondekanya ryurutonde rwindangagaciro, zose zubwoko bumwe T.

types.p9: return ubwoko bwimikorere idafite return agaciro. Ntushobora kwandika void mu buryo bweruye - nibisanzwe mugihe nta return ubwoko bwerekanwe.

architexDocs.title: Ururimi rwa Architex
architexDocs.subtitle: Imvugo UI imvugo ya Vortex Mini Apps. Imiterere ifatika, imiterere ihimbye, zeru kubaka intambwe.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex nigitangaza gito DSL cyagenewe kohereza UI imbere yintumwa ya Vortex. Urasobanura uko ecran igomba kuba imeze; igihe cyo gukora gikomeza pigiseli muguhuza na leta mu buryo bwikora. Nta virtual DOM, nta bundler, nta JSX - dosiye ya `.arx` ni porogaramu.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Gutangaza - wandika UI ushaka, ntabwo ari intambwe zo kuyubaka
architexDocs.goalReactive: Igikorwa - `~ kubara + = 1` na buri kirango gisoma kivugurura ahantu
architexDocs.goalPortable: Igendanwa - kimwe `.arx` ikora kurubuga, iOS, na Android mugihe cyoguhindura
architexDocs.goalTiny: Gitoya - parser + renderer ubwato munsi ya 30 KB, nuko Mini App zifungura ako kanya
architexDocs.goalReadable: Isomeka - indentation ni imiterere; abahindura iminyururu hamwe na `::`; nta musoro utuje
architexDocs.whoDesc: Umuntu wese ushaka kohereza ecran ya interineti muri Vortex - ifishi yabakiriya, imbaho ​​zamamaza, urupapuro rwitora, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Niba warigeze kwandika HTML + CSS + JS, Architex izumva umenyereye ariko byihuse kwandika. Niba utarigeze ubikora, Architex nayo ni intangiriro yoroheje yo gutangiza gahunda kuko ururimi rutuma ikirenge gito.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Buri gice cyubaka kuri kimwe mbere. Tangira Byihuse Gutangira, hanyuma usome Syntax, Leta, Imiterere, Abahindura, Ibikorwa, nigice cyambere cyanyuma. Simbuka unyuze kumeza yibirimo niba usanzwe uzi Reaction cyangwa Svelte - ikarita yerekana neza.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Inzira ngufi kuva muri dosiye irimo ubusa running0⟫.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Mwaramutse

  ~ izina = "isi"

  col :: padi (24) icyuho (12) hagati

    umutwe "Mwaramutse, {~ izina}!" :: ubunini butinyutse (28)

    kwinjiza ~ izina :: padi (8) radiyo (6) umupaka (#ccc)

    inyandiko "Andika izina hejuru - iyi nyandiko ivugurura uko wanditse."
      :: ubunini (12) ibara (# 888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Mwaramutse` itangaza umuzi. `~ izina =" isi "` ikora impinduka ihinduka. `col`,` header`, `input`,` text` byubatswe mubice. `::` ifata abahindura (padi, amabara, ubunini). Iyo umukoresha yanditse mubyinjijwe, buri `{~ izina}` ivugurura rya interpolation - nta wiring, nta abiyandikishije, nta bihindura intoki.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Fungura ahanditse Architex muri studio ya bVortex, andika kode, kanda Run. Igihe cyoguhindura muburyo bwo kureba mbere na hot-reloads kuri save. Iyo utangaje, abakoresha bawe bafungura porogaramu mubiganiro byose - nta kwinjiza.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Porogaramu ya Architex yose igizwe nibintu bine: imenyekanisha ritangirana na `@`, impinduka zifatika zabanjirijwe na `~`, ibice byanditse nkibiranga ubusa, hamwe nabahindura bifatanye nyuma ya :: :: `.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Ibigize bicaye kumurongo wabo: `inyandiko`,` buto`, `ishusho`,` umutwe`, `label`,` badge`, `divider`,` col`, `umurongo. Ibitekerezo byabo byimyanya biza nyuma yizina: `inyandiko ~ ubutumwa`,` buto "Kubika" `," ishusho "/logo.png" `.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Nyuma ya :: :: `urashobora guhuza urunigi rwinshi nkuko ubishaka. Buriwese afata impaka zeru cyangwa nyinshi mumutwe: `:: pad (24) icyuho (16) hagati yubunini butangaje (20) ibara (# 4f8ef7)`. Abahindura ni imyanya, ntabwo ari ijambo ryibanze - gahunda ntacyo itwaye usibye uwanditse-umwanditsi-watsinze nka `ibara`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` kuri buto (cyangwa ikindi kintu icyo aricyo cyose) ikora umukoro cyangwa imikorere ihamagara ikurikira. Inshuro nyinshi `=>` urunigi uruhande rumwe: `buto" Tanga "=> ~ uhuze = ukuri => ohereza (ibikorwa:" kuzigama ", amakuru: ~ ifishi)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Izina iryo ari ryo ryose ryashyizwe hamwe na `~` ni selile ikora. Andika `~ kubara = 0` gutangaza,` ~ kubara = 5` kugirango wongere ugabanye, `~ kubara + = 1` kuvugurura. Buri UI node isoma selile - itaziguye cyangwa ikoresheje interpolation - irongera igatanga iyo selile ihindutse.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Koresha `: =` aho kugirango `=` gutangaza imvugo ibarwa: `~ igiteranyo: = ~ kubara * ~ intambwe`. Uruhande rwiburyo rwongeye gusuzuma igihe cyose kwishingikiriza guhinduka. Nta kwandikisha intoki kandi nta na stale-agaciro gakomeye - niba usomye `~ a` ahantu runaka mumagambo, uhita ushingira kuri yo.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Ibisobanuro birahinduka ariko bifasha mubutumwa bwuzuye kandi bwibeshya: `~ kubara: umubare = 0`,` ~ izina: umugozi = "" ",` ~ ok: boolean = ibinyoma`, `~ ibintu: array = []`, `~ umukoresha: ikintu = {}`. Niba ubasimbutse ubwoko bwatanzwe kuva kubitangira.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: "umubare", "umugozi", "boolean", "array", "ikintu", "null". Amatariki na blob byanyuze nkumugozi nibintu bikurikiranye. Igihe cyogukoresha ikoresha amategeko ya agahato JavaScript munsi ya hood, bityo `~ kubara + 1` ikora nubwo` ~ kubara` yatangiye ubuzima nkumugozi.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Umugozi uwo ariwo wose urashobora gushyiramo imvugo hamwe na `{...}`: `" Uraho, {~ umukoresha.izina}! "", "" Igiteranyo: {~ kubara * ~ igiciro} "`. Interpolation ihora ikora.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex ifite ibintu bibiri bishobora guhurizwa hamwe nibice icumi byibabi. Nubashyire hamwe na indentation - nta tagi yo gufunga.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` itondekanya abana mu buryo buhagaritse,` umurongo` utambitse. Bombi bemera `icyuho (n)`, `pad (n)`, `centre`,` gukura`, nubugari / uburebure. Erekana abana urwego rumwe rwimbitse kugirango ruture.
architexDocs.containerExample:
umurongo :: icyuho (8) padi (16) hagati
  ishusho "/avatar.png" :: w (40) h (40) radiyo (20)
  col :: gukura icyuho (2)
    inyandiko ~ izina :: ushize amanga
    inyandiko ~ bio :: ubunini (12) ibara (# 888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `inyandiko` - kopi yumubiri. `Umutwe` - mu buryo busanzwe umutwe. `label` - inyandiko ntoya. `buto` - kugenzura-gukanda. `kwinjiza` - inyandiko yumurongo uhujwe na var igaragara. `ishusho` - ishusho kuva URL. `badge` - ikirango kimeze nkibinini. `divider` - umurongo utandukanya. `toast` - ephemeral snackbar. `tabs` /` tab` - uhindura tab.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: "inyandiko" Mwaramutse "` itanga umurongo uhagaze. `inyandiko ~ ubutumwa` itanga igisubizo. Huza hamwe na interpolation: `inyandiko" Igiteranyo: {~ kubara} "`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Umutwe. Mburabuzi kuri binini, bitinyutse kuruta `inyandiko '. Impaka zumwanya umwe: `umutwe" Igenamiterere "`. Ingano yubunini hamwe na ecran - kurenga hamwe na `size (n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Ikintu gishobora gukoreshwa. Ikurikiranyanyuguti ni ikirango; i `=>` igikorwa gikora kuri kanda. `buto" Kubika "=> ~ umushinga = null`. Igwiza `=>` umuriro murutonde.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Inzira-ebyiri-zihuza inyandiko. Impinduka zifatika nyuma yizina rifite agaciro kagezweho: `kwinjiza ~ imeri`. Abahindura: `umwanya ("… ")`, `gusohora (300)` kubintu bishya.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Imizigo iva HTTPS URL cyangwa `/ kohereza / ...` inzira. Abahindura `w (px)`, `h (px)`, `radiyo (px)` gutunganya agasanduku. Kugaruka gusubira kumwanya wa silhouette niba URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Gutandukanya umusatsi, 1px, yubaha ibara ryinsanganyamatsiko. Nta mpaka.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Inkingi ihobera ibiyirimo: `badge ~ kubara`,` badge "nshya" `. Koresha kuri compte idasomwe hamwe na chip chip.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Inyandiko / umufasha inyandiko - bigaragara neza. Good for for form field name.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Kutamenyesha. `toast ~ igaragara" Yakijijwe! " :: igihe (2000) `yerekana kuri 2 s igihe cyose` ~ igaragara` nukuri, hanyuma auto-kwirukana. Nta gutondeka muburyo, nta ntambara z-indangagaciro.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Ibikoresho bya tab bihujwe numugozi udasanzwe: `tabs ~ activeTab`. Imbere yacyo, buri "tab" Ikirango "" urufunguzo "` itangaza tab imwe; umubiri wagabanutse munsi werekana iyo urufunguzo ruhuye.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Abahindura nuburyo bwonyine bwo gutunganya ibice. Iminyururu nyuma ya `::`. Baza mumiryango itanu: intera, ubunini, ibara, imashini yandika, nimyitwarire.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `padi (n)` - padi kumpande zose. `padi (x, y)` - itambitse + ihagaritse. `padi (hejuru, iburyo, hepfo, ibumoso)` - CSS-gahunda. `icyuho (n)` - umwanya hagati yabana ba `col` /` umurongo`. `margin (n)` - intera yo hanze ivuye murumuna wawe.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w (px)` - ubugari bwagenwe. `h (px)` - uburebure buhamye. `gukura` - kuzuza umwanya usigaye kumurongo / col. `centre` - hagati kuruhande rw'umusaraba; muri `col` ishingiye kuri horizontalale, muri` umurongo` ihagaritse.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `ibara (#rrggbb)` - imbere. `bg (#rrggbb)` - inyuma. Byombi byemera ibimenyetso byinsanganyamatsiko: `ibara (~ primaire)` isoma uhereye kuri @ @ insanganyamatsiko. Amahirwe anyura mumibare 8: `# 00000080` ni 50 %% umukara.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `ingano (px)` - ingano yimyandikire. `bold` /` italic` - uburemere nuburyo. `guhuza (ibumoso | hagati | iburyo)` - guhuza inyandiko.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `ihishe (~ ibendera)` - gukuramo node iyo ibendera ari ukuri. `igaragara (~ ibendera)` - inverse. Imyanya itabaruwe yamennye DOM, bityo rero condition1⟫ ihendutse.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `gusohora (ms)` kuri `ibyinjijwe 'bigezweho. `umwanya ("… ")` yerekana umugozi. `imiterere (ubwoko, impaka)` kuri `umwandiko` imiterere nimero:` imiterere ("ifaranga", "USD") `," imiterere ("ijanisha") `,` imiterere ("compact") `.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius (px)` izenguruka inguni. `umupaka (#rrggbb)` ushushanya 1 px. `umupaka (px, #rrggbb)` ushiraho ubunini.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Ibikorwa bihindura leta cyangwa kuvugana nisi yo hanze. Bakoresha icyarimwe muri tap / keypress handler.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~ kubara = 0`,` => ~ uhuze = ukuri`, `=> ~ urutonde = []`. Impinduka zose zifatika zirandikwa.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+ = n`,` - = n`, `* = n`,` / = n`. `=> ~ kubara + = 1` ni idasanzwe kuri compte.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Igwiza `=>` kumurongo umwe umuriro hejuru-hasi mumatike amwe, nuko UI ivugurura rimwe kurangiza: `buto" Gura "=> ~ uhuze = ukuri => ohereza (ibikorwa:" kugura ") => ~ uhuze = ibinyoma`. Kubikorwa bya async, hitamo ibarwa `@ reaction`.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `ohereza (ibikorwa:" izina ", ... args)` ni ikiraro gisubira muri bot. Nyiricyubahiro (Vortex runtime) yakira nkubutumwa bwa JSON RPC kandi arashobora guhamagara kode ya bot yawe. Koresha kwinjira, API kuzana, kwishura - ikintu cyose DSL ubwacyo kidashobora kwerekana.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto (" ScreenName ", arg: agaciro, ...)` asunika indi `@ ecran` kuri stack; `inyuma ()` pop. Ikiringo gikora animasiyo.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Menyesha palette inshuro imwe, ongera ukoreshe ahantu hose. Tokens ihinduka ibintu bisanzwe bihinduka kuburyo porogaramu yawe ishobora kohereza uburyo bwijimye bwo guhinduranya mumirongo itatu.
architexDocs.themeExample:
@insanganyamatsiko
  ~ ibanze = # 4f8ef7
  ~ akaga = # e53935
  ~ bg = #ffffff
  ~ inyandiko = # 212121
  ~ radius = 12
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import". Inzira zijyanye na dosiye itumizwa mu mahanga; ibicuruzwa bitumizwa mu mahanga byamenyekanye kandi bigatangazwa mugihe cya parse.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Sobanura rimwe, koresha inshuro nyinshi: `@ibigize Avatar url ingano \ n ishusho url :: w (ubunini) h (ubunini) radiyo (ubunini / 2)`. Imbere yibigize umubiri witiriwe ibipimo biri murwego nkibiranga neza (nta `~`).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@kintu kiri ~ urutonde` itanga umurongo umwe kuri buri kintu. `@kintu, idx muri ~ list` nayo ihuza indangagaciro-ishingiye kuri zeru. Igihe gikurikirana gikurikirana indangamuntu ukoresheje element ubwayo, bityo ukongeraho ibintu hejuru yurutonde rwa 10 000-umurongo ugura O (1) DOM akazi.
architexDocs.forExample:
@kintu, idx mubintu ~
  umurongo :: icyuho (8) padi (4)
    badge ~ idx
    inyandiko ~ ikintu :: gukura
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond? a: b` ikora ahantu hose imvugo iremewe. Icyari cyo kubara: `~ status> = 10? "hejuru": ~ imiterere> = 5? "hagati": "hasi" `.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Imbere mu kumenyekanisha ibice, `slot` ibimenyetso aho umubiri wumuhamagaye wacometse. Tekereza nkibisubizo byabana / Agaciro gasanzwe.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: Buri `~ var` ni ikimenyetso. Iyo uyisomye imbere yabazwe, ihindura impaka, cyangwa interpolation, igihe cyogusoma cyerekana ibyasomwe mubishushanyo mbonera. Iyo wanditse, buri node isoma irongera igasuzumwa - rimwe, kumpera ya microtask yubu.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Ibice byinshi byanditse mubikoresha bimwe byateguwe. `=> ~ a = 1 => ~ b = 2` itera neza inzira imwe.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Mburabuzi isaha ikoresha uburinganire bukomeye (`===`). Kwandika agaciro kamwe ntabwo byongera gukora. Hisha ikintu gishya / umurongo kugirango uhatire ivugurura; kudahinduka birashishikarizwa ariko ntibisabwa.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Porogaramu enye zemewe, buriwese urimo kandi munsi yumurongo 40. Gukoporora icyaricyo cyose muri tab ya Architex hanyuma ukande Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter - leta ikora, ibarwa, abakoresha buto, guhuza inyandiko.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo - urutonde rwerekana, ongeraho / ukureho, uhindure umurongo.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Umwirondoro - ishusho, badges, kugaragara neza, kugendagenda.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Ibiranga abicanyi - insanganyamatsiko, ibitumizwa mu mahanga, tabs, toast, imibare yimiterere, ternaries, wanditse.
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `izina ritazwi ~ foo` - wakoresheje impinduka ihinduka mbere yo kubitangaza. Ongeraho `~ foo =…` hejuru yikuzuza `@ ecran`.
architexDocs.errIndent: `indent itunguranye` - abana bagomba kuba urwego rumwe rwimbitse kuruta ababyeyi babo. Architex ikoresha imyanya ibiri kurwego rwose; tabs zanze kwirinda ibiboneka-byera byumwanya.
architexDocs.errModifier: `modifier itazwi` - wanditse` :: igicucu` ariko igihe cyo kugikora ntigishyigikiye. Reba urutonde rwabahinduye hejuru; Architex irakomeye kubyerekeye amazina atazwi kugirango irinde guhuza imbere.
architexDocs.errType: `andika idahuye` - urugero watsinze umurongo aho umubare uteganijwe. Andika impinduka zifatika (`~ kubara: umubare`) hanyuma parser azakubwira aho agaciro keza gakomoka.
architexDocs.errDebug: Kugirango ukemure mugihe cyogukora, funga imvugo ukekwaho muri `debug (...)` - - igihe cyo gukora cyandika buri suzuma kuri konsole bitagize ingaruka ku gaciro.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Urubuga - ruhindura muri vanilla DOM hamwe na CSS impinduka kubimenyetso byinsanganyamatsiko. Nta reaction / Vue / Svelte.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS - kimwe `.arx` irasuzumwa kandi ihindurwa muburyo bwa SwiftUI ukoresheje Vortex host host. Ikarita yose ihindura uburyo bwa SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android - uwakiriye ahindura muri Jetpack Guhimba. Guhindura ibimenyetso (`:: onTap`,` :: onLongPress`) bisobanura Guhimba ibingana.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Politiki ya verisiyo - Architex yemeza guhuza inyuma ya dosiye ya `.arx` muburyo buto. Idosiye ya `.arx` yanditse kuri 0.1 iracyakora kuri 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Soma igitabo cyo gutekamo ibishushanyo (urutonde rutagira ingano, ifishi, ubwishyu), igikoresho cyo gukoresha plugin ya CLI na VS, hamwe nuyobora umusanzu niba ushaka kongeramo ibice byubatswe. Inkomoko yuzuye iri kuri github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Reba
meta.subtitle: Buri sisitemu ya Vortex ahantu hamwe.
meta.intro: Iyi nyandiko irarambuye kubishushanyo mbonera. Tangira aho ariho hose - buri gice kirimo wenyine. Amagambo yose ahuza inzira yinkomoko iyo ari ngombwa. Buri invariant ihamagarwa ku buryo bweruye.
meta.howToUse: Imbonerahamwe yibirimo kurorerwamo ibumoso ibice hano. Kanda igice kugirango usimbukiremo; buri gice gifite imitwe hamwe nurutonde ushobora gusikana mumasegonda 30 mbere yo kwibira.
meta.updatedBy: Byakozwe kuva `inyandiko / kubaka_vortex_docs_v2.py`. Ongera wubake hamwe na `python3 inyandiko / kubaka_vortex_docs_v2.py`.

architecture.title: Incamake yubwubatsi
architecture.subtitle: Inzira eshatu - umukiriya, node, umugenzuzi - na protocole imwe ibahuza.
architecture.intro: Vortex ni intumwa yegerejwe abaturage. Aho kugirango umugongo umwe winyuma ufitwe nisosiyete imwe, uhuza meshi ifunguye yigenga ya ** node ** yigenga, yavumbuwe kandi yemejwe na comptabilite ** igenzura ** itangaza umukono wa kode yemeje. ** Abakiriya ** bafashe urufunguzo rwihariye hanyuma utange UI. Igice gisigaye cyiki gice kigenda inzira eshatu, imbibi zabo, namakuru atemba hagati yabo.
architecture.h1p1: Intumwa zishyizwe hamwe ni ingingo imwe yo guhatira. Icyemezo cyurukiko, guhagarika ibicu, cyangwa kugura abanzi byose bisobanurwa ngo "abakoresha babuze uburyo". Vortex kuruhande ko kureka umuntu uwo ari we wese akayobora kandi akareka abakiriya bagenda hagati yumutwe batongeye kwiyandikisha.
architecture.h1p2: Kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage bigomba kubika ibanga n'ubunyangamugayo. Federasiyo ya seriveri itizewe ikora gusa mugihe seriveri idashobora gusoma imvugo yoroheje kandi idashobora guhimba ubutumwa. Vortex yubahiriza byombi binyuze muri encryption ya nyuma-iherezo na Ed25519 kuri buri butumwa bwambukiranya imipaka.
architecture.h1p3: Igenzura nigice kimwe-cyashizwe, ariko ni gito. Itangaza gusa `INTEGRITY.sig.json` nurutonde rwibintu byizewe byinjira. Umuntu uwo ari we wese arashobora kwiyakira indorerwamo, bityo rero nuwayigenzuye ntabwo ari ingingo imwe yo gutsindwa - gusa isoko imwe yukuri y "" igituba gisinyira kumugaragaro ".
architecture.h1l1: Nta mucuruzi ufunga: abakiriya barashobora kwimura umwirondoro wabo hagati yumwanya uwariwo wose wongeye gusinyira key0⟫ pubkey hamwe na JWT.
architecture.h1l2: Ntaho bihurira: iyo node imwe yamanutse, abakoresha kurindi zina ntibabibona.
architecture.h1l3: Nta bubasha bumwe: abakoresha bahitamo inzu yabo yemewe, naho abakoresha bahitamo umukoresha wabo.
architecture.h1l4: Nta numwe UI: iOS, Android, urubuga ni urungano rwo mu rwego rwa mbere - nta platform nimwe ipfunyika hejuru yundi.
architecture.h2p1: Umukiriya akoresha igikoresho cyumukoresha. Aho niho honyine ubutumwa bwanditse bwanditse, urufunguzo rwihariye, na dosiye-mu-bisobanutse neza. Umutwe ntushobora kubabona.
architecture.h2p2: Buri platform ishyigikiwe ishyira mubikorwa protocole imwe (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-gutandukanya ibiranga modules (`api /` protocole, `impl /` code, `ui /` views) komeza amasezerano neza kandi code yihariye yihariye.
architecture.h2p3: Ububiko ku gikoresho: Urufunguzo / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpKuki gusa kubimenyetso; SQLite (GRDB kuri iOS, Icyumba kuri Android, Ipfunyika rya IndexDB ku rubuga) kuri ciphertext cache + indangagaciro FTS.
architecture.h2l1: iOS - Swift Package hamwe na 30+ biranga module. Intego ntoya yoherejwe iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android - Kotlin + Guhimba + Hilt. minSdk 26, integoSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Urubuga - vanilla JS PWA, umukozi wa serivisi, nta ntambwe yo kubaka irenze ES module ihuza.
architecture.h2l4: Ibiro - Tauri gupfunyika umukiriya wurubuga; bundle imwe, kavukire ya Chrome.
architecture.h3p1: Umutwe ni Python inzira (`python -m app.main`, cyangwa bundled` run.py`) utegera kuri 9000 muburyo budasanzwe. Ikomeza ciphertext, abafana hanze WebSocket ibyabaye, ifite ibyangombwa TURN, hamwe na federasiyo yabakozi hamwe nizindi ngingo.
architecture.h3p2: Igice cya node ni cyoroshye nkana. Irerekana inzira zigera kuri 120 zambukiranya `/ api / *` igiti wongeyeho `/ ws` kubakunzi-nyabo. Guterura biremereye (crypto, kuboneka, gahunda) byashyizwe muri `porogaramu / umutekano /`, `porogaramu / ubwikorezi /`, `porogaramu / urungano /`.
architecture.h3p3: Umuyoboro umwe muburyo busanzwe bwa SQLite ukoresha ~ 50 abakoresha bahuje neza kuri M1. Hamwe na Postgres na Redis byashobotse, umunzani umwe umunzani utambitse - buri node ihinduka ubwenegihugu ushize DB hamwe nabafana-hanze.
architecture.h3l1: Ingingo zinjira: `/ api / *` HTTPS, `/ ws` WebSocket,` / v1 / ubunyangamugayo` na `/ ubuzima` kugirango ubeho.
architecture.h3l2: Biterwa: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust kwagura `vortex_chat` kuri hot-inzira ya crypto.
architecture.h3l3: Ibyifuzo: Redis (kuba umufana uhari hirya no hino), Postgres (umusaruro DB), coturn (TURN relay), kuvuga neza (kohereza ibicuruzwa).
architecture.h3l4: Ingano ya binini: ~ 60 MB Python deps + ~ 10 MB Rust kwaguka. Ishusho ya Docker hafi 400 MB mbere ya squash.
architecture.h4p1: Igenzura ni inzira yihariye Python (`vortex_controller`) ifite intego nto: gutangaza no kugenzura` INTEGRITY.sig.json`, kwerekana URL zinjira, no gukurikirana ubuzima bwurungano rwa federasiyo.
architecture.h4p2: Mugutangira umugenzuzi agenda inkomoko yinkwi, afite buri dosiye, kandi agereranya nibigaragara. Niba hari hash idahuye umugenzuzi yanze gutangira. Ibi bivuze ko dosiye yangiritse kuri disiki idashobora gutanga `status:" yagenzuwe "`.
architecture.h4p3: Abakiriya bakubise `/ v1 / ubunyangamugayo` mbere yuko bizera node. Niba babonye `status! =" Yagenzuwe "` banze gutanga ibyangombwa, igihe. Ngiyo icyizere.
architecture.h4l1: Yasinywe na `urufunguzo / kurekura.key` (Ed25519). Igice cya kabiri cyatetse mubakiriya barekura.
architecture.h4l2: Kugaragaza ibyanditse: `{inzira, sha256, ingano}` kuri buri dosiye idateganijwe.
architecture.h4l3: Ongera wubake: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Ibisubizo `INTEGRITY.sig.json` mumuzi wa repo.
architecture.h4l4: Kuzunguruka: abakora fork Vortex gusimbuza `kurekura.key`. Abakiriya bagizwe na pubkey yabo noneho bizere iyo fork.
architecture.h5p1: Genda unyuze mugihe Alice yohereje "hi" kuri Bob:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Umukiriya areba hejuru urufunguzo rwicyumba mububiko bwaho. Niba idahari, izana ibahasha nshya kuva `/ api / ibyumba / {id} / urufunguzo` kuri pubkey yayo. Ubwa mbere DMs ikora uruziga rumwe Diffie-Hellman kuri prekeys.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node ibika umurongo nabafana hanze `{ubwoko:" m ", icyumba: ..., msg: {id, ct, nonce, wohereje_pseudo, woherejwe_at}}` kuri buri gihuza WebSocket cyiyandikishije mucyumba.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Umukiriya wa Bob yakira ikadiri, yifungura hamwe nurufunguzo rumwe, agenzura uwohereje pseudo ahuye nabanyamuryango bateganijwe, kandi agatanga igituba.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Umukiriya wa Bob yanditse `POST / api / ibyumba / {id} / soma` hamwe nubutumwa bwanyuma bwo gusoma. Ibyo bikurura `{ubwoko:" r "}` gutangaza kugirango igituba cya Alice cyerekana amatiku.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) birakomeye, binini, kandi byihuse kuri kodegisi. Ugereranije na JSON igabanya ingano yumushahara ~ 30% kuri ciphertext isanzwe iganira kandi ikuraho ikibanza kidasobanutse.
architecture.h6p2: Ugereranije na Protobuf ntabwo bisaba generator ya schema kandi ntabwo ihagarika nimero yumurima. Ibyo bifite akamaro kuko Vortex ihinduka - twongeyeho `thread_id`,` gusubiza_to`, `reaction_count`,` ubwoko 'hejuru yo gusohora tutavunnye abakiriya bashaje.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR nicyo kimenyetso, Matrix, na NIP-29 bakoresha kubwimpamvu zisa cyane. Guhuza ibyo bahisemo bivuze ko protocole yacu yoroshye kugenzurwa nabashakashatsi bashinzwe umutekano basanzwe bazi kodegisi.
architecture.h7p1: Ikadiri yose itwara `v: <int>`. Ibiriho ubu ni 1. Ikadiri ifite verisiyo itazwi iramanuka; abakiriya bandika umuburo kandi bagakomeza hamwe nurwego rukurikira.
architecture.h7p2: Guhuza inyuma byemewe kurwego urwo arirwo rwose rutwara `v: 1`. Guhuza imbere ni byiza-imbaraga: imirima mishya yongewe kumpera yigitekerezo, abakiriya bashaje birengagiza.
architecture.h7p3: Kumeneka gukomeye kubitswe kumpinduka zumutekano (urugero: guhinduranya HKDF imirongo ikurikira). Muri ibyo bihe, verisiyo isimbuka kuri 2 kandi idirishya ryimuka ryasohotse.
architecture.h1_a: Umuyoboro Vortex ugabanyijemo inzira eshatu. Buriwese yiruka wenyine, avugana nabandi akoresheje protocole isobanutse neza, kandi irashobora gusimburwa mubwigenge. Nta monolith ihari - buri kintu kiracomeka muri imwe mu nshingano eshatu.
architecture.h1_b: Umukiriya afite urufunguzo kandi atanga UI. Ipfundo rikomeza ciphertext, abafana hanze ibyabaye hejuru ya WebSocket, hamwe nabakoresha WebRTC ikimenyetso. Umugenzuzi atangaza ibyashyizweho umukono na URL byinjira. Bavugana hejuru ya HTTPS + WebSocket bakoresheje CBOR-yashizwemo imitwaro iri imbere ya AES-GCM ibahasha.
architecture.h1_c: Gutandukana kwatangijwe muri v0.0.3 nyuma yuko verisiyo ya mbere ya monolith ihuye nibibazo bibiri: icyemezo cyo kurekura cyari gifitanye isano na node ikora (bityo rero node yangiritse ishobora kubeshya kode yayo), kandi federasiyo ntiyashobokaga kuko leta ya leta na leta yizeraga yabaga kumeza amwe. Gutandukanya attestation mubikorwa byayo byahaye buri mukoresha igituba kimwe kugirango tumenye kandi reka twemere federasiyo uko bishakiye N.
architecture.h1_f:
umukiriya --HTTPS/WSS -> node
  ^ |
  |                        v
  + ----- / v1 / ubunyangamugayo-- umugenzuzi (umukono ugaragara)
architecture.h2_a: Gutandukanya node / umugenzuzi bitandukanya ibihangano byumutekano cyane (ibimenyetso byashyizweho umukono) uhereye hejuru yibitero binini (API seriveri).
architecture.h2_b: Umugenzuzi abika akantu gato ka SQLite DB: ibyiringiro byizewe, URL indorerwamo, hamwe n amanota yubuzima. Yanze gutangira niba INTEGRITY.sig.json idahuye nigiti kiri kuri disiki - dosiye yahinduwe ntishobora na rimwe gukora `status:" yagenzuwe "`. Ipfundo ikora kuri Postgres / SQLite yonyine kandi ntabwo ifata urufunguzo rwo kurekura.
architecture.h2_c: Igishushanyo kiva mububiko bwa Chrome bwibiti (certs ibaho kumurongo wo gusohora kwa mushakisha, ntabwo inkomoko y'urubuga) hamwe na Debian's Release.gpg (bigaragara ko yashyizweho umukono, paki zidashyizweho umukono). Yemejwe kuko ibishushanyo byombi byarokotse imyaka mirongo isubirwamo.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 kuri buri hop, iherezo-iherezo ryibanga ryuzuye imbere. TLS ikora ubwikorezi; AES-GCM ikora ibirimo.
architecture.h3_b: Hagati yumukiriya nu node: HTTPS (`/ api / *`) na WSS (`/ ws`). Hagati yumutwe: HTTPS (`/ federasiyo / *`). Hagati ya node n'umugenzuzi: HTTPS (`/ v1 / *`). Bose ukoreshe TLS 1.3 hamwe na Chrome 120 igikumwe kugirango urwanye DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Kera Vortex yakoresheje mbisi TCP hamwe na progaramu isanzwe y'urusaku-protocole. Hindura kuri TLS 1.3 muri v0.0.4 nyuma yo kubona ko protocole yihariye yerekana "ishimishije" kubakurikiranira hafi. TLS 1.3 birarambiranye, ahantu hose, na ECH-twiteguye - imitungo itatu twashakaga.
architecture.h3_f:
urwego rwo gutwara: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + utabishaka ECH (RFC 9460)
ibice birimo: AES-256-GCM bifunze imbere CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Ubutumwa bumwe bwo gusohoka bunyura mu ntambwe enye: ikadiri → encrypt → post → umufana hanze.
architecture.h4_b: Umukiriya abara urufunguzo rwicyumba (X25519 + HKDF), ashyiraho ubutumwa nka CBOR, kashe hamwe na AES-256-GCM ukoresheje 96 bit bitunguranye, POSTs kuri `/ api / ibyumba / {id} / ubutumwa`. Node ibika umurongo wa ciphertext hamwe nabafana kuri buri gihuza WebSocket cyiyandikishije mubyumba. Umukiriya wabakiriya afungura hamwe nurufunguzo rumwe. Urugendo-rugendo rwihuta munsi ya ms 50 kuri local4⟫, ~ 120 ms bisanzwe WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Umuyoboro wintambwe enye nimwe Ikimenyetso cyakoreshejwe muri 2014; twahinduye ubwikorezi gusa (WebSocket aho kuba ikimenyetso cya TCP) hamwe na kodegisi (CBOR aho kuba protobuf). Guhuza igishushanyo cyemewe gikubita guhimba bundi bushya.
architecture.h5_a: Twahisemo CBOR hejuru ya JSON na Protobuf nyuma yo kugereranya ingano yimitwaro, ubwihindurize, hamwe na ergonomique yo gukemura kumurimo nyawo wo kuganira.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR itanga ~ 30% umutwaro muto urenze JSON kubutumwa bwa unicode-buremereye, nta mwanya wera udasobanutse, kandi ushyigikira kongerwaho umurima udafite amashanyarazi. Proto yakenera dosiye ya .proto kuri buri gusohora kandi igahagarika nimero yumurima.
architecture.h5_c: Ikimenyetso cyahinduwe kuva protobuf kijya kuri CBOR gisa na 2017 muri izo mpamvu. Matrix ikoresha CBOR murwego rwigihugu-rukemura. CBOR ni IETF bisanzwe (RFC 8949) kandi ururimi rwose twifuza rufite isomero rikuze.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR ingano: ~ 0.7 × JSON kuri utf-8 ivanze
          ~ 1.05 × protobuf kuri gahunda imwe
Ongeraho umurima = umugereka kurangiza. Abakiriya bashaje birengagiza.
architecture.h6_a: Kuki CBOR - igice cyubwubatsi. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
architecture.h6_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Kuki CBOR". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
architecture.h6_c: "Impamvu CBOR" uburyo bwahindutse kuri Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko mugihe buri gice cyaguye nicyabimuteye.
architecture.h7_a: Guhindura protocole - igice cyubwubatsi. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
architecture.h7_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Porotokole verisiyo". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
architecture.h7_c: Uburyo bwa "Porotokole verisiyo" bwahindutse hirya no hino Vortex. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.

crypto.title: Cryptographic primitives
crypto.subtitle: Buri algorithm muri stack, intego yayo, ibipimo byayo, RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex ikoresha gusa urungano rwasubiwemo primitives. Nta cipher yihariye yo guhagarika, nta rugo-rwakuze KDFs, nta gahunda yo gusinya. Iki gice cyandika buri kintu cyambere dukoresha, ibipimo nyabyo, hamwe nimpamvu iri inyuma yo guhitamo.
crypto.h1p1: Gukata25519 (RFC 7748) muburyo bwa Montgomery, ikoreshwa kuri Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. 32-byte urufunguzo rwigenga, 32-byte urufunguzo rusange, 32-byte bisangiwe ibanga risohoka.
crypto.h1p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: static igikoresho kiranga, urufunguzo rwamasomo ya ephemeral, ibahasha yo gusunika ibifunze, urufunguzo rwicyumba cyo gufunga, amabahasha ya federasiyo.
crypto.h1p3: ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya iOS: `Gukata25519.Kwumvikane.PrivateKey` kuva CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` ukoresheje JNI. Node: `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` hejuru ya OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Byose uko ari bitatu bihuza bito-kuri-bito. Urugendo-rugendo rwageragejwe kuri RFC 7748 Alice / Bob ibizamini bya buri nyubako.
crypto.h1p5: Imikorere: ~ 100 µs kuri Diffie-Hellman kuri iPhone 2020, ~ 30 µs kuri Mac ya 2020. Uruziga rw'icyumba-urufunguzo rwo gupfunyika itsinda 200 rigizwe na ms 10 zurukuta-isaha.
crypto.h1p6: Igihe gihoraho: yego, haba mumurongo uhetamye arithmetic hamwe na raw-byte decoding inzira.
crypto.h1p7: Umuyoboro uhagaze: Urwego rwa Montgomery ntirukingirwa icyiciro cyibitero byibasiye umurongo wa Weierstrass; GufunguraSSL na Swift CryptoKit byombi bikoreshe.
crypto.h1p8: Uruhererekane rw'ingenzi: 32-byte nto-endian. Urufunguzo rusange rushyizwe ku bicuruzwa bitumizwa mu mahanga bityo inyongeramusaruro zidakozwe neza ntizitera gahunda-yo-gutemba.
crypto.h1l1: Kuki X25519 kandi atari P-256: byihuse, bito, nta NIST-guta umurongo.
crypto.h1l2: Impamvu 32-byte isohoka ntabwo ari 64: ihuye HKDF-SHA256 uburebure buringaniye.
crypto.h1l3: Impamvu Montgomery ntabwo ari Edwards: dukeneye gusa DH, ntabwo ari umukono, kuribi bikoresho byingenzi. Edwards yakenera intambwe yo guhinduka buri gihe.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) hejuru ya edwards25519. 32-byte urufunguzo rusange, umukono wa 64-byte.
crypto.h2p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: ibyemezo bya node kubutumwa bwa federasiyo, gusohora-urufunguzo rwibanze hejuru yubunyangamugayo bugaragara, bot yohereza umukono, igikoresho kiranga igihe kirekire kuri Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: variant ⟫0⟫ 8032 dukoresha itanga umukono umwe kabiri kubutumwa bumwe + urufunguzo. Apple's CryptoKit kuri iOS 17+ ikoresha RFC 8032bis ihindagurika - byombi biremewe kandi byombi bigenzurwa hamwe na verisiyo isuzumwa.
crypto.h2p4: Igiciro cyo kugenzura: ~ 200 µs kuri modern modern0⟫. Kugenzura neza (`batch_verify ([msg, sig, pk] * N)`) ni ~ 10 × byihuse kumukono.
crypto.h2p5: Imiterere y'umukono: `R || S`, 32 bytes buri umwe, muto-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Guhagararira urufunguzo rusange: 32-byte ifatanye ingingo. Buri gihe bifite ishingiro - nta "ngingo iherezo".
crypto.h2l2: Urufunguzo rwibanze rwerekana: imbuto ya 32-byte. Kwagura scalar ikomoka ku isazi ikoresheje SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Kuki atari ECDSA: ECDSA ikenera ubuziranenge RNG kuri buri mukono; kubogama RNG bisohora urufunguzo rwihariye. Ed25519 ni deterministic, nta RNG ikenewe mugihe cyo gusinya.
crypto.h3p1: AES muri Galois / Uburyo bwa Counter (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-urufunguzo rwa biti, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit yo kwemeza ibimenyetso.
crypto.h3p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: ubutumwa ciphertext ibahasha, amabahasha ya fayili yuzuye, ibanga ryibitse ryibikoresho, ibifuniko byo gusunika bifunze.
crypto.h3p3: Nonce construction: buri butumwa butanga 96-bit bitunguranye nonce. Ipfunyika ikurikirana 10 ^ 6 yanyuma kuri buri cyumba kandi ikamanura duplicates kwirwanaho - umukiriya ntagomba kubyara duplicates mbere, ariko akeka ko ntakintu gihenze.
crypto.h3p4: Kuki 96-bit nonce kandi atari 128-bit: 96 bits nuburebure bwa GCM-bwa "deterministic" butareshya, kandi biduha 2 ^ 32 bidasanzwe mbere yuko guhura kwamavuko biba impungenge. Urufunguzo rwicyumba kimwe ruzunguruka kera mbere yacyo, bityo rero ni umutekano.
crypto.h3p5: Ingano yikimenyetso: byuzuye 128 bits. Ntabwo ducika - kuzigama kubika ni ntangarugero kandi kugabanya byongera impimbano.
crypto.h3l1: Kwihuta kwibyuma: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-Kwagura kode, kugaburira crypto kuri Apple Silicon. Encryption yinjiza ~ 3 GB / s.
crypto.h3l2: Ku bikoresho bishaje ARM bidafite umugereka wa crypto: ~ 300 MB / s ukoresheje software. Biracyihuta kuruta disiki IO.
crypto.h3l3: Amakuru afitanye isano: umutwe wumutwe (`{v, icyumba_id, wohereje_pseudo}`) watanzwe nka AAD kugirango umutwe wimpimbano ntusuzume.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) hamwe na SHA-256. Ikuramo byinshi-byte-s-urufunguzo kuva 32-byte yinjiza.
crypto.h4p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: kugabanya X25519 ibisohoka murufunguzo rwibanga + MAC urufunguzo + umutwe wumutwe; gukuramo imizi ya ratchet urufunguzo rwa Diffie-Hellman; kubaka kuri buri gice cya dosiye urufunguzo ruva mumuzi ya dosiye.
crypto.h4p3: Imirongo yamakuru ihora igena ASCII: `" v1: encryption "`, `" v1: mac "`, "" v1: umutwe "", "" v1: kugarura "`. Guhindura bituma dushobora kuzenguruka urufunguzo rwose dukoresheje amakuru-umugozi uhinduka.
crypto.h4p4: Umunyu ntubishaka. Muri Vortex dukoresha id id icyumba nkumunyu wo gukuramo ibyumba-urufunguzo kuburyo ibyumba bitandukanye bidashobora gukoresha impanuka gukoresha urufunguzo rwakomotse nubwo umusaruro umwe X25519 ugaragara.
crypto.h4l1: Kuki SHA-256 atari SHA-512: urubuga rwose rufite ibyuma SHA-256 kwihuta; SHA-512 irihuta gato kuri 64-bit CPU ariko ntabwo kuri terefone.
crypto.h4l2: Kuki atari KMAC ishingiye kuri KDF: KMAC ni niche. HKDF iri muri buri somero rya crypto dukoresha.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106). Ibipimo: m = 64 MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: seriveri-ijambobanga ryibanga hash (`abakoresha.password_hash`), urufunguzo-rwuzuye rwo gufunga urufunguzo, imbuto-interuro yatumijwe.
crypto.h5p3: Impamvu ibi bipimo: OWASP 2023 ibyifuzo. 64 MiB + 3 itera itwara ~ 0.5 s kuri iPhone X - igikoresho gishyigikiwe cyane. Igitero cya ASIC gifite 100 × ububiko bwagutse bwa terefone buracyakeneye ~ 5 ms kubigerageza. Ijambobanga rirerire (entropy> 40 bits) rihinduka kubara bidashoboka gucika kubipimo.
crypto.h5p4: Imiterere yo kubika: `argon2: <encoded>` aho kodegisi ni RFC-imiterere yumugozi harimo umunyu, kwibuka, gusubiramo, na hash.
crypto.h5l1: Kuki Argon2id atari Argon2i cyangwa Argon2d: 2id ni imvange - pass yambere irwanya imiyoboro-mpande (i-moderi), pass ikurikira irwanya GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Ikimenyetso gikoresha kimwe.
crypto.h5l2: Kugereranya Dummy-hash: niyo mugihe uyikoresha atabaho, turacyakora Argon2 yibinyoma igenzura hamwe na hash ihoraho. Ibi binganya igihe cyo kwinjira kugirango abateye badashobora kubara amazina ukoresha mugihe cyo gusubiza.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash kuri login: niba seriveri ya admin igabanije igiciro cyo kwibuka, hashes ishaje yongeye gukaraba mugihe gikurikira cyo kwinjira. Mu mucyo.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ML-KEM-768. 1184-byte urufunguzo rusange, 1088-byte ciphertext, 32-byte ibanga risangiwe.
crypto.h6p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: Hybrid post-kwant sime urufunguzo. Iyo urungano rwombi rwamamaza Kyber gushyigikira urufunguzo rwamasomo ni `HKDF (x25519_ibisohoka || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Impamvu Hybrid: nubwo Kyber yaje kuvunika (ugereranije ni muto), igice cya X25519 kiracyaturinda. Gukomatanya bitanga ibyiza-byombi.
crypto.h6p4: Kuki Kyber atari abandi bakandida NIST: niyo yatoranijwe kugirango ibe isanzwe. Kuboneka kode ni ngari (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Imikorere: igisekuru cyingenzi ~ 100 µs, encapsulation ~ 30 µs, decapsulation ~ 50 µs. Ntibyoroshye ugereranije nubukererwe bwurugendo.
crypto.h6l2: Umuyoboro mugari: 1088 bytes kumasomo ciphertext, 1184 bytes kurufunguzo rusange. Isomo ryishyuwe kubanza kubonana; nyuma ni zeru.
crypto.h6l3: Uruhande rwa seriveri: `pqcrypto` Python pack hamwe na` kem.ml_kem_768`. Uruhande rwabakiriya: liboqs ikoresheje guhuza urubuga.
crypto.h7p1: Ikimenyetso Cyikubye kabiri (nkuko bigaragara muri rusange rusange ya 2016). Ihuza igipimo cya Diffie-Hellman hamwe numurongo-urufunguzo.
crypto.h7p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: ubutumwa butaziguye hagati yibikoresho bibiri. Ibyumba byamatsinda bikoresha gahunda yoroshye "yohereza urufunguzo" urufunguzo rwumuzi wicyumba.
crypto.h7p3: Ibyiza: ibanga ryimbere (kubangamira igikoresho kigaragaza gusa ubutumwa rumaze kwakira, ntabwo ari ejo hazaza), umutekano nyuma yubwumvikane (kongera gukira nyuma yo kumvikana kwingenzi), gutanga ibicuruzwa (ubutumwa bugera ku 1000 bwo gusimbuka).
crypto.h7p4: Ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryacu riri muri `porogaramu / umutekano / double_ratchet.py` na` ios / Modules / Inkomoko / Ikiganiro / impl / DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru /.../ ikiganiro / impl / DoubleRatchet.kt`.
crypto.h7l1: Uburebure bw'urunigi: ubutumwa 1000 kuri buri munyururu mbere yo kongera guhatirwa. Kugabanya ibyangiritse kuva urufunguzo rwibwe.
crypto.h7l2: Gusimbuka-urufunguzo rwihishwa: kugeza ku 1000 urufunguzo rwo hanze rwabitswe mububiko kuri buri munyururu. Hejuru yibyo ubutumwa bwanze nkibisanzwe.
crypto.h7l3: Umutwe wibanga: ku busanzwe. Umutwe utwara metadata ya ratchet kandi uhishe hamwe nurufunguzo rwabigenewe rwakomotse kumuzi ukoresheje HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Idosiye idasobanutse yerekana ubunyangamugayo nubunyangamugayo ikoresha BLAKE3 kuko iri 10 × yihuta kurusha SHA-256 kuri blobs nini.
crypto.h8p2: Byakoreshejwe kuri: dosiye `sha256` inkingi muri DB (izina ryamateka; mubyukuri BLAKE3 munsi ya hood kuva v0.1.2), kugabanwa kumugereka, kugenzura dosiye-kugenzura ubuziranenge.
crypto.h8p3: Umwanya wumutekano: BLAKE3 irakomeye cyane (256-bit); twita inkingi `sha256` yo kwimuka gusa.
crypto.h9p1: Nonces zose, prekeys, indangagaciro zingirakamaro zitangwa binyuze kuri OS RNG: `SecRandom` kuri iOS,` java.umutekano. UmutekanoRandom` kuri Android, `amabanga.token_bytes` kuri Python (gupfunyika` / dev / urandom` cyangwa bihwanye).
crypto.h9p2: Ntuzigere na rimwe `random.random ()`, ntabwo `Math.random ()`, nta `rand ()`. Amategeko ya Lint abuza gukoresha muri kode ya module.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC kugereranya, kugenzura umukono, ijambo ryibanga hash kugenzura - byose bikoresha igihe-cyambere primitives kugirango wirinde igihe-imiyoboro.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.compare_digest`. Swift: `Umufasha wa ConstantTimeComparison` umufasha. Kotlin: `UbutumwaDigest.isEqual`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 ni elliptike-umurongo Diffie-Hellman hejuru ya Curve25519 muburyo bwa Montgomery. 32-byte urufunguzo, 32-byte ibanga risangiwe. Buri rufunguzo rwigenga / igikoresho gihamye umwirondoro / urufunguzo rwamasomo muri Vortex irayikoresha.
crypto.h1_b: Alice na Bob buriwese afite urufunguzo rwihariye a, b nurufunguzo rusange A = a · G, B = b · G aho G niwo murongo fatizo. Babara s = a · B = b · A. Iri banga risangiwe 32-byte rijya muri HKDF-SHA256 kugirango rikure urufunguzo rwa AES-GCM. Imibare yo gutandukanya ikorwa mugihe gihoraho ukoresheje urwego rwa Montgomery; nta mashami yamakuru yibanga.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 yasohowe na Daniel J. Bernstein mu 2005 itoranywa na IETF muri RFC 7748 (2016). Yemejwe na Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard. Vortex irayikoresha kuko yihuta kurusha P-256, ifite ubunini bwingenzi bwa 32-byte, irinda impungenge NIST, kandi buri platform yohereza mubikorwa bigoye.
crypto.h1_f:
Urufunguzo rwihariye: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes nto-endian)
Urufunguzo rusange: A = a · G (ingingo ya 32-byte ifunitse)
Ibanga risangiwe: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, → HKDF ibyinjijwe)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 ni umukono wa barumuna ba X25519, ukoresheje umurongo umwe muburyo bwahinduwe-Edwards. 32-byte urufunguzo rusange, umukono wa 64-byte, kugena byanze bikunze.
crypto.h2_b: Gusinya ubutumwa m hamwe nurufunguzo rwihariye d: kubara r = SHA-512 (d, m), R = r · G, c = SHA-512 (R, A, m), S = r + c · a. Umukono ni (R, S). Kugenzura: reba R + c · A = S · G. Gushiraho umukono birinda kwirinda kongera gukoresha ibyago - imikono ibiri yubutumwa bumwe nurufunguzo rumwe birasa.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) yasohotse mu mpapuro za Bernstein mu 2011 hamwe na Duif, Lange, Schwabe, na Yang. Byakiriwe cyane nyuma ya 2013. Cry3⟫ ya CryptoKit, Ink2⟫'s Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH byose birabikoresha. Vortex asinyira ibahasha ya federasiyo yose hamwe na attestation ya node hamwe na Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Ikimenyetso (d, m): r = SHA-512 (d∥m);  R = r · G.
              c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  S = r + c · a
              garuka (R, S)

Kugenzura: c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  R + c · A ≟ S · G.
crypto.h3_a: AES muri Galois / Uburyo bwa Counter. Urufunguzo 256-bit, 96-bit bitunguranye, 128-bit yo kwemeza ibimenyetso. Buri kode ifunze muri Vortex ikoresha GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM ikoresha AES muburyo bwa CTR ikabara GHASH hejuru ya ciphertext + AAD ukoresheje urufunguzo rutandukanye rukomoka kurufunguzo rwibanga. Tag = GHASH (AAD, ciphertext) ⊕ AES-CTR (0). Gusiba byongeye kubara GHASH no kugereranya - ikintu cyose bit-flip cyananiwe kugenzura. Ibyuma-byihuta kuri buri kijyambere CPU ukoresheje AES-NI cyangwa ARMv8-Kwagura crypto.
crypto.h3_c: AES yatsinze amarushanwa ya NIST AES mu 2001. GCM yapimwe muri NIST SP 800-38D mu 2007 kandi ni AEAD isanzwe muri TLS 1.3. Vortex itoranya urufunguzo 256-bit nubwo 128-bit yaba ihagije kurwanya abanzi ba kera - gusimbuka kuri 256-bit biduha hafi 128 bits z'umutekano wa nyuma ya kwant munsi ya algorithm ya Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR (k, n, pt)
                          tag = GHASH_h (aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES (k, n∥1)
                          garuka ct∥tag
Kongera gukoresha ⇒ ibanga + ubunyangamugayo bwacitse.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC ishingiye kuri KDF, RFC 5869) ihindura urufunguzo rumwe muri benshi. Ifata ibyinjira-byinshi byinjira hamwe nibiranga imiterere; yohereza 32 bytes kuri label.
crypto.h4_b: Intambwe ebyiri: Gukuramo no Kwagura. Gukuramo = HMAC-SHA256 (umunyu, IKM) → PRK. Kwagura = HMAC-SHA256 (PRK, info∥counter) ihujwe na len bytes. Twifashishije ibi kugirango tugabanye X25519 ibisohoka murufunguzo rwibanga, urufunguzo rwa MAC, nurufunguzo rwumutwe ufite imirongo yamakuru "v1: encryption", "v1: mac", "v1: umutwe".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF yasohowe na Hugo Krawczyk kuri EUROCRYPT 2010 kandi asanzwe ari RFC 5869 muri 2010. Yakoreshejwe na TLS 1.3 kuri gahunda yayo, na Signal for Double Ratchet, na WireGuard kugirango urufunguzo rwamasomo. Guhindura mumirongo yamakuru atwemerera kuzenguruka urwego rwose rwibanze dukubita "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256 (umunyu, IKM)
T (i) = HMAC-SHA256 (PRK, T (i-1) ∥ amakuru ∥ i)
OKM = T (1) ∥ T (2) ∥… yagabanijwe kuri len bytes
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id ni ijambo ryibanga-ryibanga ryibanga ryashizweho kugirango rirwanye GPU na ASIC. Ibipimo m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id ivanga Argon2i (irwanya imiyoboro yo kuruhande idashamiye kumakuru akomoka ku ijambo ryibanga) hamwe na Argon2d (yuzuza ububiko butateganijwe kuburyo ibyuma bisa ntibishobora guca inguni). Igice cya mbere-pass ni data-yigenga (i-mode); ibisigaye ni amakuru-ashingiye (d-mode). Amasegonda 0.5 yo kubara kuri iPhone X ku bipimo byacu, hafi ms 5 kuri ASIC - umuvuduko ~ 100 × ni muto ugereranije na SHA-256 hashes hashingiwe aho ASICs itsindira 1 000 000 ×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 yatsindiye amarushanwa yo gusohora ijambo ryibanga rya 2015 yateguwe na Dmitry Khovratovich na Alex Biryukov. Bisanzwe nka RFC 9106 muri 2021. Byakoreshejwe na 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Ibipimo bya Vortex biva mubyifuzo bya OWASP 2023, byateganijwe kugirango winjire mubikoresho byacu bidashyigikiwe cyane (iPhone X) munsi yisegonda 1.
crypto.h5_f:
igiciro (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) ≈ 0.5 s kuri iPhone X.
igiciro cyabateye: m × t × (p / igitero_ibintu bisa)
Kuri 10¹⁰ gukeka / s hamwe na 40-bit ijambo ryibanga entropy:
  Amasegonda 10¹² = imyaka 32 000
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) nuburyo bwa NIST-busanzwe nyuma ya kwant urufunguzo rwibanze. Itanga kwant-umutekano yamasomo urufunguzo hamwe na X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice atanga (pk, sk). Bob yita Encapsulate (pk) → (c, ss); Yohereje c kuri Alice. Alice yita Decapsulate (sk, c) → ss. Impande zombi ubu zisangiye ss, ibanga rya 32-byte. Umutekano ugabanuka kubibazo bya Module-LWE, byizerwa kwant-bigoye. Turabihuza na X25519: session_key = HKDF (x25519_ibisohoka ∥ kyber_ibisohoka). Niba kimwe cya kabiri kirokotse, isomo rirakora.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber yatoranijwe na NIST muri Nyakanga 2022 nyuma yimyaka 6 amarushanwa. Bisanzwe nka FIPS 203 muri Kanama 2024. bishobotse kubisanzwe byishyuwe, hitamo ahandi. Uburyo bwa Hybrid bwasabwe na Signal muri 2023 kandi bwemezwa na Chrome muri 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1} ²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1} ²⁵⁶
icyiciro cya Hybrid = HKDF (x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info = "isomo-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Ikimenyetso cya Double Ratchet itanga ibanga ryambere hamwe numutekano nyuma yo kumvikana kubiganiro 1: 1.
crypto.h7_b: Iminyururu ibiri: urunigi rwohereza nu munyururu wo kwakira. Buri butumwa buteza imbere urunigi rwabwo binyuze kuri HKDF. Inshuro nyinshi cyane igipimo cya Diffie-Hellman giteza imbere umuzi, wongeye gufungura iminyururu yombi. Kwiyunga k'urufunguzo rw'urunigi byerekana gusa ubutumwa bwabitswe neza. Nyuma ya DH igipimo, ubutumwa buzaza ni umutekano nubwo uwagabye igitero yibye urufunguzo rwumunyururu.
crypto.h7_c: Byakozwe na Trevor Perrin na Moxie Marlinspike mu 2013, byoherejwe muri Signal 2014, byemejwe na WhatsApp (2016), Ibiganiro By’ibanga rya Facebook, Ibiganiro byihariye bya Skype. Rusange rusange muri 2016. Vortex ishyirwa mubikorwa ni icyambu kiziguye; guhuza nabandi bakiriya ba Signal-protocole iri kumurongo wa v0.4.
crypto.h7_f:
ohereza: CK = HKDF (CK, "intambwe");  MK = HKDF (CK, "msg")
yakira: CK '= HKDF (CK', "intambwe"); MK '= HKDF (CK', "msg")
DH igipimo: RK, CK = HKDF (DH (ibyacu_eph, ibyabo_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 gushing kumadosiye - igice cyibanga. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
crypto.h8_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "BLAKE3 gukaraba dosiye". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
crypto.h8_c: Uburyo bwa "BLAKE3 hashing for dosiye" bwahindutse kuri Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko mugihe buri gice cyaguye nicyabimuteye.
crypto.h9_a: Igisekuru gisanzwe - igice cyibanga. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
crypto.h9_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Umubare wimibare isanzwe". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
crypto.h9_c: Uburyo bwa "Umubare wimibare isanzwe" byahindutse Vortex bisohoka. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.
crypto.h10_a: Ibikorwa bihoraho - igice cyibanga. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
crypto.h10_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Ibikorwa bihoraho". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
crypto.h10_c: Uburyo bwa "Constant-time operations" bwagiye buhinduka kuri Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.

cryptoWire.title: Imiterere ya wire
cryptoWire.subtitle: Imiterere ya byte kuri buri kodegisi.
cryptoWire.intro: Iki gice cyerekana bytes kuri wire. Umuntu wese ushyira mubikorwa undi mukiriya cyangwa igikoresho cya forensics arashobora gusoma hamwe.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Imiterere: `{v: 1, nonce: <12-byte hex>, ciphertext: <variable hex>, ohereza_pseudo: <32-hex>, yoherejwe_at: <unix_ms>}`. Yoherejwe hejuru ya HTTPS (POST) na WebSocket (ubwoko bwikadiri `m`).
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` ibirimo nyuma ya AES-GCM decryption: CBOR` {v: 1, inyandiko?: <string>, imigereka ?: [<file_id>,…], gusubiza_to?:
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag iri inyuma: `ciphertext` byte umugozi ni (ibanga ryishyurwa ryuzuye || 16-byte tag). Umukiriya yigabanyijemo uburebure.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: inyuguti ntoya ya hex icyumba id yatanzwe nkamakuru ajyanye. Guhambira icyumba id birinda kwambukiranya icyumba.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Idosiye yumuzi urufunguzo ni 32 bytes. Urufunguzo kuri buri gice: `HKDF (umuzi, amakuru:" dosiye: igice: "+ <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Igice ciphertext: AES-GCM hamwe nurufunguzo rwa buri gice, rudasanzwe 96-bit nonce, AAD: `<file_id> || <offset> `. Ingano nini ya 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Ubudakemwa bwa dosiye yose: umukiriya abara BLAKE3 hejuru yinyandiko kandi yohereza nka `plaque_blake3` kubakiriye binyuze mubutumwa bwicyumba. Uwakiriye yongeye kubara nyuma yo gukuramo no kugenzura.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Iyo gusunika bikwiye, node itanga urufunguzo rwa X25519, ikora DH hamwe na `p256dh_pub`, ikuramo urufunguzo AES-GCM ikoresheje HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Ikimenyetso gifunze: `{iherezo, p256dh: ububiko bwabakiriya, auth: 16 bytes, data: ciphertext || tag}`. APNs / FCM reba gusa "data".
cryptoWire.h3p4: Umukiriya yandika kubakira akoresheje urufunguzo rwihariye na `p256dh` (mubyukuri ni pode ya ephemeral node mu ibahasha).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Ijambobanga rikura urufunguzo rwo gusubira inyuma ukoresheje Argon2id (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, umunyu = <random 16B>, hashLen = 32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{umunyu, nonce, ciphertext}`. Ciphertext ni CBOR ya `{v: 1, ibyumba: [{id, urufunguzo, ct_refs} ...], umwirondoro: {...}, umubano: [...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Yabitswe haba mu karere (iCloud / Google Drive) cyangwa kuri node mucyumba cyumukoresha.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Ubutumwa bwambukiranya imipaka: `{isoko_node: <pubkey>, intego_user: <id>, imbere: {... kimwe n'ibahasha y'ibyumba ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` ikubiyemo CBOR-ikurikiranye` {isoko_node, intego_user, imbere} `. Intego igenzura kurwanya `isoko_node` pubkey kuva` kwizerwa_node`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Ubutumwa bw'icyumba kimwe kuri wire ni CBOR itegeko rifite imizigo ibitswe, nonce, izina ry'abohereje, hamwe na timestamp. Ibahasha irasa niba igenda HTTPS (POST) cyangwa WebSocket (ubwoko bwikadiri `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Umukiriya akurikirana ubutumwa bwumubiri `{v: 1, inyandiko, gusubiza_to, woherejwe_at}` nka CBOR → `pt`. Kubyara 12-byte idasanzwe. Kubara `aad = hex (icyumba_id)`. Hamagara `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (icyumba_key, nonce, pt, aad)`. Gupfunyika muri `{v: 1, ciphertext: hex (ct), nonce: hex (nonce), ohereza_pseudo: hex (pseudo), yoherejwe_at: unix_ms}` kandi yohereza. Uwakiriye agenzura GCM tag mugihe cyo gufungura, hanyuma CBOR -kugereranya neza.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Imiterere y'insinga ni verisiyo-yashizweho kuva v0.0.4 nyuma yo gukuramo inda v0.0.3 itagira `v` umurima - twagombaga guhitisha format yose mugihe twongeyeho` thread_id` kuko abakiriya bashaje bakoze impanuka kurufunguzo rutazwi. Isomo ryize: buri shusho yimigozi izaza itwara `v: N` mumwanya wambere rero guhuza neza biragaragara.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Amadosiye yacitsemo ibice binini-binini, buri kimwe gifite urufunguzo rwacyo rukomoka kumuzi ya dosiye hamwe na offset ya chunk. Kuri buri kodegisi ireka uwayohereje aruhuke / asubire kumupaka uwo ariwo wose.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Idosiye yumuzi urufunguzo ni 32 bytes. Urufunguzo kuri buri gice ni `HKDF (umuzi, amakuru =" dosiye: igice: "+ str (offset), len = 32)`. Igice cyose ni AES-GCM gihishe hamwe nurufunguzo rwacyo, rudasanzwe 96-bit nonce, na `aad = dosiye_id ∥ offset`. Uduce duto kuri 512 KiB; 4 MiB cap. Idosiye yuzuye BLAKE3 yoherejwe nka `plaque_blake3` mubutumwa bwicyumba bwerekana dosiye kugirango abayakiriye basuzume nyuma yo gufungura.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption hamwe nurufunguzo rwa buri gice yatangijwe na Mega.nz mumwaka wa 2013 kandi inonosorwa ninkunga nini ya Signal nini muri 2019. Twagerageje 256/512/1024/4096 KiB na 512 niho hantu heza mubipimo byacu.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Ibahasha ifunze ibahasha ihisha imenyekanisha ryo kwishyurwa kuva Apple / Google / Mozilla mugusobora ukoresheje urufunguzo rwihariye X25519.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Abakiriya bandika `p256dh_pub` na` auth` kuri node. Iyo gusunika bigomba, node ikora ephemeral-ECDH hamwe na p256dh_pub, ikuramo urufunguzo + nonce ikoresheje HKDF hamwe nibanga rya auth nkumunyu. Shishoza `{umutwe, umubiri, icyumba_id, ubutumwa_id}` hamwe na AES-GCM. Kohereza inyandiko nkibisobanuro bya `data` umurima kubasunika. Kwagura ibikoresho byongeye gukuramo, gufungura, guhindura.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Gusunika bifunze ni Urubuga rwihuta rwubutumwa bwibanga (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple yabyemeje muri iOS 16 yo Kumenyesha Serivisi. Mbere yo gufunga gufunga byashyigikiwe cyane, Signal na WhatsApp bohereje bucece "ikintu cyageze" ping idafite ibirimo kandi porogaramu isaba ubutumwa kubyuka - byatinze. Gusunika bifunze biduha kurangiza-kurangiza ubuzima bwite wongeyeho gutanga ako kanya.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob ireka uyikoresha agarura urufunguzo rwicyumba + umwirondoro + muminsi 90 ishize kubikoresho bishya bivuye ijambo ryibanga ryonyine.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Urufunguzo rwibanze rukomoka ku ijambo ryibanga ukoresheje Argon2id hamwe nu munyu wa 16-byte. Kwishura ni CBOR: `{v: 1, ibyumba: [{id, urufunguzo, msg_ref_ids}], umwirondoro, imibonano}`. Byabitswe hamwe na AES-GCM munsi y'urufunguzo rukomoka. Yabitswe haba mugace (iCloud / Google Drive) cyangwa nka dosiye mubyumba byumukoresha byihariye. Kugarura: andika ijambo ryibanga → Argon2id → gufungura → reimport urufunguzo.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Imiterere yatanzwe kuri 1Password ya OPVault (2013) hamwe na Bitwarden yoherejwe mu ibanga (2017). Byombi ukoreshe KDF-hanyuma-AEAD hamwe na metadata yuzuye umunyu. Vortex hiyongereyeho iminsi 90 yo kugabanya kuko amateka yuzuye yabitswe yari 100 MB + mugupima; ubwinshi bwokugarura bukeneye gusa ubutumwa bwa vuba, kandi ibirimo bishaje biracyagerwaho hifashishijwe seriveri ciphertext mugihe uyikoresha afite umurongo.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Ubutumwa bwa federasiyo yambukiranya ibahasha yimbere-ibanga mu ibahasha yo hanze yasinywe yemeza inkomoko.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A serialises {{isoko_node, intego_user, imbere_ct, imbere_nonce, yoherejwe_at} `nka CBOR. Ibimenyetso hamwe na Ed25519 yacyo urufunguzo rwo kurekura → `sig`. POSTs `{ibahasha, sig}` to node B's `/ federasiyo / gutanga`. B igenzura `sig` kurwanya pubkey ya` source_node` muri `federasiyo ', igenzura igihe cyagenwe mumadirishya yiminota 5, hanyuma ikandika ciphertext yimbere kumeza yacyo' ubutumwa 'kubakoresha intego.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Ibahasha yo hanze yasinywe yatijwe muri federasiyo ya Matrix (2015) hamwe na ActivityPub umukono HTTP (2018). Idirishya ryiminota 5 rihuye nibyifuzo bya SMTP RFC 5321 kandi birinda gusubiramo ibitero aho uwagabye igitero yafashe federasiyo imwe POST akabisubiramo nyuma yamasaha. Vortex yahisemo Ed25519 hejuru ya RSA-PSS kuko umukono wa Ed25519 ni 64 bytes vs RSA-PSS-2048 ya 256 bytes - ibintu iyo federasiyo iganira.

auth.title: Kwemeza
auth.subtitle: Iyandikishe, injira, kugarura, gukuraho. JWT + X25519 + guhitamo passkey / imbuto / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex itanga igihe gito JWTs (15 min kwinjira, iminsi 30 igarura) hamwe nurufunguzo rwumukoresha X25519 urufunguzo rusange. Iki gice gikubiyemo ibintu byose bitangirira kumpera.
auth.h1p1: Umukiriya atangira kubyara 32-byte X25519 urufunguzo rwihariye hamwe na OS RNG. Ikuramo urufunguzo rusange, ikora nka 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Umukiriya yanditse `POST / api / kwemeza / kwiyandikisha` hamwe na` {izina ryumukoresha, ijambo ryibanga, x25519_public_key, kwerekana_izina, terefone, imeri, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?} `.
auth.h1p3: Node iremeza: izina ryumukoresha rihuye `^ [a-z0-9 _] {3,30} $` (inyuguti nto kugirango wirinde gusebanya); ijambo ryibanga rinyuramo zxcvbn-imiterere yimbaraga (minota 2); terefone ihuye na E.164 niba yatanzwe; imeri ihuye RFC 5322 regex yibanze niba yatanzwe.
auth.h1p4: Kugenzura node "x25519_public_key` idasanzwe - buri pubkey irashobora kwiyandikisha neza kuri konti imwe. Ibi bihagarika ibitero byinshi byo kwiyandikisha bikoresha igituba kimwe.
auth.h1p5: Node ikoresha Argon2id ku ijambo ryibanga (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) ikabika `argon2: $ ... $` muri `abakoresha.password_hash`.
auth.h1p6: Node yerekana JWT ebyiri: kwinjira (15 min, `jti: <device_id>`) no kugarura (30 d). Ibisabwa: `{sub: umukoresha_id, jti: igikoresho_id, andika: kwinjira | kugarura, exp: ...}`. Yasinywe HS256 hejuru ya 64-byte ya seriveri ibanga yakuwe muri `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node ikora `umukoresha_ibikoresho` umurongo:` {umukoresha_id, igikoresho_id, umukoresha_agent, yaremye_at} `. Buri gashya kahujwe nigikoresho cyacyo_id; gukuraho igikoresho cyica uwo mugezi gusa.
auth.h1p8: Igisubizo: `{ok, umukoresha_id, izina ryumukoresha, kwinjira_token, kugarura_vugwa, x25519
auth.h1p9: Umukiriya abika ibimenyetso muri Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite = Cookies zikomeye (urubuga).
auth.h1l1: Igipimo ntarengwa: Kwiyandikisha 5 kumasegonda 60 kuri IP. TESTING = ukuri guhagarika ibi.
auth.h1l2: Uburyo bwo gutumira: niba `REGISTRATION_MODE = ubutumire`, umubiri ugomba gushyiramo` invite_code` yemewe. Kode ikorwa binyuze kuri admin API.
auth.h1l3: Uburyo bufunze: `REGISTRATION_MODE = ifunze`. Gusa umuyobozi wimbuto ashobora kwiyandikisha. Abakoresha bakurikira bahagera binyuze mubutumire mubyumba byihariye.
auth.h2p1: Abakiriya banditse `POST / api / kwemeza / kwinjira` hamwe na` {izina ryukoresha, ijambo ryibanga} `.
auth.h2p2: Node ibaza `abakoresha` ukoresheje izina rito. Niba itabonetse, iracyakora dummy Argon2 igenzura kurwanya hash guhoraho kugirango bangane igihe (~ 0.5 s inzira zombi).
auth.h2p3: Niba Argon2 igenzura neza kandi konte ntigihagarikwa, node isubiza ibahasha imwe nkiyandikisha. Hashyizweho umurongo mushya "ukoresha_ibikoresho"; imirongo ihari isigaye yonyine kugirango uyikoresha ashobore kwinjira mubikoresho byinshi.
auth.h2p4: Niba kugenzura binaniwe, node isubiza 401 hamwe na `{ikosa:" ibyangombwa bitemewe "}`. Nta tandukaniro riri hagati y "izina ryukoresha nabi" n "ijambo ryibanga ritari ryo" mugusubiza.
auth.h2l1: Igipimo ntarengwa: 10 byananiye kugerageza kumasegonda 60 kuri IP. Kurenza kugaruka 429 hamwe na `Gerageza-Nyuma` umutwe.
auth.h2l2: Gufunga konti: 20 byananiye kugerageza muri 24 h ibendera rya konte yo gusuzuma admin. Abakoresha byemewe gusa ijambo ryibanga-gusubiramo inzira zabo.
auth.h2l3: Gukurikirana amasomo: `/ api / kwemeza / ibikoresho` urutonde rwibikorwa byose; umukoresha arashobora gukuraho icyaricyo cyose.
auth.h3p1: Iyo ikimenyetso cyo kwinjira kiri hafi kurangira (abakiriya bakurikirana `exp` mugace) cyangwa mugihe icyifuzo gisubije 401 hamwe na` token yarangiye`, umukiriya ashyiraho `POST / api / kwemeza / kugarura` hamwe na` {refresh_token} `.
auth.h3p2: Node yanga kugarura ubuyanja, igenzura `jti` iracyahari muri` user_devices` (itavanyweho), igenzura `exp`, ikanashiraho ikimenyetso gishya cyo kwinjira.
auth.h3p3: Kuvugurura kuzenguruka byanze bikunze. Gushoboza hamwe na `ROTATE_REFRESH = ukuri` kugirango utange agashya nanone.
auth.h3p4: Niba kuvugurura byarangiye, byahagaritswe, cyangwa byahimbwe, node igaruka 401. Umukiriya asohoka mugace kandi agasaba kongera kwinjira.
auth.h4p1: Abakiriya b'urubuga barashobora kwandikisha urubuga rwemeza (Gukoraho ID, Isura ID, Windows Mwaramutse, biometrike ya Android). Seriveri ibika `{ibyangombwa_id, rusange_key, konte}`.
auth.h4p2: Injira: `POST / api / kwemeza / passkey / gutangira` → seriveri igaruka ikibazo; umukiriya asinyana na passkey yihariye (ifashwe muri Enclave Yizewe / TPM); `POST / api / kwemeza / passkey / kurangiza` → seriveri igenzura nibibazo JWT.
auth.h4p3: Kugenzura monotonicity kugenzura: buri verisiyo igomba kongera konte. Niba atari byo, passkey ifatwa nka clon ikangwa.
auth.h5p1: Ninzira yo kugarura ibiza, uyikoresha arashobora kohereza hanze ijambo-24-imbuto. Kuzana ibicuruzwa kubikoresho byose byubaka X25519 indangamuntu (imbuto → HKDF → urufunguzo ruhamye) kandi byerekana ko ufite binyuze mukibazo cyashyizweho umukono.
auth.h5p2: Imbuto ntizigera zisiga igikoresho. Ipfundo gusa ibona X25519 urufunguzo rusange hamwe n'umukono hejuru ya seriveri.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 bits (32 bytes). BIP-39 chequeum isanzwe, amakosa rero arafatwa mbere yo kugera kuri seriveri.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) hamwe na 30-s intambwe na kode 6. Guhitamo kuri buri mukoresha.
auth.h6p2: Kwiyandikisha: `POST / api / kwemeza / 2fa / setup` isubiza ibanga + otpauth URI + QR. Umukoresha scan hamwe na Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Ijambo ryibanze. Abakoresha basubiza inyuma kode 6 yimibare kugirango yerekane imikorere ya porogaramu.
auth.h6p3: Injira hamwe na 2FA: nyuma yibanga ryibanga, node igaruka `{ikeneye_2fa: ukuri}`. Umukiriya abaza kode hamwe namakuru kuri `/ api / kwemeza / kwinjira / 2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Igipimo ntarengwa: 5 TOTP kugerageza kuminota 5 kumukoresha. Kurenga bikurura 60-amasegonda akonje hamwe no kuburira imeri.
auth.h6p5: Kode yububiko: 12 × 10-code yimibare yerekanwe rimwe mukwiyandikisha. Buri kode irashobora gukoreshwa inshuro imwe.
auth.h7p1: Terefone yinjiye irashobora kwinjirira tablet nshya ifite code ya QR. Igikoresho Inyandiko `POST / api / kwemeza / qr / gutangira` → seriveri isubiza nonce na TTL.
auth.h7p2: Igikoresho A cyerekana QR kirimo `nonce + umukoresha_id + seriveri_url`. Igikoresho B gisikana kandi cyanditse `POST / api / kwemeza / qr / kugenzura` hamwe na nonce.
auth.h7p3: Seriveri igenzura nonce ikiri nzima (TTL 60 s, isasu rimwe), guhuza igikoresho B gishya X25519 pubkey kuri konte yumukoresha A (umurongo mushya wa `user_devices`), hanyuma igasubiza JWT kubikoresho B.
auth.h7p4: Igikoresho A cyakira WebSocket imenyesha `{ubwoko:" n ", ibyabaye:" ibishya_ibikoresho "}` kugirango umukoresha abashe kwemeza / gukuraho mugihe nyacyo.
auth.h8p1: Turasubiza nkana ikosa rimwe kuri "izina ryumukoresha utazwi" na "ijambo ryibanga ritari ryo". Igipimo cyo kwiyandikisha kigabanya guhisha amazina ukoresha.
auth.h8p2: Umwirondoro wanyuma (`/ api / abakoresha / {ukoresha izina}`) bisaba auth. Igitero ntigishobora kubara amazina y'abakoresha nta kimenyetso cyemewe.
auth.h8p3: Igipimo ntarengwa kuri `/ api / kwemeza / kwinjira 'bituma imbaraga zikaze zigenda.
auth.h1_a: Kwiyandikisha birema indangamuntu nshya: X25519 keypair ku gikoresho, ijambo ryibanga rya Argon2id hash kuri seriveri, JWT couple yatanzwe kubitsinzi.
auth.h1_b: Intambwe ya 1: umukiriya akora `crypto.randomBytes (32)` kuri X25519 urufunguzo rwigenga, rukura urufunguzo rusange (~ 100 µs kuri terefone). Intambwe ya 2: POST / api / kwemeza / kwiyandikisha hamwe na `{izina ryukoresha, ijambo ryibanga, x25519_abaturage_byerekana, kwerekana_izina, terefone, imeri, avatar_emoji}`. Intambwe ya 3: node yemewe ikoresheje Pydantic (izina ryukoresha regex, ijambo ryibanga ≥ 8 chars, terefone E.164, imeri RFC-5322-lite). Intambwe ya 4: node ikoresha Argon2id (ijambo ryibanga) → `argon2: ...`, ibika muri `abakoresha.password_hash`. Intambwe ya 5: ibibazo byibanze kugera JWT (15 min) + kugarura JWT (iminsi 30), bikomeza umurongo wa `user_devices`.
auth.h1_c: Urujya n'uruza ni ubwihindurize bugezweho bwa PHP mysql_real_escape_string era. Buri auth igezweho - Auth0, Firebase, Supabase - ikora hafi iyi shusho. Impinduka zihariye muri Vortex zohereza X25519 pubkey mu guhamagarwa kwiyandikisha: bivuze ko konte ihujwe n’igihe kirekire E2E indangamuntu kuva kumurongo wa mbere, ntabwo yongeyeho nyuma. Ahumekewe na Signal ya 2013 igishushanyo mbonera.

POST / api / kwemeza / kwiyandikisha
