auth.h2_a: Injira igenzura ijambo ryibanga kuri Argon2 yabitswe kandi igatanga fresh0⟫ nshya niba ihuye.
auth.h2_b: POST / api / kwemeza / kwinjira hamwe na `{izina ryukoresha, ijambo ryibanga}`. Node ibaza `abakoresha` ukoresheje izina rito. Niba bibonetse, igenzura Argon2id mugihe gihoraho kurwanya `abakoresha.password_hash`. Niba itabonetse, iracyayobora Argon2 igenzura kugenzura umugozi uhoraho kugirango bangane igihe. Intsinzi → shyashya JWT couple + shyashya `umukoresha_devices` umurongo (umwe mubikoresho byinjiye). Kunanirwa → 401 hamwe n "" ibyangombwa bitemewe "- nta tandukanyirizo riri hagati yizina ryibanga ryibanga ryibanga, kugirango wirinde kubarwa.
auth.h2_c: Kugenzura buri gihe hamwe na dummy hashing kubakoresha bataboneka nicyitegererezo Ikimenyetso cyemejwe mumwaka wa 2014 nyuma yuko abashakashatsi berekanye ibarura ryigihe cyo kwinjira. Kuva icyo gihe byemewe cyane - django-axe, authelia, Keycloak byose birabikoresha. Imyitozo yongeraho ~ 0.5 s kuri buri kintu cyatsinzwe cyo kugerageza, nibyiza; twipima-imipaka yinjira kuri 10 / min / IP uko byagenda kose.

auth.h3_a: Ibimenyetso byinjira birangira nyuma yiminota 15. Kuvugurura guhanahana igihe kirekire kugirango ushireho ikimenyetso gishya utongeye gusaba umukoresha ijambo ryibanga.
auth.h3_b: Abakiriya bakurikirana `exp` mugace. Iyo `ubu + 30s> exp`, cyangwa mugihe icyifuzo gisubije 401 hamwe na` token_expired`, umukiriya POSTs ikimenyetso gishya kuri `/ api / kwemeza / kugarura`. Node decode, igenzura `jti` iri muri` user_devices` kandi ntabwo `yakuweho_at`, igenzura` exp`, ikanashiraho ikimenyetso gishya cyiminota 15. Kuvugurura guhinduranya ni opt-in ukoresheje `ROTATE_REFRESH = ukuri` - kuzimya kubwa mbere kuko guhinduranya ibimenyetso bishya kuri buri rugendo rushya bitera irushanwa mugihe abakiriya babiri bashya icyarimwe.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) yashyizeho uburyo bwo gutandukana + kugarura ubuyanja. Ubuzima bwiminota 15 burigihe ni median muruganda - Google ikoresha isaha 1, Auth0 isanzwe kumasaha 24, Okta kugeza kumasaha 1. Twahisemo 15 min kugirango tugabanye idirishya mugihe ibimenyetso byibwe bifite akamaro. Iminsi 30 yo kugarura ihuye nibyo porogaramu zigendanwa nyinshi zikenera kugirango abakoresha binjire mugihe cyukwezi kudakora.
auth.h4_a: Kwinjira WebAuthn / passkey ikoresha urubuga rwemeza (Gukoraho ID, Isura ID, Windows Mwaramutse, biometrike ya Android) aho gukoresha ijambo ryibanga.
auth.h4_b: Kwiyandikisha: seriveri ishyiraho ikibazo; umukiriya wemeza umukiriya atanga urufunguzo rushya imbere yumutekano wacyo kandi rwohereza urufunguzo rusange + attestation. Seriveri ibika `{ibyangombwa_id, rusange_key, konte}`. Injira: `POST / api / kwemeza / passkey / gutangira` → seriveri isubiza ikibazo; umukiriya asinyisha hamwe nurufunguzo rwibanze rwemeza (rufashwe muri Enclave Yizewe, ntiruva muri chip); `POST / api / kwemeza / passkey / kurangiza` → seriveri igenzura umukono ku rufunguzo rusange rubitswe. Imashini ya monotonic itahura abemeza clon.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn yashyizweho na W3C muri 2019 nyuma yimyaka myinshi yakozwe na FIDO Ihuriro. Apple yongeyeho inkunga-yemewe muri iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Ijambo ryibanze ryakurikiye. Vortex yemeye WebAuthn muri v0.0.8. Nubushake ariko birasabwa cyane - abakoresha passkey ntibigera babona gufata konti ishingiye kuburobyi kuko urufunguzo rwigenga ntirurenga imipaka yibikoresho.
auth.h5_a: Imbuto-interuro kugarura byubaka X25519 indangamuntu kubikoresho bishya bivuye kumagambo 24 BIP-39 mnemonic. Ntukigere usaba seriveri gufata ibikoresho byose.
auth.h5_b: Umukoresha yanditse mnemonic mugitangira cyambere (bidashoboka, inshuro imwe). Kugarura: ku gikoresho gishya, umukoresha yinjira mnemonic; umukiriya akoresha PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (mnemonic, "mnemonic", 2048 kuzenguruka) → 64 bytes yimbuto. Imbuto ya mbere 32 bytes ihinduka X25519 urufunguzo rwihariye; urufunguzo rusange rukomoka. Seriveri ibwirwa gusa urufunguzo rushya rusange; igenzura gutunga hamwe na Ed25519 ikibazo-igisubizo (cyashyizweho umukono nonce), hanyuma gitanga JWTs.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Igitekerezo cyo Gutezimbere Bitcoin 39, 2013) nuburyo bwemewe bwo gushira amabanga ya kriptografiya nkurutonde rwamagambo atazibagirana. 2048-ijambo ryicyongereza inkoranyamagambo hamwe na 4-byte cheque yanyuma. Vortex ikoresha amagambo 24 kubera ko inganda zinganda zikoreshwa mumutekano muke (Trezor, Ledger) ni 24. Amagambo 12 yaba ahagije kubwumutekano wa biti 128 ariko ntibisa nkibihagije kubakoresha benshi.
auth.h5_f:
amagambo = BIP39_Encode (entropy = 256_bits + 8_bit_checksum)
imbuto = PBKDF2-SHA512 (amagambo, "mnemonic", kuzenguruka = 2048, len = 64)
sk = imbuto [0:32] // X25519 wenyine
pk = sk · G // X25519 rusange
auth.h6_a: Kwemeza ibintu bibiri byongera igihe-ijambo ryibanga rimwe (TOTP) intambwe nyuma yo kugenzura ijambo ryibanga.
auth.h6_b: Kwiyandikisha: `POST / api / kwemeza / 2fa / setup` → seriveri itanga ibanga rya 160 bit bitunguranye, ikabisubiza nkumugozi32 shingiro + otpauth: // URI kuri QR gusikana. Umukoresha scan hamwe na Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password; ohereza inyuma icyitegererezo 6-kode yerekana kwerekana gushiraho. Injira: nyuma yibanga ryibanga, seriveri isubiza `{ibikenewe_2fa: ukuri}` aho kuba JWTs. Umukiriya abaza kode yimibare 6 na POSTs `/ api / kwemeza / kwinjira / 2fa`. Seriveri igenzura HOTP (ibanga, T = ubu_unix / 30) kurwanya kode.
auth.h6_c: TOTP yapimwe nka RFC 6238 muri 2011 na Mark Pei. Mbere yibyo, RSA SecurID yakoresheje algorithm yihariye; nyuma, buri porogaramu ya 2FA yatuye kuri TOTP. Intambwe ya 30-isegonda 30 nuburebure bwimibare 6 ni RFC isanzwe. Kode yububiko (12 × 10-mibare, yerekanwe rimwe) yatijwe mubishushanyo bya GitHub guhera 2012.
auth.h6_f:
ibanga = rand (20 bytes) // bits 160 kuri RFC 6238
TOTP (ibanga, t) = HOTP (ibanga, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP (k, c) = guhagarika (HMAC-SHA1 (k, c)) mod 10⁶

idirishya: step 1 intambwe yihanganira isaha yo kuguruka
auth.h7_a: QR kwinjira byombi igikoresho gishya muri konti iriho utongeye kwandika ijambo ryibanga. Terefone imaze kwinjira-isinyira nonce igikoresho gishya gikoresha mukwemeza.
auth.h7_b: Igikoresho Inyandiko `/ api / kwemeza / qr / gutangira`. Seriveri itanga 128-bit nonce hamwe na TTL 60s, ikayihuza na A ukoresha_id, ikagarura. A yerekana nonce yashizweho nka QR (ikubiyemo `nonce + user_id + server_url`). Igikoresho B gisikana, inyandiko `/ api / kwemeza / qr / kugenzura` hamwe na nonce. Seriveri: bidafite ishingiro kandi rimwe? Associate B nshya X25519 pubkey hamwe nu mukoresha_id (umurongo mushya wa "user_devices"), mint JWTs ya B. Igikoresho A yakira WebSocket imenyesha kugirango uyikoresha abone kandi ahitemo.
auth.h7_c: QR ishingiye ku guhuza byamenyekanye bwa mbere na WhatsApp Urubuga muri 2015. Telegram yakurikiranye; Ikimenyetso cyandukuye kubufasha bwabo bwibikoresho byinshi muri 2021.
auth.h8_a: Kurwanya Konti Kurwanya - igice cyigice cya auth. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
auth.h8_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Kurwanya Konti Kurwanya". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
auth.h8_c: Uburyo bwa "Konti yo Kubara Konti" bwagiye buhinduka kuri Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.

rooms.title: Ibyumba n'ubutumwa
rooms.subtitle: Ubwoko bune bwibyumba, abanyamuryango, urufunguzo ruzunguruka, ubutumwa.
rooms.intro: Ubwoko bwibyumba bine byose - DM, itsinda ryigenga, itsinda rusange, umuyoboro - gusangira imwe munsi y 'ibyumba`. Imyitwarire irinzwe namabendera ya boolean.
rooms.h1p1: ** DM **: rwose abanyamuryango babiri, `ni_dm = ukuri`,` ni_private = ukuri`. Vuga auto-shyira kumurongo wabandi.
rooms.h1p2: ** Itsinda ryigenga **: gutumira-gusa, `ni_private = ukuri`,` ni_umuyoboro = ibinyoma`. Max 5000 abanyamuryango kubisanzwe.
rooms.h1p3: ** Itsinda rusange **: `is_private = ibinyoma`. Umuntu wese ufite ubutumire butumirwa arashobora kwinjiramo; urutonde mububiko rusange niba nyirubwite ahisemo.
rooms.h1p4: ** Umuyoboro **: gutangaza-gusa, `ni_umuyoboro = ukuri`. Gusa ba nyirubwite / abadamu bashobora kohereza; abanyamuryango basanzwe basoma.
rooms.h2p2: Abadamu barashobora gutumira, gukubita, kutavuga, no guhindura igenamiterere ryicyumba. Abanyamuryango barashobora kohereza ubutumwa, kubyitwaramo, guhindura ibyabo, gusiba ibyabo.
rooms.h2p3: Uruhushya cascade: ba nyirubwite bafite imbaraga za admin. Abadamu ntibashobora kumanura nyirayo.
rooms.h2p4: Impinduka zuruhare zitanga ubutumwa bwa sisitemu (`ubwoko:" uruhare_guhinduka "`) bigaragara kuri buri munyamuryango.
rooms.h3p1: Buri cyumba gifite 32-byte ** urufunguzo rwumuzi ** rwakozwe mubyaremwe ukoresheje `amabanga.token_bytes (32)` ku gikoresho cyabashizeho.
rooms.h3p2: Buri munyamuryango abona ibahasha `{umunyamuryango_id, ibahasha: X25519_encrypt (umunyamuryango_pubkey, umuzi_key)}` yabitswe muri `room_keys`.
rooms.h3p3: Iyo umunyamuryango yinjiye, ibahasha nshya yabacapishijwe nabakiriya bose bariho. Gufata ibahasha ni O (1) kuri buri gufatanya.
rooms.h3p4: Iyo umunyamuryango avuye, icyumba kizunguruka: umuremyi (cyangwa umuyobozi wa mbere ukora) akuramo umuzi mushya, yongera guhisha abanyamuryango basigaye, inyandiko `{ubwoko:" k ", icyumba: ..., ibishya_iterambere: [...]}` binyuze kuri WebSocket. Ciphertext ishaje iguma isomwa nurufunguzo rwa kera abakiriya baracyafite.
rooms.h3l1: Urufunguzo-B urufunguzo rutangaza: kubyumba rusange kuri> abanyamuryango 1000, amabahasha areka gupima. Ahubwo, nyirubwite asinya kandi atangaza urufunguzo rwumuzi ruri mumeza ya `icyumba_abaturage_ibikoresho. Abakiriya bagenzura umukono kuri nyiri icyumba pubkey. Kuzenguruka mu kiruhuko cy'abanyamuryango rero ni o-op y'ibyumba bitandukanye-B.
rooms.h3l2: Kuri buri cyumba pseudo: buri cyumba nacyo gifite `icyumba_pseudo_salt`. Izina ry'abanyamuryango mu butumwa ni `HMAC-SHA256 (umunyu, umukoresha_id)` yaciwe kugeza kuri 16 ya hex. Node ntishobora kumenya umukoresha yohereje ubutumwa butarimo ikarita yumukiriya.
rooms.h4p1: Ubutumwa bufite indangamuntu ya monotonic kuri buri cyumba (64-bit-auto-kwiyongera, `bigserial` muri Postgres,` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` muri SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Gutumiza ni seriveri-yashinzwe. Abakiriya ntibarwanira igihe; zitanga muri ID zikurikirana kandi zerekana uwagutumye igihe cyurukuta-isaha nka UI metadata gusa.
rooms.h4p3: Guhindura: ciphertext nshya isimbuza ibishaje mu mwanya, `byahinduwe_at`. Abakiriya berekana `(byahinduwe)` ikimenyetso.
rooms.h4p4: Gusiba: shiraho `gusiba_at`, gukuraho ciphertext. `{andika:" m ", wasibwe: ukuri}` gutangaza.
rooms.h4p5: Ibisubizo: `gusubiza_to` = ubutumwa bwerekanwe id. Abakiriya batanga umutwe muto wavuzwe.
rooms.h5p1: Ibisubizo ni umurongo muri `reaction (ubutumwa_id, umukoresha_id, emoji, yaremye_at)`. POSTs z'abakiriya `/ api / ubutumwa / {id} / reaction / {emoji}`. DELETE kuri un-reaction.
rooms.h5p2: Abafana ba node hanze `{ubwoko:" m ", reaction: [...]}` kuri buri mufatabuguzi. Abakiriya bose hamwe.
rooms.h5p3: Ntakabuza kuri emoji - Unicode iyariyo yose. Abakiriya de-dupe no gutanga ibara.
rooms.h6p1: Urudodo nicyumba cya pseudo gishinze imizi kubutumwa. `POST / api / ubutumwa / {id} / urudodo` irema` {id: <new_icyumba_id>, umubyeyi_ubutumwa_id:
rooms.h6p2: Ibyumba byinsanganyamatsiko bizungura abanyamuryango kubabyeyi. Umunyamuryango wicyumba icyo aricyo cyose arashobora kohereza mumutwe uwo ariwo wose.
rooms.h6p3: Inkomoko yingenzi: urufunguzo rwumuzi urufunguzo = `HKDF (umubyeyi_umuzi, amakuru:" urudodo: "+ <umubyeyi_ubutumwa_id>, len: 32)`. Kwiyunga urufunguzo rwurudodo ntabwo rusohora ababyeyi.
rooms.h7p1: Abadamu barashobora gushira ubutumwa bugera kuri 10 kuri buri cyumba. `POST / api / ibyumba / {id} / pin` hamwe na` {ubutumwa_id} `.
rooms.h7p2: Gushiraho ibipapuro bipakiye hejuru yicyumba; abakiriya batanga umutwe wumutwe hejuru.
rooms.h8p1: Igishushanyo cya buri cyumba gikomeza kuri node: `PUT / api / ibyumba / {id} / umushinga` hamwe na {{inyandiko}`. `GET` igaruka ikigezweho. `DELETE`.
rooms.h8p2: Abakiriya bahuza ibishushanyo mbonera kubikoresho bityo kwandika kuri terefone birangirira kuri desktop. Igishushanyo ntabwo kirangira-kirangiye - ni seriveri-igaragara neza. Ubwo ni ubucuruzi nkana kubikoresho byambukiranya UX. Abakoresha banze barashobora guhagarika sync kuri buri cyumba.
rooms.h9p1: `POST / api / gahunda` hamwe na` {icyumba_id, ciphertext, ohereza_at} `. Ububiko bwa node muri `gahunda_ubutumwa`; umukozi wa cron yiyemeje mugihe.
rooms.h9p2: Birashobora guhindurwa kandi bigahagarikwa kugeza kohereza_at tick yumuriro. Nyuma yo kohereza, ubutumwa buhinduka umurongo usanzwe muri `ubutumwa`.
rooms.h1_a: Ubwoko bwibyumba bine byose (DM, itsinda ryigenga, itsinda rusange, umuyoboro) basangira ameza yicyumba kimwe. Itandukaniro riri mumabendera atatu ya boolean.
rooms.h1_b: Ibendera: `is_dm`,` ni_gutanga`, `ni_umuyoboro`. DM: is_dm = ukuri, ni_private = ukuri, abanyamuryango 2 rwose. Itsinda ryigenga: is_private = ukuri, ni_umuyoboro = ibinyoma, abanyamuryango bagera 5000. Itsinda rusange: is_private = ibinyoma, byanditswe mububiko niba nyirubwite ahisemo. Umuyoboro: ni_umuyoboro = ukuri, gusa ba nyirubwite / post ya admin. Bose basangire imiyoborere yingenzi, abafana-hanze, reaction, insanganyamatsiko.
rooms.h1_c: Imbonerahamwe imwe ya polymorphism ni icyitegererezo kuva Martin Fowler * Ibishushanyo mbonera bya Enterprises * (2002). Telegram ikoresha ubwoko butatu bwibyumba imbere; Ubunebwe bukoresha imiyoboro + DMs + amashyaka menshi DM nkubwoko bune; Ubwumvikane buke bukoresha "imiyoboro" kuri buri kintu. Twahisemo imbonerahamwe imwe nyuma yo kwerekana umwirondoro werekana ikiguzi nyamukuru ni umufana-usa (uhuje ubwoko) hanyuma nyuma ya v0.0.3 reaktor ihuza ameza atatu asa murimwe.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE ibyumba (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  andika VARCHAR (16), - umurage, umurengera hamwe n'ibendera
  izina VARCHAR (256),
  is_private BOOLEAN,
  ni_Umuyoboro BOOLEAN,
  is_dm BOOLEAN,
  umunyamuryango_umubare INT,
  avatar_url VARCHAR (512),
  yaremye_at TIMESTAMP,
  yaremye_by BIGINT REFERENCES abakoresha (id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Inshingano ni ibyiciro bitatu: nyirubwite, admin, umunyamuryango. Nukuri nyirubwite kuri buri cyumba, byibura admin umwe, uko bishakiye abanyamuryango benshi.
rooms.h2_b: `icyumba_ibuka (icyumba_id, umukoresha_id, uruhare, gufatanya_at, muted_until)`. Inshingano casade: ba nyirayo bafite imbaraga zose za admin. Abadamu barashobora gutumira, gukubita, kutavuga, no guhindura ibyumba byateganijwe ariko ntibishobora kumanura nyirabyo. Abanyamuryango barashobora kohereza ubutumwa, kubyitwaramo, guhindura ibyabo, gusiba ibyabo. Kwimura nyirubwite binyuze kuri `PATCH / api / ibyumba / {id}` hamwe na `new_owner_id` - nyirubwite ashaje kuri admin.
rooms.h2_c: Nyirubwite / admin / umunyamuryango nu mpande eshatu IRC op / ijwi / umukoresha moderi kuva 1988, nyuma yemejwe na Slack, Discord, Telegram. Guhitamo byihariye kugira nyirayo umwe (ntabwo ari byinshi) biva mubitekerezo byemewe n'amategeko: mubucamanza hamwe namategeko agenga itsinda, kugira nyirubwite usobanutse byoroshya DMCA nibisabwa bisa.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE icyumba_abibuka (
  icyumba_id BIGINT,
  umukoresha_id BIGINT,
  uruhare VARCHAR (16) CHECK (uruhare IN ('nyir'ubwite', 'umuyobozi', 'umunyamuryango')),
  gufatanya_at TIMESTAMP,
  muted_until TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (icyumba_id, umukoresha_id)
);
rooms.h3_a: Buri cyumba gifite urufunguzo rwumuzi wa 32-byte. Abanyamuryango bafata kopi zipfunyitse munsi ya X25519.
rooms.h3_b: Kurema, umukiriya atanga `root_key = ibanga.token_bytes (32)`. Kuri buri munyamuryango, umukiriya ahisha `root_key` munsi ya` X25519 (umunyamuryango_pubkey) `→ ibahasha. Ibahasha iba muri `icyumba_ibikoresho (icyumba_id, umukoresha_id, ibahasha)`. Iyo umukoresha yinjiye, umukiriya wese uriho abacumbikira ibahasha nshya kuri bo. Iyo umukoresha avuye, nyirubwite cyangwa umuyobozi wambere ukora azunguruka - atanga imizi_key nshya, yongera guhisha abanyamuryango basigaye, gutangaza `{ubwoko:" k ", icyumba: ..., ibishya_iterambere: [...]}` hejuru ya WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Gupfunyika buri munyamuryango nicyitegererezo Ikimenyetso cyatangiye muri 2014 kumatsinda yacyo-v2. Megolm ya Matrix ikoresha uburyo busa "urufunguzo rwohereza". Vortex yajyanye n'ibahasha ya buri munyamuryango kuko byoroshye gutekereza kubijyanye: nta banga ryimbere ryimbere hagati yabohereje. Gucuruza ni O (N) ibahasha yerekana impinduka zabanyamuryango, bikaba byiza kugeza kubanyamuryango 5000; rusange-umuyoboro rusange Variant-B ikuraho imipaka.
rooms.h3_f:
kurema:
  umuzi_key = rand (32)
  kuri m mu banyamuryango:
    ibahasha [m] = X25519_Ecrypt (m.pubkey, umuzi_key)

mu kiruhuko:
  ibishya_root = rand (32)
  gusubiramo (amabahasha mashya kubanyamuryango basigaye)
rooms.h4_a: Urufunguzo rwa Variant-B rusimbuza ibahasha ya buri munyamuryango nurufunguzo rumwe rwashyizweho umukono, rwashyizwe kumeza yasomwe kumugaragaro. Umunzani kugeza 100k + abanyamuryango.
rooms.h4_b: Aho kugirango ibahasha ya O (N) ibe ibahasha, nyirubwite asinyira umuzi_key hanyuma agashyira kuri `icyumba_cyiciro rusange (icyumba_id, urufunguzo, umukono_by, umukono_at)`. Abakiriya bazana, bagenzure neza nyirubwite Ed25519, hanyuma ukoreshe. Kuzunguruka ni o-op yo guhindura abanyamuryango - umuntu wese wari ufite urufunguzo aracyafite nubwo yaba yaratewe imigeri. Ibyo biremewe kubitangaza-imiyoboro aho "amateka yimbitse" ntabwo ari icyitegererezo cyugarije ariko kugera no mubipimo biri.
rooms.h4_c: Ibinyuranye-B byerekanwe kuri Matrix "isi isomeka" amateka agaragara hamwe nurufunguzo rwasinywe. Wongeyeho kuri Vortex muri v0.0.8 nyuma yuko beta ifite umuyoboro rusange wabanyamuryango 50k wongeyeho ibahasha yongeye guturika byuzuye. Ibipimo byasinywe-byashyizwe ahagaragara umunzani ugereranije nurufunguzo ruzunguruka (zidasanzwe) aho guhinduka kubanyamuryango (bihoraho).
rooms.h4_f:
Ibitandukanye-B:
  ibimenyetso bya nyirabyo: sig = Ed25519Sign (nyirayo_priv, icyumba_id ∥ umuzi_key ∥ verisiyo)
  gutangaza: icyumba_abaturage_ibikoresho + = {icyumba_id, umuzi_key, verisiyo, sig}
  umukiriya: GET / api / ibyumba / {id} / urufunguzo-rusange → kugenzura sig kurwanya nyirayo_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Ubutumire bwa code ni 32 hex. Ibyifuzo bya max_uses, birangira_at, umukoro_role, ushobora gusubirwamo.
rooms.h5_b: `POST / api / ibyumba / {id} / gutumira` (admin-gusa) ikora umurongo muri` ubutumire (code, icyumba_id, cyaremye_by, max_uses, cyakoreshejwe_ibara, kirangira_at, umukoro_role, wanze_at) `. `1 Kuraho ukoresheje `DELETE / api / gutumira / {code}` - nyuma kwinjira birananirana.
rooms.h5_c: Saba kode nka primite irashaje nkuburyo bwa IRC bwa `+ i` (1988). Telegram kumugaragaro gutumira kumurongo hamwe nigihe cyo gukoresha no gukoresha imipaka yatangijwe mumwaka wa 2017. Impinduka ya Vortex yongeraho `assign_role` kugirango ba nyirubwite bashobore gutanga kodegisi zitanga admin umutekano muburyo bumwe bwo kurasa - bifite akamaro ko kwinjirira umuyobozi mushya udakeneye kumenya neza umukoresha wabo imbere.
rooms.h5_f:
gutumira umurongo:
  kode: VARCHAR (64) - Inyuguti 32
  icyumba_id: BIGINT
  max_uses: INT - NULL = itagira imipaka
  yakoreshejwe_umubare: INT
  irangira_at: TIMESTAMP - NULL = ntabwo
  umukoro_uruhare: VARCHAR (16) - NULL = umunyamuryango
  yakuweho_at: TIMESTAMP - NULL = kubaho
rooms.h6_a: Ubutumwa umurongo bubika ciphertext + metadata; uwayohereje ntabwo abikwa muburyo bworoshye.
rooms.h6_b: `ubutumwa (id, icyumba_id, uwakohereje_id, ciphertext, nonce, ohereza_pseudo, yoherejwe_at, yahinduwe_at?, yasibwe_at?, igisubizo_kuri?, insanganyamatsiko_id?, ubwoko)`. `sender_id` ibaho kugirango igenzurwe kandi irerekanwa. `sender_pseudo` ni buri cyumba cya deterministic hash ya sender_id kuburyo abafana-badakeneye gukora kumeza yabakoresha. `ubwoko` ni kimwe muri: inyandiko, ishusho, dosiye, ijwi, guhamagara, sisitemu. `ciphertext` ni opaque AES-GCM ibisohoka; gusa abagize icyumba bafite urufunguzo barashobora gufungura.
rooms.h6_c: Igitekerezo cyohereje_pseudo kiva mubimenyetso bifunze-byohereje (2018). Ikimenyetso kirakoresha guhuma seriveri kugirango wohereze indangamuntu; turayikoresha kubwintego isa ariko komeza `sender_id` ibisobanuro bisobanutse kuri ACL nigipimo cyibipimo. Gutandukana bituma dushobora kubahiriza "abanyamuryango bonyine ni bo bashobora kohereza" nta seriveri yize wavuze iki ku kintu cyuzuye DB.
rooms.h7_a: Hindura wandike `ciphertext` ahantu hamwe no guhita` byahinduwe_at`. Gusiba null ciphertext hanyuma ushireho 'gusiba_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Hindura: `PATCH / api / ubutumwa / {id}` hamwe na `{ciphertext, nonce}`. Gusa uwayohereje ashobora guhindura ubutumwa bwabo. Ciphertext yumurongo / nonce yasimbuwe, `edited_at = now`,` ubwoko` idahindutse. Umufana-hanze `{ubwoko:" m ", id, ct, nonce, yahinduwe_at}`. Gusiba: `DELETE / api / ubutumwa / {id}`. Kohereza cyangwa admin arashobora gusiba. `gusiba_at = ubu`,` ciphertext = NULL`. Umurongo ugumaho rero ibisubizo biracyumvikana. Umufana-hanze `{ubwoko:" m ", yasibwe: ukuri, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Guhindura-mu-mwanya ni Telegram / Igishushanyo; Disikuru yagumanye amateka yuzuye yo guhindura hanyuma ikayireka kubanga. Vortex ibika gusa ibishya - guhindura amateka ninkomoko ya PR ibyabaye mugihe wasibwe-guhindura. Gusiba-gusiba hamwe na ciphertext yubusa biva mubitabo bimwe Telegram bikinisha kandi bikabika iminyururu yo gusubiza utagumije ibirimo.
rooms.h7_f:
guhindura: UPDATE ubutumwa SET ciphertext = $ 1, nonce = $ 2, yahinduwe_at = NOW () WHERE id = $ 3
gusiba: UPDATE ubutumwa SET gusiba_at = NOW (), ciphertext = NULL WHERE id = $ 1
rooms.h8_a: Inyandiko - igice cyibyumba igice. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
rooms.h8_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Inyandiko". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
rooms.h8_c: Uburyo bwa "Draft" bwahindutse hirya no hino Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.
rooms.h9_a: Ubutumwa buteganijwe - igice cyibyumba igice. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
rooms.h9_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Ubutumwa buteganijwe". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.

files.title: Amadosiye hamwe numugereka
files.subtitle: Kurasa-imwe kuri ntoya, isubukurwa nini, umukiriya-uruhande rwibanga kuri byombi.
files.intro: Buri dosiye yoherezwa inyura mumurongo umwe. Itandukaniro riri hagati yinzira gusa kubijyanye no kwihanganira urusobe: birashoboka kwihanganira amahuza ahamye.
files.h1p1: Cap: 5 MB. Ikoreshwa kumafoto, amajwi, amajwi magufi.
files.h1p2: Umukiriya ahishe dosiye yose hamwe na AES-GCM, bidasanzwe 96-bit bitari, urufunguzo = `dosiye_root = ibanga.token_bytes (32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart / form-data` to` / api / dosiye` hamwe nimirima `dosiye` (ciphertext),` plaque_blake3` (gusaba ubunyangamugayo), `mime_type` (yerekana; seriveri yongeye kugenzura na` python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Ububiko bwa node munsi ya `gukuramo / <category> / <sha256> .bin` hanyuma igaruka` {dosiye_id, url} `.
files.h1p5: Umukiriya noneho ashyiraho ubutumwa bwicyumba bwerekana dosiye_id kandi igatwara dosiye_kuri muri ciphertext yayo kugirango abagize icyumba bashobore gufungura.
files.h2p2: Icyiciro cya 1: `POST / api / dosiye / gusubiramo / init` hamwe na` {izina ryizina, ingano, chunk_size_hint} `. Node igenera id yo gukuramo, itora ingano yubunini (isanzwe 512 KiB, ifashwe kuri 4 MiB), igaruka `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Icyiciro cya 2: kuri buri gice, `PUT / api / dosiye / gusubukurwa / {upload_id} / chunk / {offset}` hamwe numubiri wa ciphertext. Offsets igomba guhuzwa na `chunk_size`.
files.h2p4: Icyiciro cya 3: `POST / api / dosiye / gusubukurwa / {kohereza_id} / kurangiza 'hamwe na` {byoroshye_blake3} `. Node iraterana, igenzura ingano, ububiko, igaruka `{dosiye_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Kunanirwa gukemura: gukuramo byahagaritswe birashobora gukomeza mukongera kohereza gusa offsets zabuze. Node tracks offset yageze muri Redis (cyangwa muri-kwibuka kuburyo bwa SQLite).
files.h2p6: TTL: gukuramo bitarangiye bisukurwa nyuma ya 24 h.
files.h3p1: Gukuramo amashusho (MIME `ishusho / *`) bikurura amashanyarazi ashingiye kuri Pillow kuri 256 × 256 JPEG q = 80. Yabitswe munsi ya `gukuramo / igikumwe / <hash> .jpg`.
files.h3p2: Thumbnail nayo ni umukiriya-uruhande rwibanga - uyahawe akeneye dosiye_umuti kugirango utange. Ikiza umurongo wa enterineti.
files.h3p3: Gukuramo amashusho (MIME `video / *`) bitera gukuramo ffmpeg ishingiye kuri 10% yigihe cya clip, ibitswe kimwe.
files.h4p1: Abakiriya-batanze `mime_type` ni igitekerezo. Seriveri ikoresha `python-magic` irwanya 1 KB yambere kandi ikanga niba ubwoko bwasunitswe buri murutonde rwabihakana:` gusaba / x-dosexec`, `gusaba / x-sharedlib`,` gusaba / x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Ibi bihagarika abakoresha naive gukwirakwiza kubwimpanuka kubwintumwa. Abashishikariye gutera barashobora gukomeza kurenga hamwe na kontineri yanditse neza - kwirwanaho ni umukiriya-uruhande rwanze, ntabwo ari seriveri.
files.h5p1: Mburabuzi: sisitemu yimikorere. Good kumurongo umwe.
files.h5p2: S3: shiraho `STORAGE_BACKEND = s3` +` S3_BUCKET = ... `. Amadosiye yoherejwe kuri S3 adakora kuri disiki ya node. URL zabugenewe zikoreshwa mugukuramo.
files.h5p3: IPFS: ubushakashatsi. Ibikururwa bitangaza CIDs binyuze muri DHT; Ibikururwa bizana ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.
files.h1_a: Kurasa inshuro imwe ninzira yihuta kubintu byose munsi ya 5 MB - amafoto, inoti zijwi, clips ngufi. Imwe HTTPS POST, blob imwe ihishe, umurongo umwe muri `dosiye`.
files.h1_b: Umukiriya ahishe dosiye bytes iherezo-iherezo hamwe na AES-GCM munsi ya 32-byte idasanzwe "dosiye_root". POSTs `multipart / form-data` to` / api / dosiye` hamwe nimirima `dosiye` (ciphertext),` plaque_blake3` (gusaba ubunyangamugayo), `mime_type` (igitekerezo). Node ishyira mu bikorwa 5 MB cap kurwego rwo kwakira buffer, ikora `python-magic` yo kumenya ubwoko, ikanga niba MIME iri kurutonde rwabihakana, ububiko munsi ya` uploads / <category> / <hash> .bin`, igasubiza `{file_id, url, mime_type, ingano}`. Umukiriya noneho ashyiraho ubutumwa bwicyumba buvuga `dosiye_id` no gutwara` dosiye_root` muri ciphertext yayo.
files.h1_c: Igipapuro 5 MB numubare umwe Slack na Telegram gukoresha inzira yabo yo kohereza "inline". Idosiye nini ijya munzira isubukurwa. Kera Vortex yari ifite 100 MB umupira umwe; twamanutse kuri 5 MB nyuma yo gushushanya twerekanye ko kohereza inshuro imwe hejuru ya 5 MB byagabanutseho 40% kumurongo wa mobile. Inzira isubirwamo ninziza rwose kumadosiye manini nubwo ari menshi azenguruka munzira zishimishije.
files.h2_a: Gusubiramo birashoboka ni inzira ya dosiye nini. Abakiriya bohereje ibipimo binini-binini, birashobora guhagarara, birashobora gukomeza kumupaka uwo ariwo wose, birashobora gukira kumurongo.
files.h2_b: Ibyiciro bitatu. Init: `POST / api / dosiye / isubukurwa / init` hamwe na` {filename, ingano, chunk_size_hint} `→ node igenera` upload_id` + yemeza ubunini buke. Uduce: kuri buri offset, `PUT / api / dosiye / gusubukurwa / {kohereza_id} / chunk / {offset}` hamwe numubiri wa ciphertext. Offsets igomba kuba inshuro ya chunk_size. Kurangiza: `POST / api / dosiye / gusubukurwa / {kohereza_id} / kurangiza 'hamwe na {
files.h2_c: Porotokole y'ibyiciro bitatu nuburyo bumwe na tus.io (Kongera gukuramo, 2013), AWS S3 gukuramo ibice byinshi, hamwe na Google Drive yongeye gusubirwamo. Vortex yafashe imiterere ya tus.io kuko yari umukino woroshye wa FastAPI +. 24 h TTL kubintu byoherejwe bitarangiye bihuye na S3 isanzwe kandi iringaniza irahinduka kugirango ihindure imikoreshereze ya disiki ya seriveri.
files.h3_a: Thumbnail ikorwa seriveri kuruhande mugihe cyo kohereza ariko guma uhishe munsi yumuzi wa dosiye imwe, kugirango abanyamuryango bicyumba gusa babashe kubitanga.
files.h3_b: Kuri `ishusho / *` MIME, Pillow itanga 256 × 256 JPEG q = 80 uhereye kubanga. Tegereza - oya, seriveri ntizigera igira inyandiko isobanutse. Kugenda neza: umukiriya atanga igikumwe mugace, ahishe hamwe na dosiye imwe_root + nshya nonce, kohereza nka blob bavukana, hamwe na `thumb_id` mubutumwa bwicyumba. Seriveri ibika ciphertext. Kuri `video / *`, umukiriya akora kimwe na ffmpeg ikomoka kuri urufunguzo.
files.h3_c: Kera Vortex yari ifite seriveri-uruhande rwa thumbnail ibisekuruza biva mubisanzwe - twambuye ubwo bushobozi muri v0.0.4 nyuma yisuzuma ryumutekano ryerekanye ko ryarenze ingwate E2E. Ibikumwe byuruhande rwabakiriya nicyitegererezo Ikimenyetso cyakoreshejwe kuva 2018 na WhatsApp kuva 2020. Igiciro cyumuvuduko ntigisanzwe - 256 × 256 JPEG kiri munsi ya 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Seriveri ishyira mu bikorwa MIME guhakana urutonde kuri sniff layer kugirango ihagarike kubwimpanuka zagabanijwe.
files.h4_b: Nyuma yo kohereza byuzuye (isasu rimwe) cyangwa kurangiza (gusubukurwa), seriveri ikora `python-magic` hejuru ya 1 KB yambere ya ciphertext yakiriye kontineri kugirango imenye ubwoko nyabwo. Niba sniff ivuga `progaramu / x-dosexec` (Windows PE),` progaramu / x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), cyangwa `progaramu / x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O), kohereza byanze bikunze hamwe na 415 Ubwoko bw'itangazamakuru budashyigikiwe. Iyi ni politiki ya seriveri, ntabwo ari imipaka yumutekano - abagize icyumba cyabakiriya barashobora gushiraho imiterere yipfunyika irenga umunuko.
files.h4_c: MIME guswera nka politiki yo guhakana ni IETF umushinga-mime-guswera-0X guhera muri 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram bose barabikora. Imipaka (zip / kontineri ikora bypass sniff) yamenyekanye kuva 2016 - kwirwanaho kwacu kurwego: hiyongereyeho umuburo wuruhande rwumukoresha kuri dosiye iyo ari yo yose yaguwe neza.
files.h5_a: Ububiko bwinyuma - igice cyamadosiye igice. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
files.h5_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Ububiko bwinyuma". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
files.h5_c: Uburyo bwa "Ububiko bwinyuma" bwahindutse kuri Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.

presence.title: Kubaho no gutanga ibimenyetso
presence.subtitle: Kwandika ibipimo, soma inyemezabwishyu, uheruka-kubona - byose.
presence.intro: Ibi bimenyetso ni urusaku. Vortex ituma badakomeza gutsimbarara ku busanzwe: kwandika ubuzima muri Redis (cyangwa muri-kwibuka), soma inyemezabuguzi nicyo kimenyetso cyonyine kibaho gitangira.
presence.h1p1: Umukiriya yohereza `{ubwoko:" t ", icyumba: ..., leta:" gutangira "|" guhagarika "}` kuri urufunguzo. Yamaganwe byibuze ibyabaye kuri 3 s.
presence.h1p2: Node yerekana `{ubwoko:" t ", icyumba: ..., umukoresha: ..., leta: ...}` kubantu bose biyandikishije WebSockets.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `tangira` udafite` guhagarara` inshuro zikurikira nyuma ya 10 s kuruhande rwabakiriya.
presence.h2p1: POSTs z'abakiriya `POST / api / ibyumba / {id} / soma` hamwe na` {nyuma_isoma_ubutumwa_id} `.
presence.h2p2: Node ikomeza muri `soma_ibisubizo (icyumba_id, umukoresha_id, ubutumwa_id, soma_at)` kandi yerekana `{ubwoko:" r ", icyumba: ..., umukoresha: ..., ubutumwa_id: ...}`.
presence.h2p3: Abakiriya batanga "babonwa na N" munsi yubutumwa bwo hanze.
presence.h2p4: Ibanga: umukoresha arashobora guhagarika "kubona" ​​rwose; noneho node ntabwo ikomeza inyemezabwishyu kuri bo. Ubucuruzi-buke: nabo ntibabona inyemezabwishyu yabandi (symmetry).
presence.h3p1: Node ikurikirana `kuboneka.last_seen_at` (unix ms) kumukoresha. Yavuguruwe kuri buri WebSocket ikadiri.
presence.h3p2: Urwego rwa Granularity (umukoresha-ushobora guhitamo): neza, kuzunguruka kugeza hafi min 5, kuzunguruka kugeza ku isaha yegereye, "vuba", cyangwa kuzimya.
presence.h3p3: Kubazwa ukoresheje `GET / api / abakoresha / {id} / kuboneka`. Kwiyandikisha ukoresheje `{ubwoko:" sub_presence ", umukoresha: ...}`.
presence.h4p1: Umukoresha "kumurongo" niba bafite byibuze imwe active0⟫ ikora kubikoresho byabo.
presence.h4p2: Kugaragara kubitumanaho gusa - kutabonana reba ubushize ariko ntabwo ari akadomo nzima.
presence.h1_a: Ikimenyetso cyo kwandika cyoherejwe hakoreshejwe WebSocket ikadiri `{ubwoko:" t ", icyumba, leta:" gutangira "|" guhagarika "}` kandi bigatangazwa na node kuri buri mukoresha mubyumba.
presence.h1_b: Umukiriya yatangiriye kuri 3 s - urufunguzo rwa mbere rwohereza `gutangira, nyuma muri 3 s ntacyo ukora. 10 s nyuma yurufunguzo rwanyuma, umukiriya yohereza `guhagarara '. Node yerekana ikadiri mu magambo, yashyizwe hamwe na `user_id`. Nta gutsimbarara - kwandika leta ibaho murwibutso kuri buri cyumba cyateganijwe (cyangwa Redis pub / sub kuri byinshi-node). Auto-expire 10 s kuruhande rwabakiriye: niba nta update igeze, abakiriya bakeka ko bahagaze.
presence.h1_c: Ibipimo byo kwandika bisubira kuri AIM / ICQ (1997). Ibishushanyo mbonera bya kijyambere byerekanwe kuri Skype 2006 na iMessage 2011. Imibare 3 s / 10 s ituruka ku myitwarire ya iMessage - twe A / B twagerageje 2/5, 3/10, 15/5 na 3/10 twagize ibitekerezo byiza "bihuye nigitekerezo cyabantu".
presence.h2_a: Soma inyemezabuguzi irakomeza: umukiriya POSTs yanyuma-yasomye ubutumwa id; ububiko bwa node muri `soma_ibisobanuro` no gutangaza.
presence.h2_b: `POST / api / ibyumba / {id} / soma` hamwe na` {nyuma_isoma_ubutumwa_id} `. Ivugurura ryibanze `soma_ibisubizo (icyumba_id, umukoresha_id, ubutumwa_id, soma_at)` hamwe na UPSERT semantics. Ibiganiro `{ubwoko:" r ", icyumba, umukoresha, ubutumwa_id, soma_at}`. Abakiriya batanga "babonwa na N" munsi yubutumwa bwo hanze. Ibanga: umukoresha arashobora guhagarika inyemezabwishyu burundu; noneho node ntikomeza kuri bo AND ntibabona inyemezabwishyu zabandi (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Soma inyemezabwishyu zabaye hose nyuma ya iMessage 2011 na WhatsApp 2014. Amategeko agereranya (niba uhishe ibyawe, ntubona abandi ') akomoka kuri Telegram 2014 kandi niyo nzira yonyine yo kwirinda umuyoboro umwe wo kugenzura inzira imwe. Vortex ishyira hamwe kuri seriveri - ntabwo ari umukiriya gusa - bityo abakiriya babeshya ibendera ntibabona neza.
presence.h3_a: Iheruka-kubona ni imwe kuri buri mukoresha timestamp, ivugururwa kuri buri WebSocket ikadiri no gusaza mugihe nta kadamu ihageze.
presence.h3_b: Node ikurikirana `kuboneka.ibintu_byibone_at` nka unix ms. Yavuguruwe kuri buri cyemezo cyemewe WebSocket uhereye kumukoresha. Soma ukoresheje `GET / api / abakoresha / {id} / kuboneka`. Kwiyandikisha ukoresheje `{ubwoko:" sub_presence ", umukoresha}` kugirango ubone ubuzima busunika kumahinduka. Granularity ni umukoresha-ugereranywa: igihe nyacyo, kizengurutse iminota 5, kizunguruka kuri 1 h, "vuba aha", cyangwa kizimye.
presence.h3_c: Urwego rwa Granularity rukurikirana amakuru ya WhatsApp yo kuvugurura ibanga rya 2012 nyuma yo kwijujuta kubyerekanwe bwa nyuma. Telegram muri 2013 yongeyeho indobo "vuba / mucyumweru / mu kwezi". Vortex ya 5 min / 1 h / "vuba aha" yumvikana Telegram. Ihitamo "kuzimya" rihisha umukoresha kubona abandi baherukaga kubona kubwimpamvu imwe yo gusoma inyemezabuguzi.
presence.h4_a: Ibipimo byo kumurongo: umukoresha "kumurongo" niba bafite byibuze imwe live0⟫ kuri kimwe mubikoresho byabo.
presence.h4_b: Node ikomeza `ibikorwa_ibikorwa (umukoresha_id)` mububiko. Kwiyongera kuri WS kuzamura, kugabanuka hafi. `kumurongo = ukora_ws_umubare (umukoresha_id)> 0`. Kugaragara kubitumanaho gusa - kutabonana reba ubushize (bitewe na granularité) ariko ntibigere bibaho akadomo keza. Hindura ibyabaye umuriro iyo kubara kurenze zeru mubyerekezo byombi.
presence.h4_c: Guhuza-gusa kugaragara nicyitegererezo buri ntumwa ikomeye yakemuye nyuma yibintu byinshi byakurikiranwe (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Kera Vortex yatumye kumurongo ugaragara kuri buri wese; twahinduye ibisanzwe nyuma yuko uwasuzumye beta yerekanaga ko ibyumba rusange bizasohora ibihumbi byabatazi kubihumbi n’abandi batazi.

calls.title: WebRTC guhamagara
calls.subtitle: Ijwi + videwo, 1: 1 nitsinda, ryerekanwe hejuru ya WebSocket, ryerekanwa hakoreshejwe coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex ikoresha ububiko WebRTC. Node ni ikimenyetso-gusa. Urungano rumaze guhuza abakandida babo ICE, itangazamakuru ritemba mu buryo butaziguye (urungano-rungano) cyangwa binyuze muri TURN relay kuri bad ⟫2⟫.
calls.h1p1: Hamagara: `POST / api / guhamagara / {icyumba_id} / gutangira` hamwe na` {videwo: bool, amajwi: bool} `. Node itanga umuhamagaro_id, isakaza `{ubwoko:" c ", ubwoko:" gutumira ", guhamagara_id, videwo, amajwi}` mucyumba.
calls.h1p2: Callee yemera: `POST / api / guhamagara / {guhamagara_id} / kwemera` →` {ubwoko: "c", ubwoko: "byemewe"} `.
calls.h1p3: Gutanga / gusubiza guhana: `{ubwoko:" gutanga ", sdp: ...}` → `{ubwoko:" igisubizo ", sdp: ...}` → `{ubwoko:" umukandida ", urubura: ...}` × N kugeza bihujwe.
calls.h1p4: Ihamagarwa rirangira: `POST / api / guhamagara / {guhamagara_id} / iherezo '. Impande zombi zirashobora kumanikwa. Inyandiko zanditse `guhamagara_ibisobanuro (guhamagara_id, igihe_s, videwo, amajwi, ibirori)`.
calls.h2p1: Gushiraho Seriveri Yihuza. Urungano ruhana abakandida (uwakiriye, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: ihujwe na coturn. Uburyo butangaje gusa bukoreshwa muburyo bwo guhuza-NAT.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn hamwe na HMAC-byashyizweho umukono ibyangombwa bigufi. Buri guhamagarwa kubona inguzanyo nshya zifite agaciro ka 24 h.
calls.h2p4: Ibyangombwa: `{izina ryukoresha: <timestamp>: <user_id>, ijambo ryibanga: base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (ibanga, izina ryukoresha))}`. Imiterere RFC 5389.
calls.h3p1: Ijwi: Opus 48 kHz ihinduka bitrate (6-128 kbps). DTX kuri guhagarika guceceka.
calls.h3p2: Video: VP9 (bikunzwe) / H.264 / AV1 (hitamo). Simulcast kumatsinda yo guhamagara: umuhamagaye ashyiraho ibyemezo bitatu icyarimwe.
calls.h3p3: FEC: burigihe kumajwi; kuri videwo niba bitrate headroom ibemerera.
calls.h4p1: Kub> 2 bitabiriye amahugurwa, Vortex ibyara SFU (Igice cyo Guhitamo Imbere) kuri node. Buri wese mu bitabiriye amahugurwa yohereje rimwe, SFU abafana hanze.
calls.h4p2: Kugeza ubu amajwi-abitabiriye 100 gusa; amatsinda ya videwo yafatiwe kuri 8 muri v0.1 (videwo SFU gukomera muri v0.3 yerekana ikarita).
calls.h4p3: SFU ikoresha icyerekezo kimwe coturn kugirango unyure; nta serivisi zinyongera zisabwa.
calls.h5p1: Binyuze `kubonaDisplayMedia`. Umukiriya yongeyeho inzira nshya kuri PeerConnection ihari; kuganira gutanga / igisubizo.
calls.h5p2: Abagenerwabikorwa batanga ecran isangiwe nkumurongo wihariye wa videwo. Kuri mobile, kugabana ecran bisaba OS-urwego rwuruhushya - iOS isaba, Android yerekana sisitemu ikiganiro.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC yubatswe muri NetEQ ikemura igihombo na jitter. Kwangirika gukabije umukiriya areka gukemura cyangwa guhagarika videwo rwose mugihe amajwi ari muzima.
calls.h6p2: Guhagarika ms 500 bitera kugerageza kongera kugerageza (ICE gutangira). Abakoresha bareba "Guhuza…" byuzuye.
calls.h1_a: Ihamagarwa ryo guhamagara rigenda kimwe WebSocket rikoreshwa muganira. Node yerekana-gusa - ikora SDP na ICE hagati yurungano ariko ntabwo ikora kubitangazamakuru.
calls.h1_b: Hamagara POSTs `/ api / guhamagara / {icyumba_id} / gutangira` hamwe na {{amashusho, amajwi}`. Node igenera `call_id`, isakaza` {ubwoko: "c", ubwoko: "gutumira", guhamagara_id, videwo, amajwi} `mucyumba. Callee yanditse `/ api / guhamagara / {guhamagara_id} / kwemera` →` {ubwoko: "c", ubwoko: "byemewe"} `. SDP gutanga / gusubiza guhana: `{ubwoko:" gutanga ", sdp}` → `{ubwoko:" igisubizo ", sdp}`. ⟫1⟫ abakandida: `{ubwoko:" umukandida ", urubura}` × N kugeza PeerConnection ivuga `ihuza".
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE amarenga ni urugero WebRTC rusanzwe rwasobanuwe muri RFC 8839 na 8841. Vortex ntacyo ihimbye hano; nibisohoka bimwe Chrome, Firefox, na buri WebRTC isomero rishyira mubikorwa. Guhitamo node-nkibimenyetso-byonyine biva muburyo bwo kumenya ko media3⟫-itangazamakuru ryohereza imiyoboro ihuza umurongo kandi bisaba ibyuma tudashaka kohereza mububiko bwibanze.
calls.h2_a: ICE ibona inzira inyuze muri NAT ukoresheje abakiriya + seriveri-reflexive + abakandida ba relay. coturn ikora STUN na TURN kuruhande rwa Vortex.
calls.h2_b: Urungano rwose rubara abakandida: uwakiriye (IP yaho), srflx (seriveri-reflexive ikoresheje STUN), relay (TURN-yagenewe). Urungano ruhana abakandida bose; buri jambo rikora "couple", kugenzura guhuza kohereza STUN guhuza icyifuzo hejuru ya UDP. Intsinzi yambere ihinduka inzira yatoranijwe. Inyuma ya simmetric NAT, gusa relay ebyiri zikora - nibwo TURN relay itanga itangazamakuru.
calls.h2_c: ICE yapimwe nka RFC 5245 mu mwaka wa 2010 kandi igarurwa nka RFC 8445 muri 2018. Inyuma y’urwego rwabatwara-NAT, STUN inanirwa hafi 15% yigihe kandi TURN ntishobora kwirindwa. coturn ni ibisobanuro bifungura-isoko TURN seriveri; twohereza kuberako ubundi (ubucuruzi Twilio / Vonage TURN) bugura kumunota wamajwi yatanzwe.
calls.h3_a: TURN ibyangombwa ni igihe gito HMAC cyashyizweho umukono nizina ryumukoresha / ijambo ryibanga ryibiri ryatanzwe kuri buri guhamagarwa, ntabwo ari amabanga maremare.
calls.h3_b: Mugutangira guhamagarwa, node itanga `username =" <expiry_unix>: <user_id> "` na `ijambo ryibanga = base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (seriveri_ibanga, izina ryukoresha))`. Byombi bifite TTL 24 h. Umukiriya arabikoresha muri RTCPeerConnection yayo. coturn igenzura HMAC mugihe cyo gushiraho. Inguzanyo zarangiye zananiwe kugenzura HMAC - bahagarika gukora mu buryo bwikora nta base base de base.
calls.h3_c: Igihe gito HMAC inguzanyo ziva kuri RFC 5389 (STUN) kandi nicyitegererezo buri musaruro WebRTC wohereza. Twilio, Google, Xirsys bose barabikora. Ubundi buryo - static TURN inguzanyo - isohoka niba hari umukiriya wabangamiwe. Inguzanyo zimara igihe gito zigabanya idirishya ryangiritse kugeza 24h.
calls.h4_a: Ijwi ni Opus kuri 48 kHz hamwe na DTX; videwo ni VP9 ibanze / H.264 gusubira inyuma / AV1 guhitamo.
calls.h4_b: Ijwi: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Guhagarika imiyoboro) ihagarika kohereza mugihe cyo guceceka, ikomeza kumajwi. FEC buri gihe. Video: VP9 kuri baseline; H.264 yamamaje kubikoresho bidafite ibyuma VP9 decode (iOS mbere ya A10 Bionic); AV1 yatanzwe nka opt-in ya premium kubikoresho bigezweho. Simulcast kumatsinda yo guhamagara: umuhamagaye ashyiraho imyanzuro itatu icyarimwe, SFU abafana hanze iburyo kuri buriwureba.
calls.h4_c: Opus ni codec audio0⟫ yubusa idafite amajwi (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 ni Google ifunguye H.265-ihwanye. H.264 isubira inyuma kuko Apple yagobotse VP9 kugeza 2021. AV1 yabaye ingirakamaro kuri terefone nyuma ya iPhone 15 Pro (2023) na Pixel 8 (2023) yongeyeho decode yibikoresho. Vortex ya codec ivanze nimwe Google Guhura gukoresha.
calls.h5_a: Itsinda ryahamagaye koresha SFU (Guhitamo Imbere yo Guhitamo) kuri node. Buri wese mu bitabiriye amahugurwa yohereza rimwe; SFU imbere kuri buri wese.
calls.h5_b: Kuri> urungano 2 abahamagarira inyandiko `/ api / guhamagara / {icyumba_id} / itsinda / gutangira`. Node izunguruka SFU urugero ihujwe no guhamagarwa. Buri wese mu bitabiriye amahugurwa afungura PeerConnection kuri SFU aho kugirango ayandi murungano. Uplink: buri wese yohereza umugezi 1. Kumanura: SFU imbere N-1 imigezi. Simulcast ibice bisobanura SFU itoranya imyanzuro ijyanye na buriwese aboneka.
calls.h5_c: SFU ubwubatsi bwatangiye kuri Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Mbere ya SFU, WebRTC guhamagarwa kwitsinda byari byuzuye-buri rungano rwashizemo imigezi ya N-1, igapima inshuro enye. Kuzuza, Google Guhura, Jitsi, Itsinda ryibimenyetso rihamagara byose ukoreshe SFU. Vortex amajwi-yitsinda ryitsinda ryonyine ryoherejwe muri v0.0.8; amatsinda ya videwo guhamagara kuri v0.3 yumuhanda.
calls.h6_a: Gusangira ecran ni inzira nshya yibitangazamakuru kuri PeerConnection ihari, byongeye kuganirwaho binyuze gutanga / igisubizo.
calls.h6_b: Abakoresha kanda Mugabane Mugaragaza → mushakisha / iOS / Android bita `getDisplayMedia ()`. MediaStream yagarutse ni addTrack-ed kuri PeerConnection. Kongera kuganira: gutanga / igisubizo gishya hamwe n'inzira yongeyeho. Abagenerwabikorwa batanga ecran isangiwe nkibintu bitandukanye bya videwo. Kuri iOS, kugabana ecran bikenera kwagurwa kwa Broadcast Upload; kuri Android, serivisi ibanza + Uruhushya rwa MediaProjection.
calls.h6_c: GetDisplayMedia yari isanzwe muri 2017 kandi iri muri buri mushakisha kuva muri 2019. Kwiyongera kwa Broadcast Upload ya iOS yaje muri iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection ihagaze neza kuva Lollipop (2015). Vortex kugabana ecran yoherejwe muri v0.0.8.
calls.h2_f:
abakandida:
  uwakiriye: rtp: addr (local local0⟫)
  srflx: STUN yavumbuye adresse rusange
  relay: TURN-yagenewe adresse ya relay

kugenzura byombi: STUN guhuza ibyifuzo hejuru ya UDP
byatoranijwe byombi: ubanza gutsinda

izina ryukoresha = "{expiry_unix}: {umukoresha_id}"
ijambo ryibanga = base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (seriveri_ibanga, izina ryukoresha))
TTL = 24 h
coturn: yemeza HMAC kubisabwa AUTH; yanze nyuma yo kurangira

videwo: VP9 (ibanze)
         Gusubira inyuma
        H.264 ibyingenzi (bikumirwa)
