federation.title: Federasiyo
federation.subtitle: Imbuto zizewe, zasinywe amazimwe, cross-node DMs.
federation.intro: Federasiyo ireka abakoresha kuri node Ubutumwa abakoresha ubutumwa kuri node B. Ni opt-in kuri buri mukoresha. Utubuto twiziritse twizeye neza; nta buryo bwikora "node iyo ari yo yose irashobora guhuza na njye" uburyo.
federation.h1p1: Buri node ikomeza `federasiyo (igituba, iherezo, ubuzima_ibisobanuro, wongeyeho_at, wongeyeho_by)`.
federation.h1p2: Ongeraho urungano bisaba ibikorwa byashyizweho umukono na admin ibikorwa. Admin UI yerekana urutoki rwa kure kugirango abakoresha bashobore kugenzura hanze ya bande.
federation.h1p3: Urungano rwakuweho ruguma muri DB rwashyizweho `rwakuweho_at` kugirango rugenzurwe. Federasiyo nshya isaba pubkey imwe yanze kugeza admin adakuyeho.
federation.h2p1: Gusohoka kuva A kugeza kumukoresha @ B: node A kuzinga ibahasha yubutumwa muri blob yasinywe na POSTs `/ federasiyo / gutanga` kuri node B.
federation.h2p2: Ibahasha: `{isoko_node, intego_user, imbere_ciphertext, imbere_nonce, yoherejwe_at, sig}`. Sig ikubiyemo ibintu byose usibye sig ubwayo.
federation.h2p3: Node B igenzura umukono kuri `source_node` pubkey kuva kumeza yayo ya 'federasiyo'. Sig itemewe → 401 + igikorwa cyo kugenzura.
federation.h3p1: Niba B itagerwaho, umurongo muri `federasiyo_outbox (intego_node, umutwaro, kugerageza, ubutaha_ibikorwa_)).
federation.h3p2: Gusubira inyuma: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, byafashwe saa 6h. Kunanirwa burundu nyuma yiminsi 14.
federation.h3p3: Operator yamenyesheje umuriro mugihe ubujyakuzimu bwa> ubutumwa 1000 - bwerekana ihuza rya federasiyo.
federation.h4p1: Buri 60 s buri node ihindura `GET / v1 / ubuzima` kuri buri rungano. Igihe cyo gusubiza + imiterere ikurikiranwa.
federation.h4p2: Amanota yubuzima: intangiriro 100. Buri gihe cyigihe gikuramo 1; buri ntsinzi yongeraho 1 (cap 100). Amanota 0 → federasiyo yahagaritse urungano.
federation.h4p3: Byatangajwe binyuze kuri `GET / v1 / urungano` kubakoresha ibibaho.
federation.h1_a: Federasiyo muri Vortex ni isano-yo kwizerana hagati yabakozi babiri. Buri node itangaza 32-byte Ed25519 urufunguzo rusange; irindi node ryiyongera kumeza ya `yizewe_node 'kuruhande rwanyuma hamwe n amanota yubuzima.
federation.h1_b: Ongeraho igituba cyizewe gisaba uyikoresha gusinyira icyifuzo cya admin hamwe nurufunguzo rwo kurekura. UI yerekana urutoki rwa kure muburyo bwa 64-hex-char kugirango abadamu bashobore kugenzura hanze. Bimaze kongerwaho, ibahasha ya federasiyo yinjira igenzurwa neza nu mukono wa Ed25519 umukono - impapuro mpimbano zihita zimenyekana hanyuma zikandikwa. Kwamburwa biroroshye: umurongo ugumaho ikimenyetso 'wavanyweho_at` kugirango ugenzurwe, ariko umukono w ibahasha birananirana.
federation.h1_c: Igishushanyo gikomoka kuri federasiyo ya Matrix (aho buri seriveri yamamaza urufunguzo rwo gusinya kandi ibyabaye byose bigasinywa nayo) no kuri imeri ya DKIM (aho DNS itangaza igituba cyo gusinya). Matrix yerekanye icyitegererezo gikora mubipimo - umuyoboro wabo ufite seriveri zirenga 100k. Impinduka ya Vortex iratandukanye isaba opt-in mu buryo bweruye aho kuba Matrix "seriveri iyo ari yo yose ishobora guhuriza hamwe byanze bikunze"; twacuruzaga ibyoroshye kugirango twirinde bikomeye kurwanya federasiyo.
federation.h1_f:
umurongo wizewe_node:
  igituba: 32 bytes Ed25519
  iherezo: https: //…
  ubuzima_ibisobanuro: int [0, 100]
  wongeyeho_at: unix_ms
  wongeyeho_by: admin_user_id
  yakuweho_at: unix_ms | NULL
federation.h2_a: Ubutumwa bwambukiranya ubutumwa butwara ibahasha imwe E2E nki yaho, izengurutswe mu ibahasha yo hanze yashyizweho umukono yemeza koherezwa kuri node yakira.
federation.h2_b: Node A irashaka kugeza kubakoresha @ B. Intambwe ya 1: Urukurikirane `{isoko_node, intego_user, imbere_ciphertext, imbere_nonce, yoherejwe_at}`. Intambwe ya 2: Ikimenyetso cya byite ikurikiranye hamwe na Ed25519 urufunguzo rwihariye → `sig`. Intambwe ya 3: POSTs kuri tuple kuri `POST / federasiyo / gutanga` kuri node B. Intambwe ya 4: B ireba hejuru" source_node "muri` yizewe_node ", igenzura` sig`, igenzura `sent_at` ikarwanya idirishya, kandi igakomeza ibahasha yimbere mumeza yaho" ubutumwa ". Umukiriya yakiriye abona neza nkubutumwa bwaho - urwego rwa federasiyo ntirugaragara kubakoresha amaherezo.
federation.h2_c: Ibahasha yasinywe hanze yatijwe muri Matrix ya `m.room.message` ibirori bya federasiyo. Idirishya risubiramo (iminota 5) nibisabwa ko inkomoko-yashyizweho umukono igihe cyerekana urukuta rwatijwe DKIM. Kera Vortex (v0.0.2) yagerageje federasiyo idashyizweho umukono hamwe na TLS abakiriya; twahinduye kwishyura imikono yo kwishyurwa muri v0.0.5 nyuma yo kubona ko abakiriya ba cert badashobora kubaho kuringaniza imizigo no guhisha ibyemezo nyirizina bivuye murwego rwo gusaba.
federation.h3_a: Iyo node ya kure itagerwaho, kohereza node umurongo uhasha ibahasha muri `federation_outbox` hanyuma ukongera ukagaruka inyuma.
federation.h3_b: Gahunda yo gusubira inyuma: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, yafashwe saa 6h. Kuri buri kintu cyananiye kugerageza umurongo "kugerageza" inkingi yiyongera kandi `ubutaha_kugerageza_yashyizweho kuri ubu + intambwe-ntambwe. Umukozi winyuma (`porogaramu / federasiyo / outbox_worker.py`) akangura buri s 5 agatora umurongo aho` ubutaha_kugerageza_at <= ubungubu () `. Intsinzi isiba umurongo; Iminsi 14 yo gutsindwa iranga iteka kandi wohereze imenyesha rya admin.
federation.h3_c: Kugaruka inyuma hamwe nigisenge nuburyo bumwe Kafka akoresha kubisubiramo kandi SMTP ikoresha kubutumwa bwanditse. Umupira wiminsi 14 uhuye na SMTP's RFC 5321. Impapuro zambere zakoresheje 60-isegonda isubiramo itera inkuba-amashyo mugihe urungano rwagarutse kumurongo nyuma yo guhagarara; ikwirakwizwa ryerekanwe ko muri v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
gutinda (n) = min (6h, 1s · 2ⁿ) kuri n = 0, 1, 2,…

gusubiramo gahunda: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s,…, 6h
kwitondera: outbox_depth> 1000 kuri> 5 min
federation.h4_a: Buri masegonda 60 buri node ihindura buri rungano rwa `/ v1 / ubuzima`. Amanota agenda hejuru yubutsinzi, hasi kunanirwa, bigarukira kuri [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Amanota atangirira kuri 100 on on. Buri ntsinzi yongeraho +1 (ifashwe kuri 100), buri gihe cyo gukuramo -1 (hasi kuri 0). Amanota 0 arahagarika federasiyo kuri urungano - ubutumwa bushya butonda umurongo muri outbox, ntagishya cyo gutanga ibicuruzwa bigerageza kugeza amanota azamutse hejuru ya 20. Amanota agaragazwa binyuze kuri `GET / v1 / urungano 'kubikoresho byabakozi kandi binyuze kuri` / metrics` kuri Prometheus. Amanota atunguranye agabanuka murungano rwinshi mumadirishya magufi atera "ibice byurusobe bikekwa".
federation.h4_c: Amanota AIMD yuburyo bwahumetswe n window1⟫ idirishya ryumubyigano hamwe nubuzima bwa Akamai. Intambwe idasanzwe ± 1 intambwe (aho kugirango TCP igabanuke) ituma gukira bitinda kuruta gutsindwa, kubogama kuri sisitemu yo kwitonda - twahitamo guhagarika federasiyo mugihe tutazi neza kuruta kohereza ubutumwa bwikopi binyuze kumurongo uhuza. Wongeyeho muri v0.0.6 nyuma yurungano rwitwaye nabi rwuzuza urungano rwiza rwiza rwongeye kugerageza.
federation.h4_f:
ku ntsinzi: amanota = min (100, amanota + 1)
ku gihe cyagenwe: amanota = max (0, amanota - 1)
niba amanota == 0: pause_federation (urungano)
niba amanota> = 20: reume_federation (urungano) // hystereze

gossip.title: Gosoma hamwe no kuvumbura urungano
gossip.subtitle: Nigute imitwe ibonana idafite rejisitiri nkuru.
gossip.intro: Kurenga kurutonde rwabashinzwe kugenzura, Vortex node gusebanya urungano hagati yabo. Ibi bivumbura imitwe mishya nkuko abayikora bazunguruka, nubwo umugenzuzi atarabihamya.
gossip.h1p1: Buri 60 s, node itoranya urungano rudasanzwe kandi ikohereza 256-bit ya Bloom muyunguruzi ya bagenzi bawe bazwi. Urungano rusubiza hamwe nabagenzi NOT muyungurura, wongeyeho akayunguruzo. Umuyoboro mugari ni `O (urungano rushya × 32 bytes)`, mubisanzwe munsi ya 1 KiB kumuzingo.
gossip.h1p2: Urungano rwamamajwe rwashyizweho umukono nu kwamamaza. Abakiriya bagenzura imikono kubonana bwa mbere - uwagabye igitero ntashobora guhimba urungano mu gusebanya.
gossip.h1p3: Uruziga ntarengwa-igipimo: guhana umwe kuri urungano kuri 30 s (idirishya ryo kunyerera).
gossip.h2p1: Imyanya mishya itangirana na 8 igoye ya bootstrap igenzura. Urusaku rwambere ruvumbura urungano rwinshi; umuyoboro uhurira mu minota ~ 1.
gossip.h2p2: Urutonde rwa Bootstrap rushobora guhindurwa binyuze kuri `.env`` BOOTSTRAP_PEERS = pubkey1 @ impera1, igituba2 @ impera2, ... `.
gossip.h3p1: Urungano rwamamajwe rugomba gusinywa nurufunguzo rwo gusohora Ed25519. Guhimbira urungano bisaba kwiba urufunguzo rwemewe.
gossip.h3p2: Icyemezo-cyakazi (kirashobora guhindurwa, isanzwe 2 ^ 18 iyobora zeru) kurutonde rushya rwurungano rutuma ubwinshi bwa Sybil-bot waves bidashoboka.
gossip.h3p3: Sisitemu yo kwamamara: urungano rwitwara nabi (imikono mibi, amatangazo mpimbano, igihe cyateganijwe) bafite izina ryangirika. Icyubahiro cya zeru list urutonde rwabirabura.
gossip.h1_a: Buri 60 s buri node itoranya urungano rudasanzwe kandi ikohereza 256-bit ya Bloom muyunguruzi ivuga muri make urungano ruzwi. Urungano rusubiza hamwe nabagenzi bashya + muyungurura. Umuyoboro mugari ni `O (ibishya_ibikoresho × 32 bytes)`.
gossip.h1_b: Shungura akayunguruzo k = 5 hashes, m = 256 bits. Node A yinjizamo urungano rwarwo rwose. Kohereza urungano B. B ibaza akayunguruzo na buri rungano rwayo; ikintu cyose kibuze, B yohereza kuri A (hiyongereyeho akayunguruzo kayo). A ikora igenzura rimwe muburyo butandukanye. Nyuma yo guhana impande zombi zisangira ubumenyi bumwe. Guhana bisanzwe: 200-800 bytes. Ivugurura rihurira kumurongo muri ~ 5 kuzenguruka (iminota 5) dukesha imitungo yo gusebanya.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter gusebanya byanditswe na Cornell yo muri 1998 bimodal impapuro nyinshi. Apache Cassandra ayikoresha mubanyamuryango; Bitcoin yo kugurisha; IPFS yo kubungabunga DHT. Umutungo wa O (log N) uhuza nibyo bituma ukora neza kugirango dukoreshe - ntidukeneye ibitekerezo byisi, gusa amaherezo-yubumenyi bwurungano. Ingano ya filteri (256 bits) irateguwe kuburyo igipimo cyiza-cyiza ari <1% kuri 100 murungano.
gossip.h2_a: Imyanya mishya itangirana na 8 igoye ya bootstrap igenzura. Urusaku rwa mbere ruzenguruka ruvumbura byinshi; guhurira mu minota ~ 1.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` amato hamwe na` BOOTSTRAP_PEERS = igituba1 @ impera1, igituba2 @ impera2, ... `. Mugutangira, node igerageza buri kimwe murutonde. Banza gusubiza bitanga urutonde rwambere rwurungano (ukoresheje `GET / v1 / wizeye_node`). Node yinjiza ibyo mumeza yabagenzi baho, ibashyiraho ikimenyetso, kandi itangira 60 s gusebanya. Ibizakurikiraho bivumbura urungano-rwurungano.
gossip.h2_c: Bootstraps ya Hardcoded nuburyo bumwe Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS gukoresha. Ubundi buryo - DHT bushingiye kubuvumbuzi - bisaba kwinjira byambere. Vortex ya 8 bootstrap ibarwa yatoranijwe kuko kugira> 4 bitanga kwihanganira ibyabaye 2-3 icyarimwe, kandi <16 bituma dosiye ya .env isomeka. Hindura kuri buri gikorwa uhindura `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Urungano rwamamajwe rugomba gusinywa nurufunguzo rwarwo rwa Ed25519. Igitero ntigishobora guhimba urungano murusobe.
gossip.h3_b: Iyo node A yamamaza urungano P mu gusebanya kuri node B, A ikubiyemo `P.pubkey`,` P.endpoint`, na timestamp, byose byashyizweho umukono nurufunguzo rwo kurekura P. B igenzura umukono mbere yo kwizera P. Niba B nyuma ihuza P na P's TLS icyemezo + umutima wambere wumutima udahuye nigituba cyamamajwe, iyamamaza ryanditseho uburozi kandi rikwirakwizwa hepfo.
gossip.h3_c: Urungano rwamamaza rwasinywe ni anti-Sybil primitive kuva Chord (2001) na Kademlia (2002). Ubutumwa bwa addr bwa Bitcoin bukoresha moderi idakomeye (nta sinyatire, ishingiye kubiciro byihuza nka Sybil deterrent); Ibimenyetso bya disiki ya Ethereum. Vortex yemeye kwamamaza byashyizweho umukono muri v0.0.6 nyuma yuko igitero cya testnet cyamamaje urungano 1000 rwibinyoma binyuze mumutwe umwe wemewe.
gossip.h1_f:
muyunguruzi: k = 5, m = 256 bits
shyiramo (x) = kuri i muri 0..k: gushungura [hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
ikibazo (x) = kuri i muri 0..k: reba akayunguruzo [hash_i (x) mod m]
ibinyoma-byiza kuri bagenzi be 100, bits 256, k = 5: ~ 0.4%
gossip.h2_f:
.env:
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS = abcd… @ https: //a.urugero ,efgh…@https: //b.urugero

gutangira:
  kurungano muri BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    gerageza: urungano ← urungano.get ('/ v1 / kwizerwa_node'); kuruhuka
    usibye: komeza
  tangira gusebanya

stealth.title: Umuyoboro wubujura
stealth.subtitle: Inzego eshanu, uburyo 28. Ibintu byose kuva TLS padding kugeza kuri serivisi yigitunguru cya Tor.
stealth.intro: Vortex ifata umwanzi-urwego-rwigihugu. Ububiko bwibanga butondekanye kuburyo niyo iyo hanze yinyuma irengerwa, iyimbere iracyatanga serivise yangiritse-ariko-ikora.
stealth.h1p1: Igice cya 1 - gusohora urutoki. Hagarika ibyiciro bya pasiporo.
stealth.h1p2: Igice cya 2 - imiterere / ingano ya morfing. Guhagarika ibinyabiziga-gusesengura ibyiciro.
stealth.h1p3: Igice cya 3 - protokole yamashusho. Hagarika gukora DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Igice cya 4 - gutwara ibicuruzwa. Akora mumiyoboro ihagarika ibyibanze byacu.
stealth.h1p5: Igice cya 5 - gusubira inyuma. Igitunguru, BMP, ibyerekezo byinshi. Akora mugihe ntakindi gikora.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello ihuye na Chrome kuri Windows 11 byte-kuri-byte. JA3/JA4 hash ihuye na Chrome 120 - nta Vortex yihariye igikumwe.
stealth.h2p2: Kwandika-layer padding: inyandiko zose TLS zanditse kuri 16 KB. Ingano yipaki ihuye nurujya n'uruza rwinshi rwa mushakisha.
stealth.h2p3: Igipimo gihoraho cyohereza: umurongo wohereza ikadiri imwe buri N ms utitaye kubikorwa byo gusaba. Ibihe bidakorwa bisohora amakadiri ya dummy agaragara mu ibahasha y'imbere kugirango abayakira bayata.
stealth.h2p4: Igihe cyagenwe: 0-50 ms gutinda kuri egress kugirango utsinde ubukererwe bushingiye DPI.
stealth.h3p1: Youtube-720p morpher: gukwirakwiza ubunini bwa paki, guturika cadence, hamwe no guceceka bihuye na YouTube nzima. Ibyiciro bishakisha intumwa z'umutima byananiranye.
stealth.h3p2: Inzira nyinshi: imigezi imwe yagabanijwe hejuru ya Wi-Fi, selile, nibindi byose VPN icyarimwe. Kongera guterana kubakira. Gutsinda inzira imwe.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC umuyoboro wamakuru wamakuru: iyo TLS ihagaritswe ariko WebRTC ikora, Vortex tunel ikoresheje umuyoboro wa DTLS-SRTP kugeza murungano ruzwi.
stealth.h3p4: Guhuza uburiganya: 3 igihe kirekire kidafite akazi TLS amasomo kuri Google, YouTube, na Cloudflare. Indorerezi ibona imyitwarire isanzwe ya mushakisha.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): byose DNS byakemuwe binyuze kuri DoH kugeza Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP ibona HTTPS gusa kuri abo bakemura, ntabwo urutonde nyirizina.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Muraho): SNI ihishe hamwe nurufunguzo rwatangajwe muri DNS HTTPS. Indorerezi zidashobora kubona aho zerekeza.
stealth.h4p3: Kumenya neza: node ikurikirana ibyifuzo nta somo ryanditse. Ubushakashatsi butatu bwatsinzwe kuva IP mu minota 5 butera uburyo bwa "buriganya" - ko IP ubu ibona urupapuro rwerekana HTML rwuzuye hamwe na 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA. Niba iherezo ryibanze ryahagaritswe, abakiriya babara umukandida ukurikira bakagerageza.
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / igicucu: ibisanzwe V2Ray-uburyo bwo gutwara ibintu hamwe na plugable JSON config.
stealth.h5p2: Ukuri: TLS-muri-TLS umuyoboro. Intego yo guhana intoki hanze www.microsoft.com; guterana imbere ni Vortex. Ibibazo birwanya hanze byoherezwa kuri Microsoft kuburyo gukora cyane ntacyo bihishura.
stealth.h5p3: Urubura: Urubuga rwabakorerabushake batanga Vortex traffic hejuru ya WebRTC. Abakoresha bashiraho umugabane wa Snowflake batanga igifuniko.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: ihindura HTTPS probe kugirango ihuze imyitwarire ya Chromium ubwayo kugeza kuri microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Serivise yigitunguru: buri node nayo yigaragaza nka `.onion`. Abakiriya bafite inkunga ya Tor bagwa kuriyi mugihe ibindi byose binaniwe.
stealth.h6p2: Impumyi ya Mailbox Protocole (BMP): ububiko butazwi-na-imbere kubutumwa. Reba BMP igice.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: ubutumwa bushobora gutambuka kugeza kuri 5 intera intera, buri kimwe kongeramo urwego rw ibahasha. Nka Tor ariko muri mesh yacu.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): utibagiwe HTTP binyuze muri relay. Nta shyaka na rimwe ribona ibyifuzo n'ibisubizo.
stealth.h1_a: Ubujura butunganijwe nkibice bitanu byigenga. Buri cyiciro cyatsinze urwego rutandukanye rwabanzi. Kunanirwa kurwego rumwe bitesha agaciro kurindi - ntibishobora.
stealth.h1_b: Igice cya 1 gisanzwe urutoki rwa TLS kugirango pasive DPI idashobora gutondeka. Igice cya 2 morphs imiterere yumuhanda kugirango isa nkigenda. Igice cya 3 gifotora protocole ukoresheje ECH / DoH / amayeri yo gusubiza. Igice cya 4 gihindura uburyo bwo gutwara ibintu (vmess, ukuri, Snowflake) mugihe primaire ihagaritswe cyane. Igice cya 5 nicyanyuma-kuruhuka: Igitunguru cya Tor, BMP, ibyerekezo byinshi.
stealth.h1_c: Icyitegererezo cyaturutse kuri Tor's plugable-transport transport (2013). Vortex yongeyeho ibice bitanu aho kuba bitatu bya Tor kuko muri 2025 ahantu nyaburanga harimo DPI yamenyaga ubwikorezi bwa Tor ubwabo (Great Firewall 2020, Irani 2022). Buri cyiciro cya Vortex cyatangijwe nyuma y’ibyabaye mu murima: L1 nyuma yo guhagarika Qazaqistan (bihwanye na 2019), L2 nyuma y’igitero cya Irani mu 2022, L3 nyuma y’Ubushinwa bwa DoH 2020, L4 nyuma y’ibitero 2023 bya Turukiya, L5 mu rwego rwo kwitegura.
stealth.h1_f:
Icyiciro cy'abanzi | Yatsinzwe na
------------------ | -----------
passiw DPI | L1 (igikumwe)
isesengura ry'umuhanda | L2 (imiterere)
ikora DPI | L3 (amashusho)
guhagarika by IP | L4 (transport)
ibindi byose | L5 (igitunguru / BMP)
stealth.h2_a: Igice cya 1 gituma Vortex traffic idashobora gutandukana na Chrome kuri Windows 11 kurwego rwa TLS.
stealth.h2_b: Umukiriya Mwaramutse gutumiza, kwagura urutonde, urutonde rwa cipher suite, ALPN indangagaciro - byose byahujwe kugirango bihuze na Chrome 120 byuzuye. JA3/JA4 hash ihuye na Chrome isohoka. TLS kwandika padding kugeza 16 KB. Uhoraho-wohereje asohora ikadiri imwe N ms hamwe na dummy yuzuza mugihe idafite akazi. Igihe cya jitter 0-50 ms kugirango batsinde isesengura ryubukererwe. Kuriganya guhuza kuri Google, YouTube, Cloudflare ukore inyuma kuri 45 s intera.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 igikumwe cyashyizwe ahagaragara naba injeniyeri ba Salesforce muri 2017. Muri 2019 byari bisanzwe mubucuruzi DPI. Vortex isanzwe yerekana urutoki rwerekanwe kuri uTLS, isomero rya Go Snowflake ikoresha kubwintego imwe. Kohereza igipimo gihoraho ni icyambu cya WireGuard "icyifuzo cyo gutwara ibinyabiziga".
stealth.h3_a: Igice cya 2 morphs traffic kugirango isa nkibitangazamakuru byinshi bitemba aho kuganira.
stealth.h3_b: Youtube-720p morpher: gukwirakwiza ubunini bwa packet ihuye na 720p ya YouTube ya Live (imbonerahamwe ifatika), umukino wa cadence waturika, umukino wo guceceka. Inzira nyinshi: inzira imwe yumvikana yatandukanijwe hejuru ya Wi-Fi, selile, nibindi byose VPN icyarimwe; uwakiriye yongeye guterana muburyo bukurikirana. WebRTC umuyoboro wamakuru ugaruka: iyo TLS ihagaritswe ariko WebRTC ikanyura, umuyoboro Vortex unyuze kuri DTLS-SRTP umuyoboro wamakuru kuri urungano ruzwi.
stealth.h3_c: Ubushakashatsi bwa morfing traffic busubira muri Wright n'abandi. 2009. Youtube yihariye yatoranijwe kubera ko ari urubuga rumwe runini rudahagaritswe mu miyoboro myinshi ibuza - kwihisha mu muhanda umeze nka YouTube "bihisha mu bantu".
stealth.h3_f:
packet_size [i] ~ P (ubunini | YT-720p)
ohereza_delay [i] ~ P (gutinda | YT-720p)
dummy_frames yinjijwe mugihe idafite akazi kugirango ibungabunge imiterere y ibahasha
stealth.h4_a: Igice cya 3 gifotora indangamuntu ya protocole ubwayo - SNI, DNS, kode yo gusubiza.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS yose inyura DNS-hejuru-HTTPS kugeza Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP ibona HTTPS gusa kubo bakemura. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI ihishe hamwe nurufunguzo rwatangajwe muri DNS HTTPS. Indorerezi zireba gusa imbere-impera IP. Ubushakashatsi bwerekana: node ikurikirana IP idakubita `/ api / *`; bitatu byananiranye mu minota 5 fungura IP kuri "uburyo bwo kubeshya" - ko IP ubu ibona page HTML ihagaze hamwe na 200 OK. DGA: generator ya domaine itanga imbuto hamwe nitariki yuyu munsi kugirango abakiriya babone kugaruka mugihe primaire ihagaritswe.
stealth.h4_c: DoH yatangije muri Firefox 2018 ihinduka umwimerere wa Chrome muri 2019. ECH yanyuze mu mishinga itanu mbere yo kugenwa muri 2024 - Vortex yoherejwe inkunga mugihe cyateguwe-13 none ishyigikiye icyiciro cya nyuma. Uburiganya bwibisubizo byakuwe mubishushanyo mbonera bya 2014 kandi binonosorwa mu 2023 nyuma yuko abashinzwe iperereza ba Irani bagaragaje ubugwaneza mugihe cyo gusubiza.
stealth.h5_a: Igice cya 4 gikoresha ubwikorezi bworoshye - tunel-y-igice cya gatatu gisa nkikindi kintu cyose.
stealth.h5_b: vmess / vless / trojan: ibisanzwe V2Ray-uburyo bwo gutwara abantu hanze; Kugena JSON. Ukuri: TLS-muri-TLS umuyoboro aho intoki zo hanze zigamije www.microsoft.com; guterana imbere ni Vortex. Iperereza rifatika ryo hanze ryoherejwe kuri Microsoft, bityo rero iperereza ntacyo rihishura. Urubura: Urubuga rwabakorerabushake batanga Vortex hejuru ya WebRTC; nta infra kuruhande rwacu. NaiveProxy: ihindura HTTPS iperereza kugirango rihuze imyitwarire ya Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: VMess ya V2Ray yatangijwe mu 2015 n’umuryango w’abashinwa barwanya ubugenzuzi. Trojan yatangijwe muri 2019. Ukuri ni kuva 2022 - igisubizo kuri Great Firewall TLS gutunga urutoki. Snowflake ni Tor Project yo gusimbuza 2020 obfs4; Vortex yongeyeho inkunga muri v0.0.9 nyuma ya Irani 2023 yuzuye yuzuye ya Tor yinjira.
stealth.h5_f:
urugero rwukuri:
  seriveri Izina: www.microsoft.com
  intego: www.microsoft.com:443
  Amagambo magufi: ["<random>"]
umukiriya ahuza na IP, SNI = www.microsoft.com, twemeje igisubizo nyacyo Microsoft
niba inzira ihuye na shortId + auth ⇒ inzira igana Vortex
stealth.h6_a: Igice cya 5 ni umufuka wanyuma wuburiganya bwamayeri: serivisi yigitunguru, BMP ububiko-na-imbere, ibyerekezo byinshi-hop, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Buri node itangaza aderesi ya `.onion`. Abakiriya bafite Tor-ishoboye kwakira igwa iyo TLS + L1-L4 byose birananirana. BMP. amazimwe arakwirakwira; uwakiriye akura murugo rwabo. Multi-hop: ubutumwa butambuka bugera kuri 5 hagati, buri kimwe kongeramo urwego rw ibahasha - nka Tor ariko imbere muri meshi yacu. OHTTP (RFC 9458): utibagiwe HTTP binyuze muri relay kuburyo ntamuburanyi numwe ubona ibyifuzo nibisubizo.
stealth.h6_c: Serivise y'ibitunguru guhera mu 2004 muri Tor. BMP ni ibihangano byacu bwite, byerekanwe kuri Tor yihishe ya serivise isobanura abasebanya. Indorerwamo za Multi-hop zerekana ibimenyetso bya kashe-byohereje wongeyeho igitunguru. OHTTP ni guhera mu 2024, yahimbwe na Cloudflare na Apple kugirango telemetrie ibungabunge ubuzima bwite; twayyemeje muri v0.0.9 nkibisubizo byanyuma.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP agasanduku k'iposita_id = HKDF (uwahawe_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Kubitsa: POST / bmp / kubitsa {agasanduku k'iposita_id, blob}
Gutora: GET / bmp / ubutumwa (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Icyerekezo kinini: 1 MB |  Umubare munini kuri node: 500 MB

bmp.title: Impumyi ya agasanduku k'iposita
bmp.subtitle: Ububiko butazwi-na-imbere kubutumwa binyuze mumazimwe.
bmp.intro: BMP ireka uwagutumye abitsa ubutumwa kuri node iyo ari yo yose atagaragaje umwirondoro. Ubutumwa burasebanya kugeza bugeze murugo rwabakiriye, aho bwifunguye nkuko bisanzwe.
bmp.h1p1: Kohereza akuramo `mailbox_id = HKDF (uwakiriye_pubkey, amakuru:" bmp-v1 ", len: 32)`. Gusa uwayohereje (ninde uzi uwakiriye_pubkey) ashobora kubara; uyahawe nawe arabizi.
bmp.h1p2: Kohereza inyandiko `POST / bmp / ​​kubitsa` hamwe na {{agasanduku k'iposita_id, blob}` kuri buri kintu cyose cyo gusebanya.
bmp.h1p3: Ububiko bubitse hamwe kugeza kuri 7200 s. Node ikubiyemo kandi agasanduku k'iposita_id muri gossip ikurikira ya Bloom filter.
bmp.h1p4: Izindi node zikurura blobs kuri mailbox_ibikoresho bitaho (abahabwa kuri node).
bmp.h1p5: Umukiriya wabakiriya atora `GET / bmp / ​​ubutumwa` kandi akanaburura blobs nshya hamwe nibikoresho bisanzwe byingenzi.
bmp.h2p1: Ntamutwe ushobora guhuza blob nuwohereje - ihuza TLS ryohereje ryerekana inkomoko IP, ariko urunigi rwibitunguru byibitunguru hagati yuwohereje na BMP node ikuraho nabyo.
bmp.h2p2: Uwakiriye-kwihisha: blob ihishe hamwe nigituba cyuwahawe. Hagati yo hagati ireba gusa umugozi wa byte udasobanutse na agasanduku k'iposita_id.
bmp.h2p3: Nta cyemezo cyo gutanga kubohereje. Kuri-inshuro nyinshi.
bmp.h3p1: Ingano nini ya blob: 1 MB. Imizigo minini igomba gukurikiranwa binyuze muri dosiye isanzwe.
bmp.h3p2: Ububiko ntarengwa kuri node: 500 MB yo kubitsa muri rusange. LRU kwirukanwa kuri cap. Abakoresha barashobora gutunganya.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: kuri IP igipimo cyo kubitsa kigarukira kuri 10 / min. Indangamuntu ya posita yagaragaye inshuro zirenga 3 / isaha kuri node imwe ntigabanijwe nkigipimo cyumwuzure.
bmp.h4p1: Abahawe-censorship nyinshi: abohereje ntibakeneye kumenya urugo rwabo.
bmp.h4p2: Guhuza rimwe na rimwe: blobs itegereza kugeza igihe uwakiriye yongeye guhuza no gutora.
bmp.h4p3: Ifirimbi itazwi: igitunguru cyohereje-igitunguru + BMP = nta metadata kubabitse iki.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ni ububiko butazwi-imbere-imbere. Kohereza aterera blob kuri buri kintu cyose gishobora gusebanya; blob itegereza mu gasanduku k'iposita ifunguye gusa urufunguzo rusange rw'uwahawe.
bmp.h1_b: Kohereza kubara `mailbox_id = HKDF (uwakiriye_pubkey," bmp-v1 ", 32)`. Gusa umuntu uzi `uwakiriye_pubkey` arashobora kubara - uwakiriye arabizi, uwayohereje arabizi, undi muntu ntabizi. Kohereza POSTs `{agasanduku k'iposita_id, blob}` kuri buri kintu cyose cyo gusebanya. Node ibika byombi kugeza kuri 7200 s (2 h), kandi itangaza agasanduku k'iposita_id mugihe cyo guhanahana amazimwe Bloom filter. Izindi node zibona agasanduku k'iposita_iduhuza mukoresha agasanduku k'iposita k'umukoresha gukurura blob hanyuma ugana umukiriya wumukoresha.
bmp.h1_c: BMP yateguwe kuva kera nitsinda rya Vortex. Twarayubatse kuko nta ntumwa nyamukuru yashakaga gukoresha ibikoresho bisabwa kugirango ihishe metadata iherezo-iherezo - buri gicuruzwa gikomeye cyohereje ibanga ryibanga ariko gisiga urwego rwo kugemura, bityo seriveri iracyamenya uwaganiriye nande nigihe. Imbere mu ikipe twakomeje kuvuga "intumwa itekanye isohora imbuga nkoranyambaga ni kimwe cya kabiri gifite umutekano." BMP ni igisubizo cyacu: uwayohereje, uwahawe, n'ibirimo byose biba byiza; ntamutwe numwe muri mesh ufata ibice bihagije kugirango wongere ikiganiro. Ikora hejuru ya Vortex yonyine yo gusebanya aho kuba ibikorwa remezo bihamye, aribyo byatumye igiciro cyubucuruzi cyumvikana kandi igishushanyo mbonera kigenzurwa murugo.
bmp.h1_f:
agasanduku k'iposita_id = HKDF (uwakiriye_pubkey, amakuru = "bmp-v1", len = 32)

Kubitsa: POST / bmp / kubitsa {agasanduku k'iposita_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Tangaza: amazimwe Bloom filter + = agasanduku k'iposita_id
Gutora: GET / bmp / ubutumwa (auth'd) → blobs kubakoresha agasanduku k'iposita_id
TTL: 7200 s |  ububiko buri kuri node: 500 MB |  igipimo cyo kubitsa: 10 / min / IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP itanga ibintu bitatu byigenga byigenga: kubohereza-guhisha, kubakira-guhisha, guhisha ibintu.
bmp.h2_b: Kohereza-kwihisha: TLS guhuza no kubitsa byerekana isoko IP; kongeramo Tor hop cyangwa igitunguru cyayobowe nigitunguru kuri node ya mbere BMP ikuraho ibyo. Uwakiriye-kwihisha: agasanduku k'iposita_id ni inzira imwe ya hash uwakiriye_pubkey umunyu hamwe numugozi wa BMP - urwego rwagati rubona ikiranga 32-byte. Guhisha ibirimo: blob yamaze E2E-ihishe kubantu bahabwa ukoresheje urufunguzo rusanzwe rwa Vortex / DM, bityo rero hagati yo hagati ibona ciphertext gusa.
bmp.h2_c: Imiterere-yimitungo itatu nuburyo Pond yasobanuye intego zayo muri 2014. Vortex yarayinonosoye ikora agasanduku k'iposita_id ishobora kugongana (256-bit hash) kuburyo abakoresha babiri badafitanye isano badashobora gusangira agasanduku k'iposita. 7200-isegonda TTL iva mukureba ko 95% byabakiriye muri beta yacu bakuyemo 2 h; birebire TTL byazamutse kuri buri bubiko nta nyungu zigaragara zitangwa.
bmp.h2_f:
Umwanzi ubona node leta:
  - izi mailbox_id ibaho mugihe T.
  - ese NOT izi uwagutumye (yari TLS / Tor hop kure)
  - ese NOT izi uwakiriye (agasanduku k'iposita_id ni inzira imwe hash)
  - ese NOT izi ibirimo (blob ni E2E-ibanga)
bmp.h3_a: Imipaka ikaze kubunini bwa blob, kubika kuri node, no kubitsa bituma BMP idahinduka igabanuka ryamakuru atabishaka.
bmp.h3_b: Ingano nini ya blob: 1 MB. Imizigo minini igomba gucamo binyuze muri sisitemu isanzwe ya dosiye, ifite inzira yo kubika. Ububiko bunini kuri node: 500 MB yose hamwe yabikijwe BMP. Iyo ingofero igeze, kwirukanwa-kera-guta ibitonyanga mbere yuko TTL - abakoresha bashobora guhinduka binyuze kuri `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Igipimo cyo kubitsa kuri IP: 10 kumunota, kugirango wirinde umwuzure uturutse kumutera umwe. Indangamuntu ya posita yagaragaye inshuro zirenga 3 / isaha murusobekerane ntarengwa-nk "" ukekwaho kwibasirwa n’umwuzure ".
bmp.h3_c: Igikoresho cya 1 MB gihuye na IRC DCC-kohereza amasezerano hamwe na kashe ya kashe yoherejwe-yoherejwe - binini bihagije kubutumwa bugufi na thumbnail, bito bihagije kuburyo igitero kidashobora gukoresha BMP kugirango yakire dosiye. 500 MB kuri node ni OSS-isanzwe yumvikana; abakora ibikorwa binini bazamura hamwe na `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Igipimo cyibipimo cyaje nyuma ya beta v0.0.8 aho ikizamini cyikizamini cyuzuza imitwe 50 hamwe nabitsa muminota 20.
bmp.h3_f:
imipaka:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # kumunota kuri IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # agasanduku k'iposita_idisaha
bmp.h4_a: BMP irabagirana muburyo butatu: abahawe-kugenzura cyane, abahuza rimwe na rimwe, gutangaza amakuru atazwi.
bmp.h4_b: Igenzura ryinshi: uwayohereje ntazi urugo rwabakiriye (kandi birashoboka ko atabigeraho uko byagenda kose). Tera urungano urwo arirwo rwose, reka inzira yo gusebanya. Guhuza umwanya muto: uwakiriye ari kumurongo kumasaha; blob irategereza, nta gusubiramo bikenewe. Ifirimbi itazwi: kohereza igitunguru-igitunguru + BMP = nta metadata yerekeye uwabitse iki. Uhujwe nurufunguzo rwicyumba ruzwi gusa kumashyaka yizewe, ibirimo nabyo ntibisobanutse kubantu bose.
bmp.h4_c: Imanza eshatu zikoreshwa zikurikirana intego zamateka yibitonyanga byapfuye mubutasi bwumubiri (ibihe byabasoviyeti), kuri `alt.anonymous.messages` kuri Usenet (1990), no kuri SecureDrop (2013 gukomeza). BMP nugushaka kuzana ayo mateka mubutumwa bugezweho tudakeneye igikoresho cyihariye.

push.title: Shyira amatangazo
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Urubuga Push - byose bifite amabahasha afunze kugirango abatanga badashobora gusoma.
push.intro: Serivisi zisanzwe zo gusunika (APNs, FCM, Urubuga Push) reba buri mutwaro. Vortex kuzinga buri menyesha muburyo butandukanye E2E kugirango uwabitanze abone gusa blob blop idafite icyumba id, uwagutumye, cyangwa inyandiko.
push.h1p1: Umukiriya abona ikimenyetso cya platform (ikimenyetso cya APNs igikoresho, FCM id yo kwiyandikisha, cyangwa abiyandikisha kuri Web Push JWT).
push.h1p2: Umukiriya atanga 32-byte nshya X25519 urufunguzo `p256dh_pub` n ibanga rya 16-byte` auth`. POSTs `/ api / gusunika / kwiyandikisha` hamwe na` {iherezo, p256dh, auth, urubuga} `.
push.h1p3: Node ikomeza `gusunika_kwiyandikisha (umukoresha_id, iherezo, p256dh, auth, urubuga, yaremye_at)`.
push.h2p1: Iyo imenyesha rigomba (ubutumwa bushya mucyumba cyahinduwe kigamije kumenyesha, kuvuga, guhamagara ubutumire), node ihisha umushahara hamwe na AES-GCM ukoresheje urufunguzo rukomoka kuri `ECDH (p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` ukoresheje HKDF.
push.h2p2: Ipaki ya pode `{iherezo, TTL, byihutirwa, ingingo: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` kandi yohereza kuri APNs / FCM / Web Push seriveri.
push.h2p3: Utanga ibintu abona gusa `data` (ciphertext) +` ingingo`. Nta bisobanuro bisobanutse.
push.h3p1: Icyumba cy'icyumba cy'urufunguzo: `icyumba: <id>`. Ubutumwa bwinshi mubyumba bimwe busenyuka kubimenyeshwa kurwego rwa OS.
push.h3p2: Kuri buri guhamagarwa: `guhamagara: <id>`. Gusubiza cyangwa kugabanuka bikurura banneri; guhamagarwa gushya gutumira mucyumba kimwe gusimbuza icya kera.
push.h4p1: iOS: Kumenyekanisha Serivisi yo Kumenyesha ibanga muri gahunda ya NSE (itandukanye na porogaramu nkuru). Koresha progaramu imwe ya CryptoKit.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService ibanga muri serivisi yinyuma. Gahunda y'akazi itegura gahunda UI ivugurura iyo porogaramu ibanziriza.
push.h4p3: Urubuga: Umukozi wa Service yifunguye muri SW, ashyiraho imenyesha ryaho akoresheje imenyekanisha ryurubuga API.
push.h5p1: APNs: isaba abatanga ikimenyetso cyagaruwe buri min 60. Token refresh ikorwa hifashishijwe Apple ya `auth-team-id` +` auth-urufunguzo-id` + p8 dosiye yingenzi.
push.h5p2: FCM: umurage HTTP iherezo ryataye agaciro; dukoresha HTTP v1 iherezo hamwe na OAuth2 ibyangombwa bya konti ya serivisi. Kuzunguruka buri 1 h.
push.h5p3: Gusunika Urubuga: VAPID urufunguzo (urufunguzo rumwe kuri node). TTL yafashwe muminsi 28 nabashakisha benshi.
push.h1_a: Umukiriya yandika ikimenyetso cyibikoresho (APNs / FCM / Urubuga Push) hamwe nurufunguzo rushya X25519 hamwe nibanga rya 16-byte.
push.h1_b: Umukiriya atanga `p256dh_priv = rand (32)` na `auth = rand (16)`. Inkomoko `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/ api / gusunika / kwiyandikisha` hamwe na` {iherezo, p256dh, auth, urubuga, umukoresha_agent} `. Node ikomeza `gusunika_kwiyandikisha (umukoresha_id, iherezo, p256dh, auth, urubuga, yaremye_at, iheruka_yongeye_at)`. Kuzunguruka: umukiriya yongeye kwiyandikisha kuri buri porogaramu yatangijwe, igarura `iheruka_yongeye_at`. Kwiyandikisha kurenza iminsi 30 byahanaguwe.
push.h1_c: Imirima ya p256dh + auth ituruka kuri Web Push RFC 8291 (2017). Twongeye kubakoresha kuri APNs na FCM nubwo izo serivisi zidasaba imiterere ifunze - kubikora bikomeza inzira imwe ya code muri bitatu. Mbere v0.0.5 Vortex yohereje imizigo yoroheje binyuze muri serivisi zo gusunika; nyuma ya Apple ya 2022 gusunika ivugurura ryibanga hamwe nibyabaye bitandukanye aho umushinga wa FCM utari wamenyeshejwe nabi, twimuye byose mumabahasha afunze.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519
auth = rand (16)

POST / api / gusunika / kwiyandikisha
  {iherezo, p256dh: hex (p256dh_pub), auth: hex (auth), urubuga}
push.h2_a: Iyo imenyesha ryateganijwe, node ihishe umutwaro kugirango igikoresho cyabakiriye gusa gishobora kugisoma. Serivise yo gusunika (Apple / Google / Mozilla) ibona blob gusa.
push.h2_b: Node itora ephemeral X25519 urufunguzo. Inkomoko `ikm = ECDH (ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Koresha HKDF (umunyu = auth, ikm, amakuru = "aesgcm", len = 32) → urufunguzo. Encrypts `{umutwe, umubiri, icyumba_id, ubutumwa_id}` nka CBOR → AES-GCM hamwe nurufunguzo rukomokaho + rudasanzwe 96-bit nonce. Kohereza `{iherezo, TTL, byihutirwa, ingingo: gusenyuka_key, amakuru: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {umunyu, pub_ephemeral}}` kuri APNs / FCM / Urubuga-Gusunika. Igikoresho cyakira, kwagura / umukozi wa serivisi akora ibintu bimwe byingenzi biva muri revers, decrypts, yerekana kumenyesha.
push.h2_c: Gusunika bifunze ni mu buryo butaziguye Urubuga rwihuta rw'ubutumwa bwogusohora guhera muri 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple ya 2022 ya iOS 16 ivugurura yongeyeho inkunga yo mu rwego rwa mbere yo kwagura serivisi yo kumenyesha ikora ibanga; Android yarayishyigikiye ikoresheje FCM ubutumwa bwamakuru kumyaka. Vortex ni umwe mu ntumwa nke zishyira mu bikorwa byuzuye hamwe na code imwe ku mbuga zose uko ari eshatu - iOS ikoresha `NotificationServiceExtension`, Android ikoresha` FirebaseMessagingService`, Urubuga rukoresha umukozi wa serivisi.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand (32);  ephemeral_pub = ephemeral_priv · G.
ikm = ECDH (ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256 (auth, ikm)
urufunguzo = HKDF-Kwagura (prk, "Ibirimo-Encoding: aes128gcm \ x00", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Kwagura (prk, "Ibirimo-Encoding: nonce \ x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt (urufunguzo, nonce, umutwaro)
ohereza {iherezo, amakuru: umunyu∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct}
push.h3_a: Gufunga urufunguzo birinda imenyekanisha ryinshi kuva mukiganiro kimwe gutondekanya nkibendera ryihariye - OS rihuza imwe.
push.h3_b: Gusenyuka kuri buri cyumba: ingingo = `icyumba: <id>`. APNs ya "apns-gusenyuka-id" na FCM "gusenyuka_key" ubwira OS gusimbuza ibyamenyeshejwe mbere ninsanganyamatsiko imwe. Umukoresha abona banneri imwe kuri buri cyumba nubwo ubutumwa bugeze bangahe. Guhamagarwa gusenyuka: ingingo = `guhamagara: <id>`; guhamagarwa gushya gutumira mucyumba kimwe gusimbuza ibyabanje. Kuri buri kintu: ingingo = `kuvuga: <user>: <icyumba>`; umwe kuvuga banneri kubakoresha-icyumba kimwe.
push.h3_c: Urufunguzo rwo gusenyuka rwongewe kuri APN muri iOS 10 (2016) no kuri FCM muri 2014. Mbere yibyo, guturika ubutumwa bwinshi byatanze ibyapa byinshi-banneri abakoresha banga kimwe. Telegram yatangije icyumba cyo gusenyuka UX muri 2015; buri ntumwa nkuru yarakurikiye. Vortex kwigabanyamo icyumba / guhamagara / kuvuga gusenyuka byaturutse kubitekerezo byabakoresha muri beta ya v0.0.6 ko "guhamagarira ubutumire busimbuza banneri" yumvise nabi - ingingo zitandukanye zarakosoye.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-gusenyuka-id = icyumba: 42 → isimbuza banneri zabanjirije
FCM: gusenyuka_key = guhamagara: 17 → isimbuza banneri zabanjirije
Urubuga: ingingo = kuvuga: u12: r5 → isimbuza banneri zabanjirije
push.h4_a: Buri platform ifite gotchas zayo. iOS ikeneye kwagura serivisi yo kumenyesha; Android ikeneye ubutumwa bwamakuru FCM; Urubuga rukeneye umukozi wa serivisi + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: bundle ya porogaramu yohereza intego ya "NotificationServiceExtension". Sisitemu itanga ibanga ryishyurwa kuri NSE; NSE ifite 30 s ya CPU + 25 MB yibuka kugirango ifungure kandi ihindure imenyesha mbere yuko ryerekanwa. FCM: twohereza ubutumwa bwa "data" (ntabwo ari "notification") kugirango FirebaseMessagingService ya porogaramu ikore igeze - biduha kugenzura niba twerekana banneri. Urubuga Push: umukozi wa serivise ahagarika `gusunika` ibyabaye, kubanga, kwerekana binyuze kuri` self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Uburyo bwa NSE bwatangijwe na Apple muri iOS 10 (2016) kubwubutumwa-bwo gukoresha ubutumwa. Mbere yibyo, intumwa zihererekanya-ziherezo zagombaga guhitamo hagati yimitwaro isanzwe yo gusunika imitwaro (kwiherera-kwanga) no gusunika badge gusa (UX-umwanzi). WhatsApp, Ikimenyetso, Telegram byose byasimbutse kuri NSEs mugihe cyumwaka. Vortex ikurikiza icyitegererezo kimwe.
push.h5_a: Abatanga ibintu byihariye - igice cyigice cyo gusunika. Ubu ni bumwe mu buryo bwibanze buvugwa muri Vortex. Soma igice gikikije imiterere yagutse; iki gice cyegeranya imyitwarire yihariye.
push.h5_b: Incamake yo gushyira mubikorwa "Gutanga ibintu byihariye". Uburyo bwashyizwe mubikorwa muburyo bujyanye na `porogaramu /`, `ios / Modules / Inkomoko /`, cyangwa `android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / java / sol / vortexx / android /`. Module README ihamagarira inzira nyayo ya dosiye.
push.h5_c: Uburyo bwa "Provider-yihariye quirks" bwahindutse hirya no hino Vortex gusohora. Igishushanyo gikomoka kubushakashatsi bwatangajwe hamwe nibikorwa byintumwa zambere. Amateka ya verisiyo muri `CHANGELOG.md` inyandiko iyo buri gice kiguye nicyabimuteye.

controller.title: Serivisi ishinzwe kugenzura
controller.subtitle: Icyemezo cy'ubunyangamugayo, kuvumbura ibyinjira, gukurikirana ubuzima.
controller.intro: Umugenzuzi ni inzira Python itandukanye. Igitero cyacyo ni gito (inzira zigera ku icumi) kandi ikizere cyacyo gishyizwe kumurongo umwe wa Ed25519 urufunguzo rusange rwatetse mubakiriya.
controller.h1p1: `GET / v1 / ubunyangamugayo` - ibisubizo bya attestation. Igishushanyo: `{imiterere, yasinywe_by, yizewe_pubkey, verisiyo, yubatswe_at, ihuye, idahuye, yabuze, inyongera, ubutumwa}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET / v1 / ubuzima` - ubuzima. Igishushanyo: `{imiterere:" ok ", verisiyo, igituba, imibare: {kumurongo, byemewe, byose}}`.
controller.h1p3: `GET / v1 / ibyanditswe` - URL yinjira. Igishushanyo: `[{protocole:" wss "|" https ", url} ...]`.
controller.h1p5: `GET / v1 / wizeye_node` - urungano ruzwi rwa federasiyo.
controller.h1p6: `GET / v1 / umutima utera / {pubkey}` - node nzima. Byakoreshejwe na federasiyo ya federasiyo kugirango kwiyandikisha gushya.
controller.h1p7: `POST / v1 / kwiyandikisha` - urwego rushya rusaba kwizerana. Irasaba kwemererwa na admin keretse `AUTO_APPROVE = ukuri`.
controller.h2p1: Kugaragaza dosiye: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Harimo kuri dosiye BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 umukono.
controller.h2p2: Igisekuru: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Isoma urufunguzo rwo kurekura kuva `urufunguzo / kurekura.key`, kugenda igiti, kwandika bigaragara.
controller.h2p3: Kugenzura: umugenzuzi asoma ikigaragara mugitangira akagereranya na disiki. Gutangira birananirana cyane kudahuye.
controller.h3p1: Indorerwamo zikoresha kode imwe igenzura hamwe nurufunguzo rumwe rwo kurekura rwimuwe hejuru. Abakiriya babona kimwe 'cyashyizweho umukono_by` mu ndorerwamo - inzira imwe yo kumenya indorerwamo mpimbano ni ukugereranya ibibari.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS gutangaza ibyerekanwa kuri imwe mu ndorerwamo. Abakiriya bagerageza muburyo bwambere hamwe nigihe cyateganijwe.
controller.h3p3: `Vortex.sol-mirror /` ububiko muri iyi repo niteguye-kugenda-trycloudflare indorerwamo yiterambere.
controller.h1_a: Umugenzuzi rusange API ubuso ni inzira zigera ku icumi. Byose bito, byose byibanze kuri attestation no kwinjira-URL kuvumbura.
controller.h1_b: `/ v1 / ubunyangamugayo` - umukono ugaragara. `/ v1 / ubuzima` - ubuzima + igituba + imibare. `/ v1 / ibyinjira` - URL yinjira kugirango uhuze. `/ v1 / indorerwamo` - abagenzuzi b'indorerwamo. `/ v1 / kwizerwa_node` - urungano rwa federasiyo. `/ v1 / umutima utera / {pubkey}` - node nzima. `/ v1 / kwiyandikisha` - node nshya isaba kwizerana (kwemeza umuyobozi keretse` AUTO_APPROVE = ukuri`). Nibyo - bigufi nkana kugirango igitero kibe gito.
controller.h1_c: Igishushanyo-gishushanyo mbonera kimenyeshwa no kwitegereza ko inzira ya attestation ihinduka intego-yohejuru cyane iyo abakiriya bamaze kuyitera. Kode ntoya = ubuso buto. Gereranya na node ifite inzira 120+; umugenzuzi afite 12. Imiterere isa: Debian's apt-get yizera akantu gato `Release.gpg` inzira itandukanye na pack hosting.
controller.h2_b: Igikoresho gisoma `urufunguzo / kurekura.key` (32-byte Ed25519 urufunguzo rwihariye). Kugenda `vortex_controller /` + `porogaramu /` (ukuyemo dosiye za gitignored). Kuri buri dosiye: `blake3 (ibirimo) → hash`. Yubaka igaragara {{verisiyo, yubatswe_at, dosiye: [{inzira, sha256, ingano}]} `. Ibarura `canonical_bytes = CBOR (kwigaragaza)`. Ibimenyetso: `sig = Ed25519-Ikimenyetso (kurekura_key, Canonical_bytes)`. Yandika `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {kwigaragaza, yashyizweho umukono_by: igituba, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Ibimenyetso byashyizweho umukono bisubira muri Release ya Debian.gpg (1997) na PGP byashyizweho umukono na Linux ya kernel ya kernel. Sigstore (2021) yatunganije icyitegererezo cyo gutanga amasoko. Verisiyo ya Vortex iremereye cyane kuko yerekana koherezwa rimwe, ntabwo ari amashyaka menshi yo kurekura. Turashobora kwemeza Sigstore muri v0.4 kugirango dusohore kumugaragaro.
controller.h3_a: Indorerwamo zikoresha kode imwe hamwe nurufunguzo rumwe rwo kurekura. Inshuro nyinshi DNS / SNS / IPFS ibyinjira byerekana imwe mu ndorerwamo nyinshi.
controller.h3_b: Abakoresha bashiraho indorerwamo N (mubisanzwe 3-5). Buriwese akora kode imwe ya "vortex_controller" hamwe na `urufunguzo / kurekura.key`. Abakiriya babona kimwe `cyashyizweho umukono_by` hejuru yindorerwamo - kugenzura neza. DNS/SNS/IPFS yanditse urutonde rwindorerwamo hamwe nibyingenzi. Abakiriya bagerageza muburyo bwambere, hamwe 7-isegonda yigihe cyo kugerageza. `Vortex.sol-mirror /` ububiko muri iyi repo ni pre-wired trycloudflare indorerwamo.
controller.h3_c: Indorerwamo nyinshi hamwe nubushakashatsi bwibanze nuburyo bumwe SMTP ikoresha kuri MX inyandiko na HTTPS ikoresha SRV inyandiko. Ubuyobozi bwa Tor nubuyobozi bufitanye isano - amajwi 9 ya DAs + amajwi. Vortex yahisemo "hitamo indorerwamo ikora" hejuru ya "quorum vote" kubera ko ibishushanyo bishingiye ku majwi birushaho gukomera ariko bitinda cyane kuri bootstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/ v1 / ubunyangamugayo: GET → ibisubizo bya attestation
/ v1 / ubuzima: GET → {imiterere, verisiyo, igituba, imibare}
/ v1 / ibyanditswe: GET → [{protocole, url}, ...]
/ v1 / indorerwamo: GET → [umugenzuzi_url, ...]
/ v1 / kwizerwa_node: GET → [{igituba, iherezo, ubuzima}, ...]
/ v1 / umutima utera / {pk}: POST (uhereye kumutwe gusa)
/ v1 / kwiyandikisha: POST (kuri node nshya)
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: dnslink = / ipfs / <CID>
SNS andika vortexx.sol: {"indorerwamo": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json yiganye
gutoranya abakiriya: kubanza kwitabira muburyo bwambere, 7 s igihe cyateganijwe

storage.title: Ububiko
storage.subtitle: SQLite ya dev, Postgres ya prod, Alembic yo kwimuka, GRDB / Icyumba / IndexedDB kubakiriya.
storage.intro: Ububiko bwa Vortex ni SQL. Guhinduranya hagati ya SQLite (dev) na Postgres (prod) ni DATABASE_URL ihinduka - nta kode ya kode.
storage.h1p1: `abakoresha (id, izina ryukoresha, ijambo ryibanga_hash, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key?, kwerekana_name, avatar_url, terefone, imeri, yaremye_at, is_active)` - imbonerahamwe yibanze.
storage.h1p2: `umukoresha_ibikoresho (id, umukoresha_id, igikoresho_id, umukoresha_agent, uwanyuma_wabonye, ​​yakuweho_at)` - kuri buri gikoresho cyumurongo.
storage.h1p3: `ibyumba (id, ubwoko, izina, ni_ibyingenzi, ni_umuyoboro, ni_dm, umunyamuryango_umubare, avatar_url, yaremye_at, yaremye_by, ibisobanuro)` - ameza yicyumba, umurongo umwe kuri buri cyumba.

storage.h1p6: `reaction (ubutumwa_id, umukoresha_id, emoji, yaremye_at)` - guhuza urufunguzo rwibanze `(ubutumwa_id, umukoresha_id, emoji)`.

storage.h1p10: `federasiyo (igituba, iherezo, ubuzima_ibisobanuro, wongeyeho_at, wongeyeho_by, wavanyweho_at)` - urutonde rwurungano.

storage.h2p1: Alembic muri `alembic / verisiyo /`. Amateka yumurongo, isubiramo rimwe kuri buri gusohora (rimwe na rimwe bike kuri buri gusohora).
storage.h2p2: Uburyo bwa devis: `kurema_byose + ALTER TABLE gusubira inyuma` kugirango byihute.
storage.h2p3: Uburyo bwa prod: `alembic kuzamura umutwe` mbere yo gutangira. Ishusho ya Docker irayikoresha mukwinjira.
storage.h3p1: `ubutumwa (icyumba_id, id DESC)` - indangagaciro yibanze yo kwizana.
storage.h3p2: `ubutumwa (icyumba_id, cyoherejwe_at DESC)` - kubitondekanya bishingiye kumwanya wo guhindura.
storage.h3p6: Table0⟫ imbonerahamwe igaragara (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) kugirango ushakishe inyandiko yuzuye.
storage.h4p1: `kora db-backup` itanga ububiko bwigihe. Shishoza kuruhuka hamwe nurufunguzo rwumukoresha.
storage.h4p2: Kugumana: buri munsi muminsi 14, buri cyumweru ibyumweru 4, buri kwezi kumezi 12.
storage.h4p3: Kugarura: `kora db-kugarura FILE = <inzira>`. Ikora kuri stage DB mbere; umukoresha agenzura noneho swaps.
storage.h1_a: Ububiko bwa node ni SQL. SQLite ya dev na ntoya-yakiriye; PostgreSQL kubikorwa bya federasiyo cyangwa byinshi. Kimwe SQLAlchemy 2.x code ya async itwara byombi.
storage.h1_b: Hindura ukoresheje `DATABASE_URL = sqlite + aiosqlite: /// vortex.db` cyangwa` postgresql + asyncpg: // umukoresha: pw @ host / db`. Igenamiterere rimwe, nta kode ya kode. SQLite ikora mubikorwa; Postgres ikora ukwayo. Imikorere: SQLite ikora ~ 50 abakoresha bahujwe neza kuri M1; Ibipimo bya Postgres bigera ku bihumbi. Kwimuka kwimuka → SQLite ninzira imwe ikoresheje `pg_dump --data-gusa` + SQLite itumiza; ikindi cyerekezo ni kimwe.
storage.h1_c: Imiterere "imwe ORM, ibiri inyuma" ni imyaka icumi ya SQLAlchemy imyitozo. Vortex ikoresha async 2.x API kuburyo buri kibazo gitegereje. Twahisemo SQLAlchemy Core hejuru ya Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` kubwinkuru yimuka ikungahaye hamwe numukino hamwe na async ya FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: Imbonerahamwe 18 yibanze: abakoresha, abakoresha_ibikoresho, ibyumba, ibyumba_abibuka, ubutumwa, reaction, dosiye, gusoma_ibisubizo, kuboneka, federasiyo, federasiyo_bisanduku, gahunda_ubutumwa, guhuza, gukiza_impano, ububiko, bot_ibikorwa, amasomo, gusunika_ kwiyandikisha.
storage.h2_b: Imbonerahamwe y'abakoresha ni indangamuntu. icyumba_ibuka gifite (icyumba, umukoresha, uruhare, gufatanya_at, muted_until). ubutumwa butwara ciphertext + metadata; Yerekanwe kuri (icyumba_id, id) kugirango yinjizwe. reaction ni compound-primaire-urufunguzo. Ibindi byose biroroshye. Ububiko bukura neza hamwe nubutumwa bwo kubara - hafi 1 KB kuri buri butumwa kuri disiki nyuma yerekana hejuru.
storage.h2_c: Igishushanyo cyari gihamye nyuma ya v0.0.4. Mbere twari dufite ameza `dm_messages` na` group_messages`; yahujwe muri v0.0.3 nyuma ya code ya fanout yiganye byombi. Imbonerahamwe 18 nizo ntoya kubiranga ubutumwa bwuzuye; binini binini byongeweho imbonerahamwe yo gusesengura ariko ibyo ntibikenewe mubikorwa.
storage.h3_a: Alembic icunga abimuka. Amateka yo gusubiramo umurongo, isubiramo rimwe kurekurwa. Isubiramo ryose rifite `kuzamura ()` na `kumanura ()` imikorere.
storage.h3_b: `alembic / verisiyo /` ifite ubugororangingo. Buri ni Python dosiye hamwe no kuzamura / kumanura. CI ikora `alembic kuzamura umutwe` +` kumanura alembic -1` + `alembic kuzamura umutwe` kugirango igenzure urugendo-rugendo. Umusaruro: `kora db-migrate` ikorera muri Docker yinjira mbere yuko porogaramu itangira. Uburyo bwa dev ikoresha `kurema_byose + ALTER TABLE gusubira inyuma` rero itera irihuta idakeneye kwimuka kuri buri rease.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) nigikoresho cyemewe cya SQLAlchemy. Amateka yumurongo (ntabwo ari ishami) nuguhitamo - birinda "abaterankunga babiri barema umubare umwe wo gusubiramo" ikibazo. Kwimuka kwa Django bikoresha inzira imwe. Gariyamoshi yavuye kumurongo yerekeza ku gihe cyagenwe muri 2014 ariko yongera kwemeza umurongo-hamwe-hamwe-muri 2020.
storage.h4_a: Ibipimo byingenzi byatoranijwe neza kugirango usome (ubutumwa, reaction, soma inyemezabwishyu) hit disiki gake.
storage.h4_b: `ubutumwa (icyumba_id, id DESC)` - indangagaciro yibanze. `ubutumwa (icyumba_id, cyoherejwe_at DESC)` - igihe cyagenwe cyo gusubira inyuma cyo guhindura. `reaction (ubutumwa_id)` - guteranya icyumba gifunguye. `soma_ibisubizo (icyumba_id, ubutumwa_id)` - "wabonwe na N" ibara. `umukoresha_ibikoresho (umukoresha_id)` - urutonde rwibikoresho. Table2⟫ imbonerahamwe yuburyo bwo gushakisha (FTS5 kuri SQLite, tsvector kuri Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Guhitamo indangagaciro byaturutse kubisobanuro-gahunda-yerekana mugihe cya v0.0.4. Twatangiranye na indangagaciro ngenderwaho hanyuma twongeraho / twakuweho dushingiye kubibazo byabajijwe. `Ubutumwa (icyumba_id, id DESC)` ni indangagaciro imwe ishyushye - hafi 80% yabasomyi yarayikubise. Kugumya kugufi (nta gushiramo inkingi) kureka bigahuza nibuka.

bots.title: Urwego
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + isoko + antispam.
bots.intro: Bots ni abitabiriye icyumba cya mbere. Ubutumwa bwasinywe nurufunguzo rwa Ed25519 kugirango ibihimbano biboneke.
bots.h1p1: Amahitamo abiri: Python SDK cyangwa Gravitix DSL. Python ni kubikorwa bigoye; Gravitix kubintu byayobowe nibiganiro bigomba koherezwa vuba.
bots.h1p2: Urugero: 2 SDK ikora WebSocket, guhuza, gushishoza urufunguzo.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix urugero: `kuri / gutangira {emit" Mwaramutse, {ctx.first_name}! " } `. Gukusanya kuri bytecode kandi ikorera mumasanduku yumusenyi.
bots.h1p4: Ikimenyetso cya Bot gitangwa mugukora bot. Ikimenyetso cyatakaye? `POST / api / bots / {id} / kuzenguruka-token` itanga agashya.
bots.h2p1: Uburyo bubiri bwo kohereza: mubikorwa (coroutine imbere yumutwe) no hanze (gutora bot `/ api / bots / {id} / ivugurura`).
bots.h2p2: Mubikorwa: zero umuyoboro wa zeru, byihuse, ariko ukora agomba kwizera kode ya bot. Good kuri bots wenyine.
bots.h2p3: Hanze: webhook cyangwa gutora-birebire. Nta cyizere cyo murwego rukenewe. Good kubandi-bots hamwe nisoko.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots buri gihe ikora-muri sandbox - nta sisitemu ya sisitemu cyangwa imiyoboro ihari usibye API.
bots.h3p1: Bots rusange irashobora kohereza kumasoko. Abasesengura bagenzura kode ntabwo ifi, ntabwo ari spam, ntisohora amakuru yumukoresha.
bots.h3p2: Ibyiciro: umusaruro, imikino, amakuru, ibikorwa, ai, ibisobanuro.
bots.h3p3: Shyiramo: kanda rimwe. Node yiyandikisha uyikoresha kumazina ya bot kugirango inzira ya DMs neza.
bots.h3p4: Monetisation: kubuntu, kugura inshuro imwe, kwiyandikisha. Amafaranga ya platform 10 %% yumubare rusange.
bots.h4p1: Icyumba cyose gikurikiranwa na bot antispam itagaragara. Kugenzura: guhuza ubucucike> 3 kumunota, igipimo cy'inyuguti-nyuguti> 70 %% kuri 10+ chars, gusubiramo ubutumwa, guturika gutunguranye kw'abinjira-konti nshya.
bots.h4p2: Ibikorwa: kuburira → igihe cyateganijwe (5 min) → gutera → kubuza. Ubujurire bujya mubuyobozi bwa cyumba.
bots.h4p3: Kuringaniza kuri buri cyumba ukoresheje bot config.
bots.h1_a: Bots ni abitabiriye icyumba cya mbere. Buriwese afite urufunguzo rwa Ed25519 n'ikimenyetso; buri butumwa bohereje bwashyizweho umukono, impimbano rero ziramenyekana.
bots.h1_b: Kurema: nyirayo POSTs `/ api / bots` hamwe na` {ukoresha izina, kwerekana_izina, code} `. Node irema umurongo wabakoresha hamwe na `is_bot = ukuri`, itanga urufunguzo rwa Ed25519, igasubiza nyirarureshwa-urufunguzo rwibanga kuri nyirarwo (rwerekanwe rimwe). Kwiruka: bot yaba mubuzima-nka coroutine cyangwa gutora hanze `/ api / bots / {id} / ivugurura` hamwe nikimenyetso cyayo. Ubutumwa buva muri bots butwara `kuva_bot: ukuri` ibendera kandi byashyizweho umukono nurufunguzo rwihariye rwa bot.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIs yatangijwe na Slack (2014) inonosorwa na Telegram (2015). Vortex kugoreka: imikono ya bot ihuza ubutumwa kubiranga bot, bityo rero node yangiritse ntishobora guhimba "@bot yavuze X". Inkunga ya bot3 yongeyeho uyu mutungo muri 2021 ukoresheje imikono ya federasiyo; Vortex ifite kuva v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix ni indimi yihariye yo kwandika ibyabaye-bots. Utuntu duto, twerekana, twakusanyije kuri sandbox ya bytecode.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `kuri / gutangira {emit" Mwaramutse, {ctx.first_name}! " } `. Abashinzwe guhuza imbarutso (itegeko, regex, ibyabaye). Umubiri nuruhererekane rwa `emit`,` reka`, `niba`,` gahunda`, nibindi. Uwandika asohora bytecode; igihe cyo gusobanura gisobanura muri sandbox idafite sisitemu ya sisitemu, nta rezo itabishaka, gusa Vortex ya API. Ibisobanuro byuzuye mumutwe wa Gravitix.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix yateguwe mugihe cya v0.0.6 nyuma yo kubona ko code ya bot yari 80% yo gutekesha kugirango wire3⟫ SDK, hamwe na kernel ya logique nyayo hagati. A DSL ireka logique ikayangana kandi ikabuza gutobora Python uko bishakiye muri bot-dev ahantu hashobora gutoroka sandbox.
bots.h3_a: Icyumba cyose gifite antispam itagaragara itareba umwuzure, guhuza spam, ubutumwa bwisubiramo, hamwe na konti nshya bifatanya.
bots.h3_b: Amategeko: guhuza ubucucike> 3 kumunota uhereye kumukoresha umwe, ALL-CAPS igipimo> 70% kubutumwa ≥ chars 10, ubutumwa busubiramo> inshuro 3 muri 30 s, guturika kwabinjira bafite imyaka ya konte <24 h> 20 muri 60 s. Ibikorwa biriyongera: kuburira time iminota 5 yigihe cyigihe → isaha 1 yo gukubita → kubuza (kwemeza admin kubuza). Kuringaniza kuri buri cyumba ukoresheje `/ antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics ituruka muguhuza amategeko ya IRC yigihe cyibimera (Eggdrop, BitchX) hamwe na sisitemu igezweho nka Discord AutoMod. Ibipimo byihariye muri Vortex byahujwe n’amezi 6 ya beta corpus yubutumwa bwa 200k; igipimo cyibinyoma-ni 0.3% ku gipimo cyabujijwe-kujurira.
bots.h4_a: Bots rusange zishyikiriza isoko. Abasesengura bareba ko nta fishing / nta spam / nta makuru yatangajwe. Abakoresha bashakisha ibyiciro hanyuma bagashyiraho ukanze rimwe.
bots.h4_b: Gutanga: nyirayo ashyiraho inkomoko y'ibisobanuro + ibisobanuro. Isubiramo ikoresha kode muri sandbox, irayisoma kuri anti-moderi izwi, igenzura umuhamagaro uwo ariwo wose unyura muri API zemewe, igenzura politiki y’ibanga. Urutonde: icyiciro, igiciro, igipimo, gushiraho kubara. Shyiramo: `POST / api / bots / {id} / ushyireho - - node ikora buri mukoresha. Monetisation: ubuntu / inshuro imwe / kwiyandikisha; urubuga rutwara 10%.
bots.h4_c: Amasoko ya porogaramu asubira mububiko bwa App 2008. Ububiko bwa porogaramu ya Slack (2015), Urutonde rwa Bord Discord (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex yagabanutseho 10% iri munsi ya Apple ya 30% kandi iri munsi gato ya 20% ya Shopify, yahisemo gushishikariza abitezimbere gutangaza. Politiki yo gusuzuma yerekanwa kuri GitLab "isubiramo byanze bikunze, ikureho ikirego".
bots.h3_f:
imbarutso:
  guhuza_ubucucike> 3 / min → kuburira
  byose_caps_ratio> 0.7 (≥10c) → kuburira
  gusubiramo_ibara> 3 muri 30s → kuburira
  ibishya_joiner_burst> 20 muri 60s lock gufunga icyumba

kuzamuka:
  Imiburo 2 min 5 min igihe cyateganijwe
  Imiburo 3 → 1 h gutera
  Imiburo 4 → kubuza (admin arabyemera)
bots.h4_f:
ibyiciro: umusaruro, imikino, amakuru, ibikorwa, ai, ibisobanuro
igiciro: ubuntu | inshuro imwe (USD umubare) | kwiyandikisha (USD / ukwezi)
gukata: 90% kubateza imbere, 10% kugeza Vortex
gusubiramo: imfashanyigisho, ~ 3 iminsi yakazi intego yo guhinduka

ops.title: Ibikorwa
ops.subtitle: Kohereza, gukurikirana, gusubira inyuma.
ops.intro: Igikorwa cyose gikora gifite `gukora` intego cyangwa itegeko rya CLI. Impapuro za Ops zibaho muri `kohereza /`.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` izana node, umugenzuzi, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Umubumbe: `/ data / vortex.db`,` / data / uploads`, `/ data / logs`. Umusozi kugirango wakire gushikama.
ops.h1p3: Ibidukikije: `.env` mu mizi ya repo. Ntukigere wiyemeza. `.env.urugero` nicyitegererezo.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-kuzana Let's Encrypt certs. Limits1⟫ igipimo cyibipimo gikurikizwa - koresha kubika kubushakashatsi.
ops.h2p1: `kora install` - shyiramo Python deps + ibikoresho bya dev.
ops.h2p2: `kora dev` - uvicorn hamwe na reload ku cyambu 9000.
ops.h2p4: `kora lint` - ruff + mypy. CI guhagarika kunanirwa.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` ni PyInstaller bundle hamwe na pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Banza ukore: hitamo izina rya node → kubyara urufunguzo rwo kurekura → kugena TLS (Let's Encrypt / kuzana-ibyawe / kwiyandikisha) → hitamo URL yinjira → gushoboza kwiba → gufungura ibyambu bya firewall.
ops.h3p3: Nyuma yo gushiraho, wizard aguma nka admin konsole: gutangira / guhagarika node, kureba ibiti, kuzenguruka urufunguzo, ongeraho urungano rwa federasiyo.
ops.h4p1: Isohora ryose ryashizweho muri git. Tag nayo yasinywe nurufunguzo rwo kurekura kugirango tagi ubwayo irashobora kugenzurwa.
ops.h4p2: Gusubira inyuma: `git kugenzura <tag> && gukora docker-kubaka && docker guhimba up -d`. Gukoresha imiyoboro ivaho hanyuma utangire.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `kumanura <rev>` ushyigikiwe na verisiyo ntoya inyuma. Inyuma yinyuma isaba intoki.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` izana Vortex yuzuye: node, umugenzuzi, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` kuri repo umuzi. Umubumbe `/ data / vortex.db`,` / data / uploads`, `/ data / logs` yashizwe kubakira kugirango amakuru akomeze atangire. Ubuzima bwiza: node nzima iff `/ ubuzima / yiteguye` igaruka 200; umugenzuzi iff `/ v1 / ubunyangamugayo` yagarutse yagenzuwe. Caddy auto-kuzana Let's Encrypt certs. `.env` itanga amabanga (ntukigere wiyemeza). `.env.urugero` nicyitegererezo.
ops.h1_c: Docker Guhimba ni de-facto yuburyo bwa kontineri nyinshi-yakiriye serivisi. Umami, Umuzimu, Birashoboka, Miniflux yose irayikoresha. Idosiye yo guhimba Vortex yasubiwemo kuva v0.0.2 gukomeza; imiterere y'ubu ihagaze neza muri v0.0.5. Ibindi (k8s, inzererezi) bisigaye nkimyitozo kubakoresha binini.
ops.h2_a: Makefile niyo nkuru yinjira kuri buri dev na ops ibikorwa. `kora ubufasha` urutonde rwintego.
ops.h2_b: `kora install` →` gushiraho imiyoboro -r ibisabwa.txt`. `kora dev` → uvicorn hamwe na reload. `kora test` → pytest + ubwishingizi, ibisubizo` ubwishingizi.xml`. `kora lint` → ruff + mypy. `kora docker-kubaka` →` docker kubaka -t vortex: $ VERSION`. `kora db-kwimuka` →` alembic kuzamura umutwe`. `kora db-backup` /` kora db-kugarura FILE = ... `. `kora ci` → yuzuye CI umuyoboro waho.
ops.h2_c: Makefile nkibintu byemewe byemewe ni imyaka myinshi ya Unix imyitozo, yemejwe na buri mushinga munini Python (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Ibindi bikoresho (Ibisigo, Hatch, uv) ni uburyohe-bwumwaka; Gukora birarambiranye kandi kuri bose.
ops.h3_a: Gushiraho wizard ni bundle ya PyInstaller (`Vortex Wizard.app`) hamwe na pywebview GUI igenda yambere ikora binyuze mubikorwa.
ops.h3_b: Banza ukore: hitamo izina node → kubyara urufunguzo rwo kurekura (Ed25519 keypair yabitswe kuri `urufunguzo / kurekura.key`) → kugena TLS (Let's Encrypt / kuzana-ibyawe / wenyine-wasinyiye) → hitamo URL zinjira (vortexx.sol / indangarubuga / Nyuma yo kwiruka bwa mbere, wizard aguma nka admin konsole: gutangira / guhagarika node, kureba ibiti, kuzenguruka urufunguzo, ongeraho urungano rwa federasiyo.
ops.h3_c: Gushiraho ubuhanga nubushakashatsi bwibikoresho byifashishwa byibanda kubakoresha sysadmin: Kwinjira kwa Ghost (2015), seriveri ya Noteri ya seriveri, ibibazo bya Mastodon. PyInstaller itwemerera kohereza bibiri-ikanda kabiri; pywebview itanga page HTML yaho ikorerwa na admin ya FastAPI API kuri 127.0.0.1 - mushakisha UX nta bigoye kubaka kavukire GUI.
ops.h4_a: Isohora ryose ryashizwe muri git. Gusubira inyuma ni `git kugenzura <tag> && gukora docker-kubaka && docker guhimba up -d`. Kwimuka bifite `kumanura ()` imikorere.
ops.h4_b: Tagi yasinywe nurufunguzo rwo kurekura kugirango tagi ubwayo irashobora kugenzurwa. Uburyo bwo gusubira inyuma: kugenzura tagi ishaje, kongera kubaka ishusho, kongera gukora kontineri - gukora imiyoboro ihuza imiyoboro ya SIGTERM (ubuntu bwa 15 s). DB: `kumanura alembic <rev>` ihindura isubiramo rimwe. Kwirinda gutakaza amakuru: ntituzigera duterera inkingi mugusohora kamwe; ibitonyanga bibaho N + 1 nyuma yuko code ihagaritse kubisoma.
ops.h4_c: "Kode-hanyuma-kode" uburyo bwo kwimuka (kwagura-kwimuka-amasezerano) nibisanzwe kubikorwa byoherejwe na zeru. Igitabo cyo kwimuka kwa Stripe (2019) gisobanura neza. Vortex yabyemeje nyuma yibyabaye muri v0.0.3 aho igitonyanga cyinkingi gihatira idirishya ryiminota 30.

mobile.title: Abakiriya ba mobile
mobile.subtitle: iOS na Android - kavukire UI, protocole imwe.
mobile.intro: Abakiriya bagendanwa bombi ni urungano rwuzuye, ntabwo ari urubuga ruto. Reba kavukire, imikorere kavukire, kwishyira hamwe kavukire (CallKit, ConnectionService, Gufunga widgets).
mobile.h1p1: Swift Package muri `ios / Modules /`. 30+ ibiranga modules, buri SOLID-gutandukana `api /` + `impl /` + `ui /`.
mobile.h1p2: Intego ya porogaramu muri `ios / VortexApp /`. XcodeGen igaragara kuri `ios / umushinga.yml` igarura xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Guhinduka kwose kunyura muri `db.wandika`.
mobile.h1p6: Gusunika: APNs ukoresheje `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Kwagura Serivisi yo Kumenyesha kubanga.
mobile.h2p1: Gutanga umushinga muri `android /`. 22 biranga module hamwe na Hilt DI, kimwe `api / impl / di / ui` gutandukana.
mobile.h3p1: Kimwe na 146-bundle hamwe namazina kavukire (`Русский ru`,` Icyongereza en`, `中文 zh`,…).
mobile.h3p2: Kimwe na 1500-emoji catalog ifite ibyiciro 9 + tone-tone + MRU + gushakisha.
mobile.h3p3: Kimwe-konte nyinshi X25519 ikibazo-igisubizo cyo guhinduranya.
mobile.h3p4: Ububiko bumwe bwo kuganira (Byose / Ububiko / gakondo) hamwe no gukurura-guta reordering.
mobile.h3p5: Kimwe cyabitswe-INGABIRE urutonde (nta Tenor - icyegeranyo cyihariye).
mobile.h3p6: Gahunda imwe-ubutumwa UI, ecran ya ecran, urupapuro rwimiterere.
mobile.h1_a: Umukiriya wa iOS ni Swift Package ifite 30+ ibiranga module. Kimwe HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protocole nkabandi bakiriya bose.
mobile.h1_b: Module yateguwe nimiterere: `Bootstrap`,` Auth`, `Chat`,` Files`, `Hamagara`,` Push`, `Emoji`,` Folders`, `Konti`, 'SavedGifs`,` Contacts`, Buri gice kigabanyijemo `api /` (protocole), `impl /` (ibyiciro bifatika), `ui /` (Ibitekerezo bya SwiftUI). Crypto: CryptoKit ya X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Ihinduka kuri Argon2id. DB: GRDB hamwe na FTS5. WebRTC: stasel / WebRTC XCFramework. Gusunika: APNs hamwe no Kwagura Serivisi yo Kumenyesha kubifunga-gusunika ibanga.
mobile.h1_c: Amapaki yububiko nuburyo busanzwe bwa Swift kuva Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Gutandukana kwacu muri api / impl / ui ni SOLID-ish: guhinduranya biterwa (modules biterwa na api / gusa), gutandukanya impungenge, ubuhamya (swap impl kubizamini). 30+ module ibara ni amahitamo yo kubaka parallelism - buri module ikusanya mu bwigunge.
mobile.h2_a: Abakiriya ba Android indorerwamo iOS: Kotlin + Guhimba + Hilt DI. 22 biranga module, kimwe `api / impl / di` gutandukana.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), integoSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: Umutekano wa AndroidX + Tink kuri AES-GCM; argon2-jvm kuri Argon2id. DB: Icyumba gifite FTS4 imbarutso. WebRTC: Inzira WebRTC Android. Gusunika: FCM ukoresheje FirebaseMessagingService + ifunze ibahasha ifunze. Itondekanya byinshi-module, Hilt ihuza ibiranga module idafite ishingiro.
mobile.h2_c: Guhimba ni Google imenyekanisha UI toolkit, itajegajega kuva 2021. Hilt (2020) ni Google-yemejwe DI urwego hejuru ya Dagger 2. Hamwe na hamwe bahuza ibicuruzwa bya SwiftUI + bipfunyika kuri iOS kugirango bumve hafi yubwubatsi. Vortex yemeye Guhimba / Hilt kuva v0.0.4 gukomeza; mbere Android yari ishingiye kuri View.
mobile.h3_a: Byombi iOS na Android bihuza 146-yaho JSON yashyizwemo amazina kavukire hamwe na 1500-emoji catalog - umukoresha wandika 🥹 kuri iOS 17 yerekana 🥹 kuri Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios / Modules / Inkomoko / I18N / Ibikoresho / byaho / *. indorerwamo ya json` android / porogaramu / src / nyamukuru / umutungo / ahantu / *. json`. Porogaramu zombi zikorera ahantu heza mugutangiza bwa mbere (ecran y'ururimi) hanyuma ugakomeza guhitamo. Urutonde rwa emoji ni ibyiciro 9 JSON byoherejwe mumigozi yombi; iranyerera OS-urwego rwa emoji-yashizeho gutandukana ubundi bitera kudasubirwaho `?` glyphs kuri OS ishaje.
