webclient.title: Umukiriya wurubuga
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, uburyo bwa interineti, umukozi wa serivisi.
webclient.intro: Umukiriya wurubuga ni vanilla-JS PWA. Nta reaction, nta bundler irenze ESM. ~ 400 KB gzipedi yose, harimo 146.
webclient.h1p1: `static / js / main.js` niyinjira. Ibiranga module ubunebwe-umutwaro kubanza gukoresha.
webclient.h1p2: Leta: icyumba cyo kumpeta yicyumba muri IndexedDB, murwibutso rwabitswe. Umukozi wa serivisi arahuza kuzana.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Ingaruka yikirahure cyamazi ukoresheje CSS inyuma-muyunguruzi. Nta rwego; ibirori byintumwa + idempotent gutanga abafasha.
webclient.h2p1: Inyandiko iyo ari yo yose yakozwe mugihe umurongo wa interineti kuri IndexedDB. SW ihindagurika iyo ihuza igarutse.
webclient.h2p2: Urufunguzo rudasanzwe kuri buri POST reka kwigana gusubiramo bigerweho neza.
webclient.h2p3: Gusoma bikora kumurongo wuzuye - ciphertext yose ihujwe iba muri IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: 146 ahantu muri `static / locales / *. Json`. Ikaze ecran (`lang-picker.js`) inzinguzingo ukoresheje izina-kavukire.
webclient.h3p2: Guhindura umwanya wimikorere: `inyandiko.documentElement.lang = code` + ongera utange ibirango ukoresheje` data-i18n` ibiranga.
webclient.h1_a: Umukiriya wurubuga ni vanilla-JS PWA. Nta reaction, nta ntambwe yo kubaka irenze ESM guhuza. Igiteranyo JS cyoherejwe: ~ 400 KB gzipi.
webclient.h1_b: `inyandikorugero / ishingiro.html` nigikonoshwa cya Jinja2. `static / js / nyamukuru.js` ni ES-module yinjira. Ibiranga modul muri `static / js / <feature> /` umunebwe-umutwaro kumikoreshereze yambere. CSS muri `static / css /` hamwe na 1-dosiye-kuri buri kintu. Umukozi wa serivisi akora cache; umutwaro wambere uturuka kumurongo, nyuma ya cache; kuvugurura kugenzura kugendagenda.
webclient.h1_c: Kureka ibikorerwa byari icyemezo nkana v0.0.1 nyuma yo gupima React na Vue PWAs kuri ~ 1.5 MB gz hamwe nibintu bisa. Vanilla JS + ES modules iduha ~ 400 KB. Ubucuruzi-burenzeho DOM-manipulation boilerplate, ibyo tworoshya hamwe nabafasha bato muri `static / js / lib / dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Uburyo bwa Offline: gusohoka byandika umurongo kuri IndexedDB; Umukozi wa Service aratemba iyo ihuza ryagarutse.
webclient.h2_b: Icyo ari cyo cyose POST / PATCH uyikoresha akora kumurongo abona urufunguzo rudasanzwe kandi agwa muri `outbox` (IndexedDB). Umukozi wa Serivisi yumva ibyabaye kuri interineti hanyuma akongera akandika hamwe nurufunguzo rudasanzwe nkumutwe. Seriveri izi duplicates ikoresheje urufunguzo rudasanzwe kandi igasubiza igisubizo cyumwimerere. Gusoma bikora kumurongo wuzuye - ciphertext yose ihujwe iba muri IndexedDB kandi ikanabanga mugace hamwe nurufunguzo rwo kwibuka.
webclient.h2_c: Imfunguzo zidasanzwe zo gusubiramo POSTs ni amasezerano ya Stripe yo muri 2017, yemejwe na API nyinshi zigezweho. IndexedDB nkibisohoka nuburyo Google Gutwara urubuga rukoresha muguhindura kumurongo. Gushyira mu bikorwa Vortex ni ~ 200 imirongo muri `static / js / lib / outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: 146-indimi bundle kuri `static / locales / *. Json`. Ikaze ya ecran ya cycle ukoresheje izina-kavukire (`Выберите язык` /` Hitamo ururimi rwawe` / `选择语言` /…).
webclient.h3_b: Gutangiza bwa mbere: `lang-picker.js` yerekana imashini yandika-animasiyo yerekana izenguruka ahantu 97 kuri 45 ms / char, ihagarika 1.8 s, gusiba kuri 30 ms / char, gutera imbere. Umukoresha atoranya ururimi; gutsimbarara muri `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Buri kwiruka gukurikira gusoma amahitamo yabitswe. Guhindura igihe: `setLang (code)` yikoreza JSON, yongera gutanga `data-i18n` ibintu.
webclient.h3_c: Imashini yandika-yerekana uburyo bwo kubaha ecran ya kera ya ecran ya ecran kandi yemejwe kubushyuhe bwa UX nyuma ya beta ya v0.0.6 yerekanaga ko abakoresha birengagije kugabanuka kumanuka. Amagare yerekana amagare atanga 1-isegonda kuri buri mukoresha kugirango abone izina ryururimi rwabo kandi arumenye ako kanya.
webclient.h1_f:
igikonoshwa: inyandikorugero / shingiro.html (seriveri yatanzwe na Jinja2)
ibyinjira: static / js / nyamukuru.js (ES module)
ibiranga: static / js / {kuganira, ibyumba, auth, guhamagara, dosiye, bots} / ...
SW: static / serivisi-umukozi.js
ingano: ~ 400 KB gzipedi yose
webclient.h2_f:
kumurongo wandika kumurongo:
  1. kubara idempotency_key = rand (16) .hex
  2. Db.outbox.yinjiza ({url, uburyo, umubiri, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. Kuri 'kumurongo': flush outbox
     kuri buri murongo: kuzana (url, {uburyo, umubiri, imitwe: {"Idempotency-Urufunguzo": ikey}})
       X 2xx: kura umurongo
       → 4xx: guta umurongo (gutsindwa burundu)
       → 5xx / kumurongo: gerageza nyuma
webclient.h3_f:
gutoranya.js:
  ibitekerezo = ["Выберите язык", "Hitamo ururimi rwawe", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  andika igitekerezo kuri 45 ms / char → guhagarika 1.8 s → gusiba kuri 30 ms / char → guhagarara 0.2 s → ubutaha

igihe cyo gukora:
  Ububiko bwibanze.vortex_lang = kode
  kuzana ('locales /' + code + '.json') → shyira mubintu-i18n

security.title: Guhagarara k'umutekano
security.subtitle: Icyitegererezo cyugarije, kwirwanaho-byimbitse, WAF, kugenzura inzira, canary.
security.intro: Vortex ikoresha kwirwanaho-byimbitse: kumena igice kimwe ntabwo bihagije, igitero gifatika gikeneye intsinzi nyinshi zigenga.
security.h1p1: ** Indorerezi ya pasiporo yitegereza **: ireba TLS paki; ikora ingano / isesengura ryigihe. Yatsinzwe nubujura bwa 1.
security.h1p2: ** Igitero gikora kumurongo **: irashobora guta / gutinda / gutera. Gutsindwa nu Rwego 2-4 kwiba.
security.h1p3: ** Umuyoboro wangiritse **: abona ciphertext + metadata. Ibirimo ubutumwa bikomeza kuba ibanga.
security.h1p4: ** Ibikoresho byabakiriya byibwe **: ibisobanuro byubutumwa bwashize bwerekanwe. Inshuro ebyiri zingana kumasomo agezweho; guhanagura-kuri-ubutaha-gufungura birahari.
security.h1p5: ** Umwanzi wa Quantum hamwe nurujya n'uruza rwabitswe kera **: yatsinzwe na Hybrid Kyber-768 urufunguzo rwamasomo mugihe urungano rwombi rwamamaje PQ.
security.h2p1: Gusaba umugenzuzi: SQLi ishusho, inzira nyabagendwa, gutera inshinge, LFI, NoSQLi. Ibitonyanga mbere ya kode ya porogaramu.
security.h2p2: Igipimo cyibipimo: kwisi 1000 req / s yoroheje cap hamwe no guturika; kuri buri nzira (injira 10 / min, iyandikishe 5 / min); kuri buri mukoresha 100 req / s nyuma ya auth.
security.h2p3: Geo-guhagarika guhitamo binyuze kuri `GEO_BLOCK = RU, CN`.
security.h3p1: Ibikorwa bijyanye numutekano (ibikorwa bya admin, guhindura federasiyo, kuzamura kurekura, guhanagura ubwoba) hash-umunyururu ukoresheje `porogaramu / umutekano / canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Kumena umunyururu ⇒ tamping byagaragaye. Kumenyesha umuriro.
security.h3p3: `/ api / admin / audit` yerekana logi (admin auth gusa). Umugereka-gusa.
security.h4p1: Idosiye ya Canary yasinywe burimunsi nurufunguzo rwo kurekura. Kubura ⇒ kumvikana ukekwa.
security.h4p2: Kwamburwa byihutirwa: admin atangaza `{ubwoko:" n ", ibyabaye:" kumvikana ", ...}` kuri buri WebSocket. Abakiriya bahanagura urufunguzo.
security.h4p3: Kuzunguruka: urufunguzo rushya rwo kurekura, ongera usinye kugaragara, ongera utangaze. Abakiriya bongeye gutangira.
security.h1_a: Ibyiciro bine byabanzi bitwara igishushanyo: indorerezi ya pasiporo, igitero gikora, ukora ibikorwa byangiritse, igikoresho cyangiritse. Buri wese yatsinzwe nuburyo butandukanye.
security.h1_b: Indorerezi ya passiyo: ireba TLS-ibitswemo paki, ikora isesengura ryumuhanda. Gutsindwa nu Rwego 1-2 kwiba. Igitero gifatika: irashobora guta / gutinda / gutera paki. Gutsindwa nu Rwego 3-4 kwiba. Umukoresha wangiritse: abona ciphertext + metadata. Yatsinzwe na E2E crypto + kugabanya metadata. Igikoresho cyangiritse: ibona inyandiko yubutumwa bwashize. Ibyangiritse bigengwa n’ibanga ryimbere (Double Ratchet) no guhanagura ubwoba.
security.h1_c: Icyitegererezo cy’ibyiciro bine kiva muri Schneier yo mu 1999 "Applied Cryptography" yerekana iterabwoba ry’imisoro, yongerewe hamwe na nyuma ya Snowden yitegereza indorerezi zo ku rwego rwa Leta. Buri gishushanyo kigezweho gifite umutekano-ubutumwa gitanga ikintu nkicyo. Vortex igoretse irimo kongeramo icyiciro cya gatanu kubishushanyo mbonera bya v0.4: umwanzi-ushoboye umwanzi hamwe numuhanda wabitswe kera, Kyber akora.
security.h2_a: WAF igenzura buri cyifuzo mbere yuko igera kuri kode ya porogaramu, ikanga SQL-i, inzira nyabagendwa, gutera inshinge, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `porogaramu / umutekano / ibikoresho byo hagati.py :: WAFMiddleware` ikora ~ 50 regex igenzura URL, ikibazo, numubiri. Uburyo buzwi-bubi (`UNION SELECT`,` ../ `,` {{config}} `,` $ aho`) → 403. kuri buri nzira `/ kwinjira` 10 / min,` / kwiyandikisha` 5 / min; kuri buri mukoresha 100 req / s nyuma ya auth. Guhagarika geo kubushake binyuze kuri `GEO_BLOCK = RU, CN, IR` kugirango huzuzwe ibisabwa kubihano kubakoresha.
security.h2_c: WAFs nkibikoresho byo hagati nuburyo bwashizweho - mod_umutekano (2002), Cloudflare WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex ni ntoya nkana kuko uburemere WAF butera ibyiza bitari byo kurohama iterabwoba nyaryo. Urutonde rwa regex rwakozwe kuva OWASP Imikono 10 yambere kandi inonosorwa muri v0.0.5 nyuma yuko itegeko rya beta WAF ryahagaritse umugozi usanzwe "DROP TABLE" imbere yubutumwa bwo kuganira kuri SQL.
security.h3_a: Umutekano ujyanye nibyabaye bigwa muri hash-iminyururu y'ubugenzuzi. Kumena kumurongo byerekana kunyereza.
security.h3_b: Igikorwa cyose cya admin, guhindura federasiyo, kuzamura kurekura, cyangwa guhanagura ubwoba byinjijwe muri `audit_log (ts, ibyabaye, umukinnyi_id, intego_id, ibisobanuro_cbor)`. Buri murongo utwara `prev_hash = hash (pre_row)`. Umurongo wubu hash ubarwa hejuru ya `ts ∥ ibyabaye ∥ prev_hash`. Niba umurongo uwo ariwo wose wasibwe cyangwa uhinduwe, umurongo ukurikiraho '`prev_hash` urunigi rucika - bigaragazwa no gusubiramo urunigi.
security.h3_c: Igenzura rya Hash-iminyururu ni igishaje cyambere (hash-ihuza igihe, 1991). Linux auditd irabikoresha. Git yiyemeje DAG muburyo bumwe. Vortex yabongeyeho muri v0.0.6 nyuma yuko umujyanama yerekanye ko node yangiritse ishobora guhanagura bucece umurongo wibiti.
security.h4_a: Igisubizo cyibyabaye byateguwe mbere: canary yerekana ko urufunguzo rwo kurekura rutabangamiwe; gukuraho byihutirwa bihanagura urufunguzo rwihishwa kubakiriya bose.
security.h4_b: Buri munsi `canary.txt` yashyizweho umukono nurufunguzo rwo kurekura, rwasohotse kuruhande rwumugenzuzi. Abakiriya bahitamo kugenzura gutangira - kubura ise kumvikana gukekwa. Niba ubwumvikane bwemejwe: admin atangaza `{ubwoko:" n ", ibyabaye:" kumvikana ", impamvu}` kuri buri WebSocket. Abakiriya bahanagura urufunguzo rwihishwa, imbaraga zo kongera kwinjira. Isohora rishya urufunguzo rwacapwe, rugaragara rwongeye gusinywa, abakiriya bongeye gukuramo bootstrap kuva indorerwamo yuzuye. Ciphertext ishaje yahinduwe idasomwa kubishushanyo mbonera.
security.h4_c: Amadosiye ya Canary akurikirana Apple ya 2013 ya canary hamwe numushinga wa "canarywatch.org". Ikimenyetso kirabikoresha. Vortex byikora: ibimenyetso bya cron `canary.txt` hamwe nurufunguzo rwo kurekura buri 24 h. Ibihe byihutirwa byo gutambuka ni uburyo bumwe Let's Encrypt bukoresha ibyemezo-gukuraho.
security.h1_f:
icyiciro | kwirwanaho
--------------------------- | ---------------------------------
indorerezi y'urusobekerane | L1 + L2 kwiba (igikumwe + imiterere)
ibikorwa byibasiye umuyoboro | L3 + L4 kwiba (ECH, gucomeka)
umukoresha wangiritse | E2E crypto + wohereje pseudo
igikoresho cyangiritse | imbere ibanga + guhanagura ubwoba
kwant (ejo hazaza) | Kyber-768 icyiciro cya Hybrid
security.h2_f:
kugenzura kuri buri cyifuzo:
  Gutera inshinge: gutahura UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE ,; - n'ibindi
  inzira nyabagendwa: gutahura ../, ..% 2f, URL-yashizwemo impinduka
  inshinge yerekana: gutahura {{, {%
  XSS: gutahura <inyandiko, javascript:
  NoSQLi: menya $ ne, $ aho, $ regex
igipimo cyibipimo: 1000 / s kwisi yose, 10 / min kwinjira, 5 / min kwiyandikisha
security.h3_f:
umurongo: {ts, ibyabaye, umukinnyi_id, intego_id, ibisobanuro_cbor, pre_hash, umurongo_hash}
umurongo_hash = SHA-256 (ts ∥ ibyabaye ∥ umukinnyi_id ∥ ... ∥ pre_hash)
kugenzura: kugendagenda, ongera ubaze buri murongo_hash, gereranya nagaciro kabitswe
kumena ⇒ kunyereza byagaragaye kuri uwo murongo

privacy.title: Ibanga no kubahiriza
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, iburyo-gusiba, kugabanya metadata, kugabanya amakuru.
privacy.intro: Vortex amato GDPR na CCPA ibikoresho biva mu gasanduku. Abakora mu nkiko zagenwe bafite imiyoborere imwe ya admin kuri buri cyifuzo gisabwa n'amategeko.
privacy.h1p1: Nta IP ibiti bisanzwe. Hindura ibice bya porokisi `X-Real-IP` keretse niba umukoresha ahisemo.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` mubutumwa bwumurongo hasheshe indangamuntu nyayo yohereje - ⟫0⟫ imyanda igaragaza gusa amazina y'icyumba.
privacy.h1p3: Shakisha ikoresha ibanga-ibimenyetso. Umukiriya ahishe ijambo ryibanze hamwe nurufunguzo rwicyumba; node ibika ibimenyetso bidasobanutse; gushakisha ni bihuye neza na ciphertext tokens.
privacy.h2p1: `POST / api / ibanga / gusiba` atamenyekanisha umurongo wumukoresha, ahanagura ubutumwa boherejwe (metadata yagumanye kuri quorum), asiba dosiye muri disiki.
privacy.h2p2: Federasiyo: amazimwe yashyizweho umukono aramenyesha urungano; bahanagura kuruhande rwabo muri 72 h.
privacy.h2p3: Ubugenzuzi: gusiba byinjiye hamwe na timestamp na (hashed) ukoresha id kugirango umukoresha abashe kwerekana ko yubahirizwa.
privacy.h3p1: `GET / api / ubuzima bwite / kohereza hanze 'imigezi zip: umwirondoro JSON, woherejwe / wakiriye ciphertext, dosiye yerekanwe hamwe na dosiye ya mizi ya dosiye, urutonde rwitumanaho.
privacy.h3p2: Igihe cyibisekuruza: ~ 5 min kubutumwa 10 k, bugarukira kuri IO.
privacy.h3p3: Uwakiriye agomba gufungura ciphertext yaho; ibikoresho byohereza hanze byoherezwa kuruhande.
privacy.h4p1: Ikirango kirekire-kimenyetso 5 s → guhita uhanagura: urufunguzo, ubutumwa bwanditse, umugereka.
privacy.h4p2: Guhanagura hamwe: `/ api / ibanga / panic` nayo itera amabuye ya konte ya seriveri.
privacy.h1_a: Nta IP ibiti bisanzwe. Nta mukoresha-uranga metadata kumurongo wubutumwa. Shakisha inyandiko-yuzuye hejuru y'ibanga.
privacy.h1_b: Subiza porokisi ya porokireri `X-Real-IP` mbere yuko node ibona keretse niba umukoresha ahisemo kugabanya igipimo. Ubutumwa bwumurongo bubika `sender_id` (kuri ACL) na` sender_pseudo` (kubafana-hanze); ohereza_pseudo ni HMAC (icyumba_umunyu, uwakohereje_id) bityo guta DB ntibigaragaza uwavuze ibyo hakurya y'ibyumba. Shakisha: umukiriya ahishe ijambo ryibanze nurufunguzo rwicyumba; node ibika ibimenyetso bidasobanutse; gushakisha ni bihuye neza na ciphertext tokens, nta indangagaciro igaragara.
privacy.h1_c: Kugabanya Metadata ni ibyumvikanyweho nyuma ya Snowden - Ikimenyetso cyamamaye muri 2014, WhatsApp ikurikirwa no kohereza-pseudo muri 2019. Gushakisha mu ibanga hejuru ya ciphertext ni uburyo bwa CryptDB (2011) na ShadowCrypt (2014). Ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya0⟫ ni verisiyo yambuwe igurisha ibibazo bimwe byoroshye kugirango byorohe.
privacy.h2_a: `POST / api / ibanga / gusiba` atamenyekanisha umurongo wumukoresha, ahanagura ciphertext yabo yoherejwe, asiba dosiye, kandi abimenyesha urungano rwa federasiyo.
privacy.h2_b: Seriveri-uruhande: `abakoresha umurongo wumurongo wunvikana zeru (` username = "wasibwe- <id>" `,` terefone = null`, `email = null`,` display_name = "[wasibwe]" "); `ubutumwa.ciphertext` shiraho NULL kumurongo wose aho` sender_id = u.id`; dosiye zahujwe nubutumwa bwasibwe muri disiki. Urungano rwa federasiyo rwakira ibyasinywe `{ibyabaye:" gusiba ", umukoresha_id, umukono_by}` amazimwe; bakora isuku imwe kuruhande rwabo muri 72 h (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Uburenganzira-bwo gusiba ni GDPR Ingingo ya 17 isabwa kuva 2018. CCPA yakurikijwe muri 2020; LGPD (Burezili) mu 2021. Federasiyo ya 72 h SLA ihuza GDPR idirishya ryiminsi 30 yo gusubiza hamwe nicyumba cyo gukwirakwiza.
privacy.h3_a: `GET / api / ubuzima bwite / kohereza hanze 'imigezi zip: umwirondoro JSON, woherejwe / wakiriye ciphertext, dosiye yerekanwe hamwe na dosiye ya mizi ya dosiye, urutonde rwitumanaho.
privacy.h3_b: Igisekuru ni async kuko konti nini zifata iminota. Abakiriya POSTs basaba → node itanga akazi → akazi gakorera inyuma → amatora yabakiriya `/ api / ibanga / kohereza / {akazi_id}` → 200 hamwe na URL byashyizweho umukono iyo byiteguye. Ibirimo bya Zip: `umwirondoro.json`,` ibyumba.jsonl` (imwe kuri buri cyumba), `ubutumwa.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + kuri buri rufunguzo rwimizi ya dosiye),` dosiye / `(gukuramo-nkuko-ni blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Data portable ni impanga zisabwa hamwe no gusiba muri GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Ikimenyetso bose bafite ibikoresho byo gufata. Vortex yongeyeho ibintu byingenzi (dosiye_root kuri dosiye) kugirango abakoresha bashobore gutobora ibyoherezwa hanze - bitabaye ibyo kohereza hanze ntacyo bimaze. Hatariho ibisobanuro birambuye Apple / Google gufata neza biragaragara neza-gusa kuko bimaze gufungura.
privacy.h4_a: Guhanagura ubwoba: kanda-kanda ikirango cya Vortex amasegonda 5 kugirango uhite usenya urufunguzo rwose hamwe namakuru yabitswe kubikoresho. Ntibishoboka.
privacy.h4_b: Umukiriya-uruhande: kuri 5-amasegonda maremare-yerekana, kwerekana icyemezo; kubyemeza, hamagara `wipeKeychainIbintu ()` / `ClearKeystore ()` / `LocalStorage.clear () + indexDB.database (). kuri buri (gusiba Data base)`. Cache ciphertext yagiye, urufunguzo rwagiye, JWT zagiye. Guhanagura kubushake: `POST / api / ibanga / panic` nayo itera imva kuri konte ya seriveri kuruhande kandi igahuza gusebanya.
privacy.h4_c: Utubuto twa panic / abapfuye-bapfuye bafite amateka maremare mubutumwa bwizewe: "Shred" ya Wickr 2014, "Kwibagirwa" ya Cryptocat 2013, Icyifuzo cya "Gusiba Umutekano" (2016, ntabwo yigeze yoherezwa). Vortex-amasegonda 5-masegonda maremare biragoye nkana gukurura kubwimpanuka - twize ibitekerezo byishimishije kuri iPhone 15 na Pixel 8 hanyuma duhitamo 5 s nk'ahantu heza hagati ya "byihuse bihagije mugihe cyihutirwa" kandi "ntibishobora kurasa ukoresheje buto-buto".
privacy.h1_f:
ohereza_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256 (icyumba_umunyu, wohereje_id) [: 16]
  ⇒ ⟫1⟫ guta: {icyumba, ohereza_pseudo, ciphertext}
  Er igitero ntigishobora guhuza sender_pseudo hejuru y'ibyumba (imyunyu itandukanye)

debugging.title: Gukemura no gusuzuma
debugging.subtitle: Ibikoresho byo gukurikirana ibibazo muri dev, kubika, na prod.
debugging.intro: Buri sisitemu yuburyo bwateganijwe bwo gutema ibiti hamwe na / metero yubuso. Dore igitabo gisanzwe cyo gusuzuma.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-byubatswe mbere. `logger.info (" ibikorwa ", inyongera = {" umukoresha_id ": ...})` itanga `{" ts ": ...," lvl ":" INFO "," msg ":" igikorwa "," umukoresha_id ": ...}`.
debugging.h1p3: Urwego kuri module ukoresheje `LOG_LEVEL_ <MODULE> = DEBUG` (urugero: LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT = DEBUG`).
debugging.h1p4: Id bifitanye isano: icyifuzo cyose kibona `X-Gusaba-Id`; kumanuka RPCs yongeye kuyikoresha.
debugging.h2p1: Imiterere ya Prometheus kuri `/ metrics` (admin-yemejwe muri prod).
debugging.h2p2: RED: igipimo / amakosa / igihe bimara inzira.
debugging.h2p3: USE: gukoresha / kwiyuzuza / amakosa kuri DB pisine, WebSocket umufana-hanze, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Umukiriya: ibyumba bikora, ubutumwa / s, ubujura-urwego rwamateka.
debugging.h3p1: `py-maneko` yo gutoranya igihe. Ongeraho kuri node ikora PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` kubirundo. Ifoto yiminota 1 yerekana vuba vuba.
debugging.h3p3: Rust kwagura `vortex_chat` yohereza hanze - --profile` ibendera ryandika flamegraph-ihuza ibimenyetso.
debugging.h4p1: `inyandiko / umwotsi / byose.sh` ikora kwiyandikisha / kwinjira / kohereza / kwakira / gusohoka hanze yumutwe. Gusohoka bitari zeru kunanirwa kwose.
debugging.h4p2: CI ikoresha umwotsi kuri buri PR kimwe no guhuza nyamukuru.
debugging.h4p3: Umwotsi wumusaruro: iperereza ryo hanze ikubita konte ya kanari rimwe kumunota.
debugging.h1_a: Ibiti ni JSON-byubatswe mbere. Buri murongo wumurongo urimo ts, urwego, module, ubutumwa, hamwe nisano id.
debugging.h1_b: "logger.info" ( Ihuriro rifitanye isano na `X-Gusaba-Id` umutwe; buri kumanuka RPC irongera irayikoresha. Kuzunguruka kuri 100 MB; komeza ibisekuru 14 gzip. Urwego kuri module ukoresheje `LOG_LEVEL_ <MODULE> = DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Gutondekanya JSON gutema ni ubwumvikane bugezweho - byemejwe na Stripe, Datadog, buri mucuruzi ugezweho. Indangamuntu zifitanye isano na X-Gusaba-Id (RFC 4557) hanyuma iba Canonical muri microservices ikoresheje Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex ikoresha umutwe woroheje-ukwirakwizwa bifitanye isano id aho kugabura ibimenyetso kuko ibikoresho byakwirakwijwe-byongeweho ibintu bitagikenewe kugeza ubu.
debugging.h2_a: Ibipimo bya Prometheus kuri `/ metrics` (admin-yemejwe mubikorwa). Ikibaho cya Grafana cyoherejwe muri `kohereza / grafana /`.
debugging.h2_b: RED ibipimo kuri buri nzira: igipimo cyo gusaba, igipimo cyamakosa, igihe cyamateka. USE ibipimo kuri buri soko: DB gukoresha pisine, WebSocket kwiyuzuza abafana, TURN kwerekanwa kwagutse. Custom: ibyumba bikora, ubutumwa kumasegonda, ubujura-urwego rwamateka. Ikibaho cya Admin kuri `/ admin / metrics` yerekana imbonerahamwe yo hejuru; Gusenya Prometheus kumateka yuzuye.
debugging.h2_c: RED (igipimo / amakosa / igihe) ni incamake ya Weaveworks '2016. USE (gukoresha / kwiyuzuza / amakosa) ni uburyo bwa Brendan Gregg 2013. Hamwe hamwe batwikiriye serivisi-urwego n'ibikoresho-urwego rwibimenyetso. Prometheus + Grafana nifungura-isoko isanzwe kuva 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-maneko` yo gutoranya igihe; `memray` kubirundo by'ibirundo; `vortex_chat` Rust kwagura bifite` --profile` kubimenyetso bya flamegraph.
debugging.h3_b: `py-maneko inyandiko -o umwirondoro.svg --pid <node>` kuri 60 s itanga flamegraph SVG yerekana ibishyushye Python. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` ikurikirana ibigenerwa; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` ihindura. ⟫3⟫ kwagura byohereza imyirondoro yimbere nka Chrome-tracing JSON iyo usabwe na `--profile`. Huza kimwe muribi byose hamwe numutwaro-wikizamini unyuze muri `scripts / umwotsi / all.sh` kumiterere ihamye.
debugging.h3_c: py-maneko (2018) numushinga wibarurishamibare udahuzagurika uhuza inzira ikora Python nta guhindura code - Go ya Python umwirondoro. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) ninziza nziza Python ikirundo cyumunsi. Rust umwirondoro wibidukikije urakuze ariko ntiwinjizwemo; kwaguka kwacu kohereza Chrome-tracing byumwihariko kuko buri mushakisha ifite abayireba yubatswe.
debugging.h4_a: `inyandiko / umwotsi / byose.sh` imyitozo yiyandikisha / kwinjira / kohereza / kwakira / gusohoka hanze yaho. CI ikoresha kuri buri PR.
debugging.h4_b: Umwotsi wiruka mu masegonda ~ 5. Kora konti ebyiri nshya, ufungura DM, wohereza ubutumwa, ugenzura itangwa, winjira hanze. Gusohoka bitari zeru kunanirwa kwose. CI irahamagarira nyuma yo kubaka. Canary itandukanye ya prod-umwotsi ikora buri munota uhereye kuri probe yo hanze irwanya konti yabigenewe kuri node.
debugging.h4_c: Ibizamini byumwotsi ni ikigereranyo cyuruganda rwa Toyota (1950s) - kora igenzura ryihuse kugirango wemeze ko sisitemu itavunitse. Muri software babaye ibisanzwe nyuma ya Michael Feathers "Gukorana neza na Kode y'Umurage" (2004). Vortex umwotsi wanditse ni ~ 200 imirongo ya bash + curl.

testing.title: Ingamba zo kugerageza
testing.subtitle: 29 k imirongo y'ibizamini hakurya ya Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Buri cyiciro kigira suite yacyo. CI ikoresha bose muminota 10.
testing.h1p1: `pytest porogaramu / ibizamini` ikubiyemo inzira, umutekano, ubwikorezi, bots.
testing.h1p2: Hypothesis imitungo ishingiye kuri crypto: `kwemeza decrypt (encrypt (m, k), k) == m` kuri 1000 m idasanzwe.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style-fuzz kuri WAF: miriyoni zinjiza zidahwitse - yemeza ko nta 5xx yamenetse.
testing.h2p1: `igeragezwa ryihuse` muri` ios / Modules / `ikora ibizamini byibice birwanya RFC 7748/8032/5869/846.
testing.h2p2: XCUI ibizamini bitwara SwiftUI kureba muri simulator idafite umutwe; ifoto-igereranijwe.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew ihuzaCheck` ikora ibizamini byabigenewe kuri emulator ikora.
testing.h4p1: Umwanditsi w'ikinamico atwara urubuga rwabakiriya, Chrome idafite umutwe + Firefox idafite umutwe. Ihamagarwa rikorwa na `--use-fake-ui-kubitangazamakuru-bitemba`.
testing.h4p2: Scenarios: andika konti ebyiri → DM → ohereza dosiye → gusiba → kugenzura sync → iherezo.
testing.h1_a: Python ibizamini ukoreshe pytest + ubwishingizi. Buri router, umutekano wibanze, buri modoka module ifite ibizamini. ~ 80%.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app / test` ikora suite yuzuye muminota 2 kumutwe umwe. Hypothesis imitungo ishingiye kubizamini kuri crypto primitives: `kwemeza decrypt (encrypt (m, k), k) == m` kubutumwa 1000 butemewe. AFL-yuburyo bwa fuzz ibizamini kuri WAF: miriyoni zinjiza zidahwitse zemeza ko zitanga igisubizo cya 4xx (ntabwo ari 5xx). `pytest --cov = porogaramu` yo gukwirakwiza.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) ni de-facto Python ikizamini. Hypothesis (2015) kubizamini bishingiye kumitungo byerekanaga igitekerezo cyihuse cya Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) kuri fuzz nigitabo cyemewe cya fuzzer. Ack1⟫ igikoresho ni rusange; uburyohe bwonyine nibyo dukunda kuri pytest parametrisation kurenza umurage-urwego rwumurage.
testing.h2_a: Ibizamini byihuta muri `ios / Modules /` gutwikira crypto primitives kurwanya RFC ibizamini byongeweho wongeyeho ibizamini bya SwiftUI.
testing.h2_b: `igeragezwa ryihuse` kuva` ios / Modules / `ikora ibizamini byibice munsi ya 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) ibice. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) ibice. RFC 5869 (HKDF) ibice. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) ibikoresho. SwiftUI yerekana amashusho ugereranije ukoresheje ishusho itandukanye na git-ikurikiranwa; gusubira inyuma kuri pigiseli iyo ari yo yose yananiwe kubaka.
testing.h2_c: Gupima crypto kurwanya ibizamini byemewe nuburyo bukoreshwa cyane - niba code yawe yemeye na RFC ibice, birahuye nibisobanuro. Igeragezwa rya Snapshot kuri SwiftUI ni ~ 2022 imiterere yubuhanzi, ikunzwe na pointfreeco / swift-snapshot-igerageza. Vortex ikoresha verisiyo ntoya murugo kugirango wirinde kwishingikiriza.
testing.h3_a: Ibizamini bya Kotlin: JVM-gusa binyuze muri `./gradlew test`; ibikoresho binyuze kuri `./gradlew ihuzaCheck` kuri emulator ikora.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` ikora mumasegonda make - ntamikorere ya Android ikenewe, gusa JUnit + Hilt-android-igerageza. Intego-yikizamini intego: crypto, abatanga ibiganiro, coroutine-ishingiye. `./gradlew ihuzaCheck` izunguruka yigana, yinjizamo porogaramu, ikora ibizamini UI ikoresheje Espresso. E2E itemba: kwinjira → kohereza ubutumwa → reba mukiganiro.
testing.h3_c: Gutandukanya ibizamini JVM gusa n'ibizamini byabigenewe ni amasezerano ya Android 2019+. JVM ibizamini birihuta (amasegonda); ibizamini byabikoresho biratinda (iminota). Robolectric (2014) yahoze ikuraho icyuho ariko yasimbuwe ahanini nuku gutandukana mubikorwa byiterambere rya Android bigezweho.
testing.h4_a: Umwanditsi w'ikinamico atwara umukiriya wurubuga muri Chrome na Firefox idafite umutwe, akora igitabo cyukuri → DM → guhamagara gutemba.
testing.h4_b: `umwanditsi w'amakinamico-` / afite ibintu muri TypeScript. Umwanya wo guta + Postgres izunguruka kuri buri kizamini ikoresheje docker compose. Ibizamini bitwara urubuga UI: andika konti ebyiri, fungura DM, wohereze ubutumwa, ugenzure itangwa, guhamagara videwo hamwe na - Scenarios ikora ibangikanye ikoresheje abakozi ba Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Umwanditsi w'amakinamico (Microsoft, 2020) yasimbuye Selenium kubizamini byinshi byurubuga E2E kuko birihuta, byizewe, kandi bifite ikibazo cyiza. WebRTC kwipimisha muri mushakisha idafite umutwe byari ububabare kugeza Chrome 69 yongeyeho ibendera ryibikoresho-mpimbano; kuva icyo gihe byabaye imyitozo isanzwe.

register.title: POST / api / kwemeza / kwiyandikisha
register.subtitle: Kora umukoresha mushya ufite X25519 indangamuntu + Ijambobanga rya Argon2id.
register.h1_a: Kurema konti nshya yumukoresha kandi itanga intangiriro JWT. Guhuza umukoresha igihe kirekire X25519 urufunguzo rusange kuri konte kuva guhamagarwa kwambere.
register.h1_b: Node yemeza imirima yose ikoresheje Pydantic, igenzura izina ryukoresha na x25519_public_key idasanzwe, ikoresha Argon2id (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) ku ijambo ryibanga, yinjiza muri `abakoresha ',` umukoresha_ibikoresho`,
register.h1_c: Yoherejwe muri v0.0.1 nkibisobanuro byambere. Ibipimo bya X25519 pubkey byongewe muri v0.0.2 nyuma yo kumenya indangamuntu na konti bigomba gushirwaho atomike - bitabaye ibyo seriveri ishobora MITM umukoresha hagati yo kwiyandikisha no kohereza urufunguzo rwa mbere.
register.h2_a: Irasaba: ** ntayo **. Porogaramu yo hagati `porogaramu / umutekano / ibikoresho byo hagati.py :: auth_required` amarembo yiyi nzira kandi yanze hamwe na` 401 itemewe 'niba ibyangombwa bisabwa bibuze cyangwa bitemewe.
register.h2_b:
- `none` - bitemewe (mbere yo kwinjira).
- `jwt` - Uwitwaye JWT ikimenyetso cyo kwinjira mumutwe wa" Uruhushya ".
- `refresh` - Uwitwaye JWT kugarura ikimenyetso.
- `admin` - JWT ibyo basaba birimo` is_admin: ukuri`.
- `urungano rwashyizweho umukono` - gusaba urwego rwashyizweho umukono nurufunguzo rwizewe rwa Ed25519.
register.h2_c: Urwego rwa auth rugaragaza ihame ryamahirwe make: amaherezo yo kwinjira mbere yo kugarukira kugarukira kuri konti no kugarura; ibintu byose inyuma ya JWT ibona umukoresha nyawe; imiyoborere ya admin yerekana badge muri UI bityo gukoresha nabi biragaragara.
register.h3_a: JSON umubiri ufite izina ryumukoresha utegetswe + ijambo ryibanga + x25519_public_key; terefone itabishaka (E.164), imeri (RFC 5322 lite), kwerekana_izina, avatar_emoji, ubutumire_code, kyber_public_key.

login.h2_a: Irasaba: ** ntayo **. Porogaramu yo hagati `porogaramu / umutekano / ibikoresho byo hagati.py :: auth_required` amarembo yiyi nzira kandi yanze hamwe na` 401 itemewe 'niba ibyangombwa bisabwa bibuze cyangwa bitemewe.

- `jwt` - Uwitwaye JWT ikimenyetso cyo kwinjira mumutwe wa" Uruhushya ".

refresh.title: POST / api / kwemeza / kugarura
refresh.subtitle: Gucuruza kugarura JWT kugirango ubone uburyo bushya JWT.
refresh.h1_a: Shushanya ikimenyetso gishya cy'iminota 15 utabajije umukoresha ijambo ryibanga. Byakoreshejwe mugihe icyerekezo kigezweho kiri hafi kurangira cyangwa kimaze gusubiza 401.
refresh.h1_b: Kwemeza no kwemeza ibimenyetso bishya (umukono, exp, ntabwo byavanyweho), byerekana uburyo bushya JWT hamwe na `jti` imwe. Niba `ROTATE_REFRESH = ukuri`, nayo itanga agashya.
refresh.h1_c: Abakurikira RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0. Kuvugurura kuzenguruka byanze bikunze kugirango wirinde amoko mugihe abakiriya benshi bavugurura icyarimwe.
refresh.h2_a: Ibisabwa: ** kugarura **. Porogaramu yo hagati `porogaramu / umutekano / ibikoresho byo hagati.py :: auth_required` amarembo yiyi nzira kandi yanze hamwe na` 401 itemewe 'niba ibyangombwa bisabwa bibuze cyangwa bitemewe.
refresh.h2_b:
- `none` - bitemewe (mbere yo kwinjira).
- `jwt` - Uwitwaye JWT ikimenyetso cyo kwinjira mumutwe wa" Uruhushya ".
- `refresh` - Uwitwaye JWT kugarura ikimenyetso.
- `admin` - JWT ibyo basaba birimo` is_admin: ukuri`.
- `urungano rwashyizweho umukono` - gusaba urwego rwashyizweho umukono nurufunguzo rwizewe rwa Ed25519.
refresh.h2_c: Urwego rwa auth rugaragaza ihame ryamahirwe make: amaherezo yo kwinjira mbere yo kugarukira kugarukira kuri konti no kugarura; ibintu byose inyuma ya JWT ibona umukoresha nyawe; imiyoborere ya admin yerekana badge muri UI bityo gukoresha nabi biragaragara.
refresh.h5_a: Ibisanzwe Vortex ibahasha ibahasha `{ikosa, imiterere, inzira}`. `401` ku byangombwa bibi; `403` ku mahirwe adahagije; `422` ku kwemeza; `429` ku gipimo ntarengwa; `5xx` ku ikosa ryimbere.

totpDisable.h1_a: Kugenzura ijambo ryibanga ryubu + current0⟫; ku ntsinzi, gusiba ibanga.
totpDisable.h1_b: Umukoresha kuriyi nzira aba muri module ijyanye na `porogaramu /`. Inzira yinzira `/ api / kwemeza / 2fa` yatangajwe hamwe na @ @ router.delete ('/ api / kwemeza / 2fa')`.
totpDisable.h1_c: Yoherejwe mugihe cyambere Vortex gusohora nkigice cyubushobozi bwa `2fa`.
totpDisable.h2_a: Ibisabwa: ** jwt **. Porogaramu yo hagati `porogaramu / umutekano / ibikoresho byo hagati.py :: auth_required` amarembo yiyi nzira kandi yanze hamwe na` 401 itemewe 'niba ibyangombwa bisabwa bibuze cyangwa bitemewe.
totpDisable.h2_b:
- `none` - bitemewe (mbere yo kwinjira).
- `jwt` - Uwitwaye JWT ikimenyetso cyo kwinjira mumutwe wa" Uruhushya ".
- `refresh` - Uwitwaye JWT kugarura ikimenyetso.
- `admin` - JWT ibyo basaba birimo` is_admin: ukuri`.
- `urungano rwashyizweho umukono` - gusaba urwego rwashyizweho umukono nurufunguzo rwizewe rwa Ed25519.
totpDisable.h2_c: Urwego rwa auth rugaragaza ihame ryamahirwe make: amaherezo yo kwinjira mbere yo kugarukira kugarukira kuri konti no kugarura; ibintu byose inyuma ya JWT ibona umukoresha nyawe; imiyoborere ya admin yerekana badge muri UI bityo gukoresha nabi biragaragara.
totpDisable.h5_a: Ibisanzwe Vortex ibahasha ibahasha `{ikosa, imiterere, inzira}`. `401` ku byangombwa bibi; `403` ku mahirwe adahagije; `422` ku kwemeza; `429` ku gipimo ntarengwa; `5xx` ku ikosa ryimbere.
totpDisable.h5_f:
401 ikimenyetso kitemewe cyabuze / ikimenyetso kitemewe
403 bibujijwe amahirwe adahagije
422 kwemeza_ibibazo byumurima imbogamizi yarenze
429 igipimo_kigabanya kugerageza cyane
500 imbere_ikosa ritunguranye rya seriveri
totpDisable.h6_f:
gutonda -X DELETE 'https: //node.urugero/api/ibyemezo/2fa' \
  -H 'Ibirimo-Ubwoko: gusaba / json' \
  -H 'Uruhushya: Uwitwaye $ TOKEN'

challenge.title: POST /api/authentication/challenge
challenge.subtitle: X25519 challenge (multi-account)
challenge.h1_a: Issues a nonce bound to the user's X25519 public key. Client signs to prove possession.
challenge.h1_b: Handler for this route lives in the corresponding module under `app/`. The path pattern `/api/authentication/challenge` is declared with `@router.post('/api/authentication/challenge')`.
challenge.h1_c: Shipped in an early Vortex release as part of the `challenge` capability.
challenge.h2_a: Requires: **none**. The middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` gates this route and rejects with `401 unauthenticated` if the required credential is missing or invalid.
challenge.h2_b:
- `none`  — unauthenticated (pre-login).
- `jwt`   — Bearer JWT access token in the `Authorization` header.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT whose claims contain `is_admin: true`.
- `peer-signed` — request body signed by a trusted peer's Ed25519 key.
challenge.h2_c: The auth tier reflects the principle of least privilege: pre-login endpoints are strictly limited to account creation and recovery; everything behind a JWT sees a real user; admin endpoints show a badge in the UI so misuse is observable.
challenge.h5_a: Standard Vortex error envelope `{error, status, path}`. `401` on bad credentials; `403` on insufficient privilege; `422` on validation; `429` on rate limit; `5xx` on internal error.

403  forbidden              insufficient privilege
422  validation_error       field constraint violated
429  rate_limited           too many attempts
500  internal_error         unexpected server fault

thread.h1_a: Creates a pseudo-room rooted at the message; its root key is derived from the parent room's key with `info="thread:<parent_id>"`.
thread.h1_b: Handler for this route lives in the corresponding module under `app/`. The path pattern `/api/messages/{id}/thread` is declared with `@router.post('/api/messages/{id}/thread')`.
thread.h1_c: Shipped in an early Vortex release as part of the `thread` capability.
thread.h2_a: Requires: **jwt**. The middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` gates this route and rejects with `401 unauthenticated` if the required credential is missing or invalid.
thread.h2_b:
- `none`  — unauthenticated (pre-login).
- `jwt`   — Bearer JWT access token in the `Authorization` header.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT whose claims contain `is_admin: true`.
- `peer-signed` — request body signed by a trusted peer's Ed25519 key.
thread.h2_c: The auth tier reflects the principle of least privilege: pre-login endpoints are strictly limited to account creation and recovery; everything behind a JWT sees a real user; admin endpoints show a badge in the UI so misuse is observable.
thread.h5_a: Standard Vortex error envelope `{error, status, path}`. `401` on bad credentials; `403` on insufficient privilege; `422` on validation; `429` on rate limit; `5xx` on internal error.
thread.h5_f:
401  unauthenticated        missing/invalid token
403  forbidden              insufficient privilege
422  validation_error       field constraint violated
429  rate_limited           too many attempts
500  internal_error         unexpected server fault

deliver.h1_b: Handler for this route lives in the corresponding module under `app/`. The path pattern `/federation/deliver` is declared with `@router.post('/federation/deliver')`.
deliver.h1_c: Shipped in an early Vortex release as part of the `deliver` capability.
deliver.h2_a: Requires: **peer-signed**. The middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` gates this route and rejects with `401 unauthenticated` if the required credential is missing or invalid.
deliver.h2_b:
- `none`  — unauthenticated (pre-login).
- `jwt`   — Bearer JWT access token in the `Authorization` header.
- `refresh` — Bearer JWT refresh token.
- `admin` — JWT whose claims contain `is_admin: true`.
- `peer-signed` — request body signed by a trusted peer's Ed25519 key.
deliver.h2_c: The auth tier reflects the principle of least privilege: pre-login endpoints are strictly limited to account creation and recovery; everything behind a JWT sees a real user; admin endpoints show a badge in the UI so misuse is observable.
deliver.h5_a: Standard Vortex error envelope `{error, status, path}`. `401` on bad credentials; `403` on insufficient privilege; `422` on validation; `429` on rate limit; `5xx` on internal error.
deliver.h5_f:
401  unauthenticated        missing/invalid token
403  forbidden              insufficient privilege
422  validation_error       field constraint violated
429  rate_limited           too many attempts
500  internal_error         unexpected server fault
